verses.sa:
अग्निं नरो दीधितिभिररण्योर्हस्तच्युती जनयन्त प्रशस्तम् ।
दूरेदृशं गृहपतिमथर्युम् ॥
verses.rom:
agnim naro didhitibhiraranyorhastachyuti janayanta prashastam |
duredrisham grihapatimatharyum ||
verses.en:
THE men from fire-sticks, with their hands' swift movement, have, in deep thought, engendered glorious Agni,
Far-seen, with pointed flame, Lord of the homestead.

verses.sa:
तमग्निमस्ते वसवो न्यृण्वन्सुप्रतिचक्षमवसे कुतश्चित् ।
दक्षाय्यो यो दम आस नित्यः ॥
verses.rom:
tamagnimaste vasavo nyrinvansupratichakshamavase kutashchit |
dakshayyo yo dama asa nityah ||
verses.en:
The Vasus set that Agni in the dwelling, fair to behold, for help from every quarter:
Who, in the home for ever, must be honoured.

verses.sa:
प्रेद्धो अग्ने दीदिहि पुरो नोऽजस्रया सूर्म्या यविष्ठ ।
त्वां शश्वन्त उप यन्ति वाजाः ॥
verses.rom:
preddho agne didihi puro no'jasraya surmya yavishtha |
tvam shashvanta upa yanti vajah ||
verses.en:
Shine thou before us, Agni, well-enkindled, with flame, Most Youthful God, that never fadeth.
To thee come all our sacrificial viands.

verses.sa:
प्र ते अग्नयोऽग्निभ्यो वरं निः सुवीरासः शोशुचन्त द्युमन्तः ।
यत्रा नरः समासते सुजाताः ॥
verses.rom:
pra te agnayo'gnibhyo varam nih suvirasah shoshuchanta dyumantah |
yatra narah samasate sujatah ||
verses.en:
Among all fires these fires have shone most brightly, splendid with light, begirt by noble heroes,
Where men of lofty birth sit down together.

verses.sa:
दा नो अग्ने धिया रयिं सुवीरं स्वपत्यं सहस्य प्रशस्तम् ।
न यं यावा तरति यातुमावान् ॥
verses.rom:
da no agne dhiya rayim suviram svapatyam sahasya prashastam |
na yam yava tarati yatumavan ||
verses.en:
Victorious Agni, grant us wealth with wisdom, wealth with brave sons, famous and independent,
Which not a foe who deals in magic conquers.

verses.sa:
उप यमेति युवतिः सुदक्षं दोषा वस्तोर्हविष्मती घृताची ।
उप स्वैनमरमतिर्वसूयुः ॥
verses.rom:
upa yameti yuvatih sudaksham dosha vastorhavishmati ghritachi |
upa svainamaramatirvasuyuh ||
verses.en:
To whom, the Strong, at morn and eve comes, maid-like, the ladle dropping oil, with its oblation.
Wealth-seeking comes to him his own devotion.

verses.sa:
विश्वा अग्नेऽप दहारातीर्येभिस्तपोभिरदहो जरूथम् ।
प्र निस्वरं चातयस्वामीवाम् ॥
verses.rom:
vishva agne'pa daharatiryebhistapobhiradaho jarutham |
pra nisvaram chatayasvamivam ||
verses.en:
Burn up all malice with those flames, O Agni, wherewith of old thou burntest up Jarutha,
And drive away in silence pain and sickness.

verses.sa:
आ यस्ते अग्न इधते अनीकं वसिष्ठ शुक्र दीदिवः पावक ।
उतो न एभि स्तवथैरिह स्याः ॥
verses.rom:
a yaste agna idhate anikam vasishtha shukra didivah pavaka |
uto na ebhi stavathairiha syah ||
verses.en:
With him who lighteth up thy splendour, Agni, excellent, pure, refulgent, Purifier,
Be present, and with us through these our praises.

verses.sa:
वि ये ते अग्ने भेजिरे अनीकं मर्ता नरः पित्र्यासः पुरुत्रा ।
उतो न एभिः सुमना इह स्याः ॥
verses.rom:
vi ye te agne bhejire anikam marta narah pitryasah purutra |
uto na ebhih sumana iha syah ||
verses.en:
Agni, the patriarchal men, the mortals who have in many places spread thy lustre,-
Be gracious to us here for their sake also.

verses.sa:
इमे नरो वृत्रहत्येषु शूरा विश्वा अदेवीरभि सन्तु मायाः ।
ये मे धियं पनयन्त प्रशस्ताम् ॥
verses.rom:
ime naro vritrahatyeshu shura vishva adevirabhi santu mayah |
ye me dhiyam panayanta prashastam ||
verses.en:
Let these men, heroes in the fight with foemen, prevail against all godless arts of magic,-
These who approve the noble song I sing thee.

verses.sa:
मा शूने अग्ने नि षदाम नृणां माशेषसोऽवीरता परि त्वा ।
प्रजावतीषु दुर्यासु दुर्य ॥
verses.rom:
ma shune agne ni shadama nrinam masheshaso'virata pari tva |
prajavatishu duryasu durya ||
verses.en:
Let us not sit in want of men, O Agni, without descendants, hero less, about thee:
But, O House-Friend, in houses full of children.

verses.sa:
यमश्वी नित्यमुपयाति यज्ञं प्रजावन्तं स्वपत्यं क्षयं नः ।
स्वजन्मना शेषसा वावृधानम् ॥
verses.rom:
yamashvi nityamupayati yajnam prajavantam svapatyam kshayam nah |
svajanmana sheshasa vavridhanam ||
verses.en:
By sacrifice which the Steeds' Lord ever visits, there make our dwelling rich in seed and offspring,
Increasing still with lineal successors.

verses.sa:
पाहि नो अग्ने रक्षसो अजुष्टात्पाहि धूर्तेरररुषो अघायोः ।
त्वा युजा पृतनायूँरभि ष्याम् ॥
verses.rom:
pahi no agne rakshaso ajushtatpahi dhurterararusho aghayoh |
tva yuja pritanayunrabhi shyam ||
verses.en:
Guard us, O Agni, from the hated demon, guard us from malice of the churlish sinner:
Allied with thee may I subdue assailants.

verses.sa:
सेदग्निरग्नीँरत्यस्त्वन्यान्यत्र वाजी तनयो वीळुपाणिः ।
सहस्रपाथा अक्षरा समेति ॥
verses.rom:
sedagniragninratyastvanyanyatra vaji tanayo vilupanih |
sahasrapatha akshara sameti ||
verses.en:
May this same fire of mine surpass all others, this fire where offspring, vigorous and firm-handed,
Wins, on a thousand paths, what ne'er shall perish.

verses.sa:
सेदग्निर्यो वनुष्यतो निपाति समेद्धारमंहस उरुष्यात् ।
सुजातासः परि चरन्ति वीराः ॥
verses.rom:
sedagniryo vanushyato nipati sameddharamamhasa urushyat |
sujatasah pari charanti virah ||
verses.en:
This is that Agni, saviour from the foeman, who guards the kindler of the flame from sorrow:
Heroes of noble lineage serve and tend him.

verses.sa:
अयं सो अग्निराहुतः पुरुत्रा यमीशानः समिदिन्धे हविष्मान् ।
परि यमेत्यध्वरेषु होता ॥
verses.rom:
ayam so agnirahutah purutra yamishanah samidindhe havishman |
pari yametyadhvareshu hota ||
verses.en:
This is that Agni, served in many places, whom the rich lord who brings oblation kindles,
And round him goes the priest at sacrifices.

verses.sa:
त्वे अग्न आहवनानि भूरीशानास आ जुहुयाम नित्या ।
उभा कृण्वन्तो वहतू मियेधे ॥
verses.rom:
tve agna ahavanani bhurishanasa a juhuyama nitya |
ubha krinvanto vahatu miyedhe ||
verses.en:
Agni, may we with riches in possession bring thee continual offerings in abundance,
Using both means to draw thee to our worship.

verses.sa:
इमो अग्ने वीततमानि हव्याजस्रो वक्षि देवतातिमच्छ ।
प्रति न ईं सुरभीणि व्यन्तु ॥
verses.rom:
imo agne vitatamani havyajasro vakshi devatatimachchha |
prati na im surabhini vyantu ||
verses.en:
Agni, bear thou, Eternal, these most welcome oblations to the Deities' assembly:
Let them enjoy our very fragrant presents.

verses.sa:
मा नो अग्नेऽवीरते परा दा दुर्वाससेऽमतये मा नो अस्यै ।
मा नः क्षुधे मा रक्षस ऋतावो मा नो दमे मा वन आ जुहूर्थाः ॥
verses.rom:
ma no agne'virate para da durvasase'mataye ma no asyai |
ma nah kshudhe ma rakshasa ritavo ma no dame ma vana a juhurthah ||
verses.en:
Give us not up, Agni, to want of heroes, to wretched clothes, to need, to destitution.
Yield us not, Holy One, to fiend or hunger; injure us not at home or in the forest.

verses.sa:
नू मे ब्रह्माण्यग्न उच्छशाधि त्वं देव मघवद्भ्यः सुषूदः ।
रातौ स्यामोभयास आ ते यूयं पात स्वस्तिभिः सदा नः ॥
verses.rom:
nu me brahmanyagna uchchhashadhi tvam deva maghavadbhyah sushudah |
ratau syamobhayasa a te yuyam pata svastibhih sada nah ||
verses.en:
Give strength and power to these my prayers, O Agni; O God, pour blessings on our chiefs and nobles.
Grant that both we and they may share thy bounty. Ye Gods, protect us evermore with blessings.

verses.sa:
त्वमग्ने सुहवो रण्वसंदृक्सुदीती सूनो सहसो दिदीहि ।
मा त्वे सचा तनये नित्य आ धङ्मा वीरो अस्मन्नर्यो वि दासीत् ॥
verses.rom:
tvamagne suhavo ranvasamdriksuditi suno sahaso didihi |
ma tve sacha tanaye nitya a dhanma viro asmannaryo vi dasit ||
verses.en:
Thou Agni, swift to hear, art fair of aspect: beam forth, O Son of Strength, in full effulgence.
Let me not want, with thee, a son for ever: let not a manly hero ever fail us.

verses.sa:
मा नो अग्ने दुर्भृतये सचैषु देवेद्धेष्वग्निषु प्र वोचः ।
मा ते अस्मान्दुर्मतयो भृमाच्चिद्देवस्य सूनो सहसो नशन्त ॥
verses.rom:
ma no agne durbhritaye sachaishu deveddheshvagnishu pra vochah |
ma te asmandurmatayo bhrimachchiddevasya suno sahaso nashanta ||
verses.en:
Condemn us not to indigence, O Agni, beside these flaming fires which Gods have kindled;
Nor, even after fault, let thy displeasure, thine as a God, O Son of Strength, o'ertake us.

verses.sa:
स मर्तो अग्ने स्वनीक रेवानमर्त्ये य आजुहोति हव्यम् ।
स देवता वसुवनिं दधाति यं सूरिरर्थी पृच्छमान एति ॥
verses.rom:
sa marto agne svanika revanamartye ya ajuhoti havyam |
sa devata vasuvanim dadhati yam surirarthi prichchhamana eti ||
verses.en:
O Agni, fair of face, the wealthy mortal who to the Immortal offers his oblation.
Hath him who wins him treasure by his Godhead, to whom the prince, in need, goes supplicating.

verses.sa:
महो नो अग्ने सुवितस्य विद्वान्रयिं सूरिभ्य आ वहा बृहन्तम् ।
येन वयं सहसावन्मदेमाविक्षितास आयुषा सुवीराः ॥
verses.rom:
maho no agne suvitasya vidvanrayim suribhya a vaha brihantam |
yena vayam sahasavanmademavikshitasa ayusha suvirah ||
verses.en:
Knowing our chief felicity, O Agni, bring hither ample riches to our nobles,
Wherewith we may enjoy ourselves, O Victor, with undiminished life and hero children.

verses.sa:
नू मे ब्रह्माण्यग्न उच्छशाधि त्वं देव मघवद्भ्यः सुषूदः ।
रातौ स्यामोभयास आ ते यूयं पात स्वस्तिभिः सदा नः ॥
verses.rom:
nu me brahmanyagna uchchhashadhi tvam deva maghavadbhyah sushudah |
ratau syamobhayasa a te yuyam pata svastibhih sada nah ||
verses.en:
Give strength and power to these my prayers, O Agni; O God, pour blessings on bur chiefs and nobles.
Grant that both we and they may share thy bounty. Ye Gods, protect us evermore with blessings.

verses.sa:
जुषस्व नः समिधमग्ने अद्य शोचा बृहद्यजतं धूममृण्वन् ।
उप स्पृश दिव्यं सानु स्तूपैः सं रश्मिभिस्ततनः सूर्यस्य ॥
verses.rom:
jushasva nah samidhamagne adya shocha brihadyajatam dhumamrinvan |
upa sprisha divyam sanu stupaih sam rashmibhistatanah suryasya ||
verses.en:
GLADLY accept, this day, our fuel, Agni: send up thy sacred smoke and shine sublimely.
Touch the celestial summits with thy columns, and overspread thee with the rays of Surya.

verses.sa:
नराशंसस्य महिमानमेषामुप स्तोषाम यजतस्य यज्ञैः ।
ये सुक्रतवः शुचयो धियंधाः स्वदन्ति देवा उभयानि हव्या ॥
verses.rom:
narashamsasya mahimanameshamupa stoshama yajatasya yajnaih |
ye sukratavah shuchayo dhiyamdhah svadanti deva ubhayani havya ||
verses.en:
With sacrifice to these we men will honour the majesty of holy Narasamsa-
To these the pure, most wise, the thought. inspirers, Gods who enjoy both sorts of our oblations.

verses.sa:
ईळेन्यं वो असुरं सुदक्षमन्तर्दूतं रोदसी सत्यवाचम् ।
मनुष्वदग्निं मनुना समिद्धं समध्वराय सदमिन्महेम ॥
verses.rom:
ilenyam vo asuram sudakshamantardutam rodasi satyavacham |
manushvadagnim manuna samiddham samadhvaraya sadaminmahema ||
verses.en:
We will extol at sacrifice for ever, as men may do, Agni whom Manu kindled,
Your very skilful Asura, meet for worship, envoy between both worlds, the truthful speaker.

verses.sa:
सपर्यवो भरमाणा अभिज्ञु प्र वृञ्जते नमसा बर्हिरग्नौ ।
आजुह्वाना घृतपृष्ठं पृषद्वदध्वर्यवो हविषा मर्जयध्वम् ॥
verses.rom:
saparyavo bharamana abhijnu pra vrinjate namasa barhiragnau |
ajuhvana ghritaprishtham prishadvadadhvaryavo havisha marjayadhvam ||
verses.en:
Bearing the sacred grass, the men who serve him strew it with reverence, on their knees, by Agni.
Calling him to the spotted grass, oil-sprinkled, adorn him, ye Adhvaryus, with oblation.

verses.sa:
स्वाध्यो वि दुरो देवयन्तोऽशिश्रयू रथयुर्देवताता ।
पूर्वी शिशुं न मातरा रिहाणे समग्रुवो न समनेष्वञ्जन् ॥
verses.rom:
svadhyo vi duro devayanto'shishrayu rathayurdevatata |
purvi shishum na matara rihane samagruvo na samaneshvanjan ||
verses.en:
With holy thoughts the pious have thrown open Doors fain for chariots in the Gods' assembly.
Like two full mother cows who lick their youngling, like maidens for the gathering, they adorn them.

verses.sa:
उत योषणे दिव्ये मही न उषासानक्ता सुदुघेव धेनुः ।
बर्हिषदा पुरुहूते मघोनी आ यज्ञिये सुविताय श्रयेताम् ॥
verses.rom:
uta yoshane divye mahi na ushasanakta sudugheva dhenuh |
barhishada puruhute maghoni a yajniye suvitaya shrayetam ||
verses.en:
And let the two exalted Heavenly Ladies, Morning and Night, like a cow good at milking,
Come, much-invoked, and on our grass be seated ' wealthy, deserving worship, for our welfare.

verses.sa:
विप्रा यज्ञेषु मानुषेषु कारू मन्ये वां जातवेदसा यजध्यै ।
ऊर्ध्वं नो अध्वरं कृतं हवेषु ता देवेषु वनथो वार्याणि ॥
verses.rom:
vipra yajneshu manusheshu karu manye vam jatavedasa yajadhyai |
urdhvam no adhvaram kritam haveshu ta deveshu vanatho varyani ||
verses.en:
You, Bards and Singers at men's sacrifices, both filled with wisdom, I incline to worship.
Send up our offerings when we call upon you, and so among the Gods obtain us treasures.

verses.sa:
आ भारती भारतीभिः सजोषा इळा देवैर्मनुष्येभिरग्निः ।
सरस्वती सारस्वतेभिरर्वाक्तिस्रो देवीर्बर्हिरेदं सदन्तु ॥
verses.rom:
a bharati bharatibhih sajosha ila devairmanushyebhiragnih |
sarasvati sarasvatebhirarvaktisro devirbarhiredam sadantu ||
verses.en:
May Bharati with all her Sisters, Ila accordant with the Gods, with mortals Agni,
Sarasvati with all her kindred Rivers, come to this grass, Three Goddesses, and seat them.

verses.sa:
तन्नस्तुरीपमध पोषयित्नु देव त्वष्टर्वि रराणः स्यस्व ।
यतो वीरः कर्मण्यः सुदक्षो युक्तग्रावा जायते देवकामः ॥
verses.rom:
tannasturipamadha poshayitnu deva tvashtarvi raranah syasva |
yato virah karmanyah sudaksho yuktagrava jayate devakamah ||
verses.en:
Well pleased with us do thou, O God, O Tvastar, give ready issue to our procreant vigour,
Whence springs the hero, powerful, skilled in action, lover of Gods, adjuster of the press-stones.

verses.sa:
वनस्पतेऽव सृजोप देवानग्निर्हविः शमिता सूदयाति ।
सेदु होता सत्यतरो यजाति यथा देवानां जनिमानि वेद ॥
verses.rom:
vanaspate'va srijopa devanagnirhavih shamita sudayati |
sedu hota satyataro yajati yatha devanam janimani veda ||
verses.en:
Send to the Gods the oblation, Lord of Forests, and let the Immolator, Agni, dress it.
He as the truer Priest shall offer worship, for the God's generations well he knoweth.

verses.sa:
आ याह्यग्ने समिधानो अर्वाङिन्द्रेण देवैः सरथं तुरेभिः ।
बर्हिर्न आस्तामदितिः सुपुत्रा स्वाहा देवा अमृता मादयन्ताम् ॥
verses.rom:
a yahyagne samidhano arvanindrena devaih saratham turebhih |
barhirna astamaditih suputra svaha deva amrita madayantam ||
verses.en:
Come thou to us, O Agni, duly kindled, together with the potent Gods and Indra.
On this our grass sit Aditi, happy Mother, and let our Hail! delight the Gods Immortal.

verses.sa:
अग्निं वो देवमग्निभिः सजोषा यजिष्ठं दूतमध्वरे कृणुध्वम् ।
यो मर्त्येषु निध्रुविरृतावा तपुर्मूर्धा घृतान्नः पावकः ॥
verses.rom:
agnim vo devamagnibhih sajosha yajishtham dutamadhvare krinudhvam |
yo martyeshu nidhruvirritava tapurmurdha ghritannah pavakah ||
verses.en:
ASSOCIATE with fires, make your God Agni envoy at sacrifice, best skilled in worship,
Established firm among mankind, the Holy, flame-crowned and fed with oil, the Purifier.

verses.sa:
प्रोथदश्वो न यवसेऽविष्यन्यदा महः संवरणाद्व्यस्थात् ।
आदस्य वातो अनु वाति शोचिरध स्म ते व्रजनं कृष्णमस्ति ॥
verses.rom:
prothadashvo na yavase'vishyanyada mahah samvaranadvyasthat |
adasya vato anu vati shochiradha sma te vrajanam krishnamasti ||
verses.en:
Like a steed neighing eager for the pasture, when he hath stepped forth from the great enclosure:
Then the wind following blows upon his splendour, and, straight, the path is black which thou hast travelled.

verses.sa:
उद्यस्य ते नवजातस्य वृष्णोऽग्ने चरन्त्यजरा इधानाः ।
अच्छा द्यामरुषो धूम एति सं दूतो अग्न ईयसे हि देवान् ॥
verses.rom:
udyasya te navajatasya vrishno'gne charantyajara idhanah |
achchha dyamarusho dhuma eti sam duto agna iyase hi devan ||
verses.en:
From thee a Bull but newly born, O Agni, the kindled everlasting flames rise upward.
Aloft to heaven thy ruddy smoke ascendeth: Agni, thou speedest to the Gods as envoy.

verses.sa:
वि यस्य ते पृथिव्यां पाजो अश्रेत्तृषु यदन्ना समवृक्त जम्भैः ।
सेनेव सृष्टा प्रसितिष्ट एति यवं न दस्म जुह्वा विवेक्षि ॥
verses.rom:
vi yasya te prithivyam pajo ashrettrishu yadanna samavrikta jambhaih |
seneva srishta prasitishta eti yavam na dasma juhva vivekshi ||
verses.en:
Thou whose fresh lustre o'er the earth advanceth when greedily with thy jaws thy food thou eatest.
Like a host hurried onward comes thy lasso: fierce, with thy tongue thou piercest, as 'twere barley.

verses.sa:
तमिद्दोषा तमुषसि यविष्ठमग्निमत्यं न मर्जयन्त नरः ।
निशिशाना अतिथिमस्य योनौ दीदाय शोचिराहुतस्य वृष्णः ॥
verses.rom:
tamiddosha tamushasi yavishthamagnimatyam na marjayanta narah |
nishishana atithimasya yonau didaya shochirahutasya vrishnah ||
verses.en:
The men have decked him both at eve and morning, Most Youthful Agni, as they tend a courser.
They kindle him, a guest within his dwelling: bright shines the splendour of the worshipped Hero.

verses.sa:
सुसंदृक्ते स्वनीक प्रतीकं वि यद्रुक्मो न रोचस उपाके ।
दिवो न ते तन्यतुरेति शुष्मश्चित्रो न सूरः प्रति चक्षि भानुम् ॥
verses.rom:
susamdrikte svanika pratikam vi yadrukmo na rochasa upake |
divo na te tanyatureti shushmashchitro na surah prati chakshi bhanum ||
verses.en:
O fair of face, beautiful is thine aspect when, very near at hand, like gold thou gleamest,
Like Heaven's thundering roar thy might approaches, and like the wondrous Sun thy light thou showest.

verses.sa:
यथा वः स्वाहाग्नये दाशेम परीळाभिर्घृतवद्भिश्च हव्यैः ।
तेभिर्नो अग्ने अमितैर्महोभिः शतं पूर्भिरायसीभिर्नि पाहि ॥
verses.rom:
yatha vah svahagnaye dashema parilabhirghritavadbhishcha havyaih |
tebhirno agne amitairmahobhih shatam purbhirayasibhirni pahi ||
verses.en:
That we may worship, with your Hail to Agni! with sacrificial cakes and fat oblations,
Guard us, O Agni, with those boundless glories as with a hundred fortresses of iron.

verses.sa:
या वा ते सन्ति दाशुषे अधृष्टा गिरो वा याभिर्नृवतीरुरुष्याः ।
ताभिर्नः सूनो सहसो नि पाहि स्मत्सूरीञ्जरितॄञ्जातवेदः ॥
verses.rom:
ya va te santi dashushe adhrishta giro va yabhirnrivatirurushyah |
tabhirnah suno sahaso ni pahi smatsurinjaritrinjatavedah ||
verses.en:
Thine are resistless songs for him who offers, and hero-giving hymns wherewith thou savest;
With these, O Son of Strength, O Jatavedas, guard us, preserve these princes and the singers.

verses.sa:
निर्यत्पूतेव स्वधितिः शुचिर्गात्स्वया कृपा तन्वा रोचमानः ।
आ यो मात्रोरुशेन्यो जनिष्ट देवयज्याय सुक्रतुः पावकः ॥
verses.rom:
niryatputeva svadhitih shuchirgatsvaya kripa tanva rochamanah |
a yo matrorushenyo janishta devayajyaya sukratuh pavakah ||
verses.en:
When forth he cometh, like an axe new-sharpened, pure in his form, resplendent in his body,
Sprung, sought with eager longing, from his Parents, for the Gods' worship, Sage and Purifier:

verses.sa:
एता नो अग्ने सौभगा दिदीह्यपि क्रतुं सुचेतसं वतेम ।
विश्वा स्तोतृभ्यो गृणते च सन्तु यूयं पात स्वस्तिभिः सदा नः ॥
verses.rom:
eta no agne saubhaga didihyapi kratum suchetasam vatema |
vishva stotribhyo grinate cha santu yuyam pata svastibhih sada nah ||
verses.en:
Shine this felicity on us, O Agni: may we attain to perfect understanding.
All happiness be theirs who sing and praise thee. Ye Gods, preserve us evermore with blessings.

verses.sa:
प्र वः शुक्राय भानवे भरध्वं हव्यं मतिं चाग्नये सुपूतम् ।
यो दैव्यानि मानुषा जनूंष्यन्तर्विश्वानि विद्मना जिगाति ॥
verses.rom:
pra vah shukraya bhanave bharadhvam havyam matim chagnaye suputam |
yo daivyani manusha janumshyantarvishvani vidmana jigati ||
verses.en:
BRING forth your gifts to his refulgent splendour, your hymn as purest offering to Agni,
To him who goes as messenger with knowledge between all songs of men and Gods in heaven.

verses.sa:
स गृत्सो अग्निस्तरुणश्चिदस्तु यतो यविष्ठो अजनिष्ट मातुः ।
सं यो वना युवते शुचिदन्भूरि चिदन्ना समिदत्ति सद्यः ॥
verses.rom:
sa gritso agnistarunashchidastu yato yavishtho ajanishta matuh |
sam yo vana yuvate shuchidanbhuri chidanna samidatti sadyah ||
verses.en:
Wise must this Agni be, though young and tender, since he was born, Most Youthful, of his Mother;
He who with bright teeth seizeth fast the forests, and eats his food, though plenteous, in a moment.

verses.sa:
अस्य देवस्य संसद्यनीके यं मर्तासः श्येतं जगृभ्रे ।
नि यो गृभं पौरुषेयीमुवोच दुरोकमग्निरायवे शुशोच ॥
verses.rom:
asya devasya samsadyanike yam martasah shyetam jagribhre |
ni yo gribham paurusheyimuvocha durokamagnirayave shushocha ||
verses.en:
Before his presence must we all assemble, this God's whom men have seized in his white splendour.
This Agni who hath brooked that men should seize him hath shone for man with glow insufferable.

verses.sa:
अयं कविरकविषु प्रचेता मर्तेष्वग्निरमृतो नि धायि ।
स मा नो अत्र जुहुरः सहस्वः सदा त्वे सुमनसः स्याम ॥
verses.rom:
ayam kavirakavishu pracheta marteshvagniramrito ni dhayi |
sa ma no atra juhurah sahasvah sada tve sumanasah syama ||
verses.en:
Far-seeing hath this Agni been established, deathless mid mortals, wise among the foolish.
Here, O victorious God, forbear to harm us: may we forever share thy gracious favour.

verses.sa:
आ यो योनिं देवकृतं ससाद क्रत्वा ह्यग्निरमृताँ अतारीत् ।
तमोषधीश्च वनिनश्च गर्भं भूमिश्च विश्वधायसं बिभर्ति ॥
verses.rom:
a yo yonim devakritam sasada kratva hyagniramritan atarit |
tamoshadhishcha vaninashcha garbham bhumishcha vishvadhayasam bibharti ||
verses.en:
He who hath occupied his God-made dwelling, Agni, in wisdom hath surpassed Immortals.
A Babe unborn, the plants and trees support him, and the earth beareth him the All-sustainer.

verses.sa:
ईशे ह्यग्निरमृतस्य भूरेरीशे रायः सुवीर्यस्य दातोः ।
मा त्वा वयं सहसावन्नवीरा माप्सवः परि षदाम मादुवः ॥
verses.rom:
ishe hyagniramritasya bhurerishe rayah suviryasya datoh |
ma tva vayam sahasavannavira mapsavah pari shadama maduvah ||
verses.en:
Agni is Lord of Amrta. in abundance, Lord of the gift of wealth and hero valour,
Victorious God, let us not sit about thee like men devoid of strength, beauty, and worship.

verses.sa:
परिषद्यं ह्यरणस्य रेक्णो नित्यस्य रायः पतयः स्याम ।
न शेषो अग्ने अन्यजातमस्त्यचेतानस्य मा पथो वि दुक्षः ॥
verses.rom:
parishadyam hyaranasya rekno nityasya rayah patayah syama |
na shesho agne anyajatamastyachetanasya ma patho vi dukshah ||
verses.en:
The foeman's treasure may be won with labour: may we be masters of our own possessions.
Agni, no son is he who springs from others: lengthen not out the pathways of the foolish.

verses.sa:
नहि ग्रभायारणः सुशेवोऽन्योदर्यो मनसा मन्तवा उ ।
अधा चिदोकः पुनरित्स एत्या नो वाज्यभीषाळेतु नव्यः ॥
verses.rom:
nahi grabhayaranah sushevo'nyodaryo manasa mantava u |
adha chidokah punaritsa etya no vajyabhishaletu navyah ||
verses.en:
Unwelcome for adoption is the stranger, one to be thought of as another's offspring,
Though grown familiar by continual presence. May our strong hero come, freshly triumphant.

verses.sa:
त्वमग्ने वनुष्यतो नि पाहि त्वमु नः सहसावन्नवद्यात् ।
सं त्वा ध्वस्मन्वदभ्येतु पाथः सं रयि स्पृहयाय्यः सहस्री ॥
verses.rom:
tvamagne vanushyato ni pahi tvamu nah sahasavannavadyat |
sam tva dhvasmanvadabhyetu pathah sam rayi sprihayayyah sahasri ||
verses.en:
Guard us from him who would assail us, Agni; preserve us O thou Victor, from dishonour.
Here let the place of darkening come upon thee: may wealth be ours, desirable, in thousands.

verses.sa:
एता नो अग्ने सौभगा दिदीह्यपि क्रतुं सुचेतसं वतेम ।
विश्वा स्तोतृभ्यो गृणते च सन्तु यूयं पात स्वस्तिभिः सदा नः ॥
verses.rom:
eta no agne saubhaga didihyapi kratum suchetasam vatema |
vishva stotribhyo grinate cha santu yuyam pata svastibhih sada nah ||
verses.en:
Shine this felicity on us, O Agni: may we attain to perfect understanding.
All happiness be theirs who sing and praise thee. Ye Gods, preserve us evermore with blessings.

verses.sa:
प्राग्नये तवसे भरध्वं गिरं दिवो अरतये पृथिव्याः ।
यो विश्वेषाममृतानामुपस्थे वैश्वानरो वावृधे जागृवद्भिः ॥
verses.rom:
pragnaye tavase bharadhvam giram divo arataye prithivyah |
yo vishveshamamritanamupasthe vaishvanaro vavridhe jagrivadbhih ||
verses.en:
BRING forth your song of praise to mighty Agni, the speedy messenger of earth and heaven,
Vaisvanara, who, with those who wake, hath waxen great in the lap of all the Gods Immortal.

verses.sa:
पृष्टो दिवि धाय्यग्निः पृथिव्यां नेता सिन्धूनां वृषभ स्तियानाम् ।
स मानुषीरभि विशो वि भाति वैश्वानरो वावृधानो वरेण ॥
verses.rom:
prishto divi dhayyagnih prithivyam neta sindhunam vrishabha stiyanam |
sa manushirabhi visho vi bhati vaishvanaro vavridhano varena ||
verses.en:
Sought in the heavens, on earth is Agni stablished, leader of rivers, Bull of standing waters.
Vaisvanara when he hath grown in glory, shines on the tribes of men with light and treasure.

verses.sa:
त्वद्भिया विश आयन्नसिक्नीरसमना जहतीर्भोजनानि ।
वैश्वानर पूरवे शोशुचानः पुरो यदग्ने दरयन्नदीदेः ॥
verses.rom:
tvadbhiya visha ayannasiknirasamana jahatirbhojanani |
vaishvanara purave shoshuchanah puro yadagne darayannadideh ||
verses.en:
For fear of thee forth fled the dark-hued races, scattered abroad, deserting their possessions,
When, glowing, O Vaisvanara, for Puru, thou Agni didst light up and rend their castles.

verses.sa:
तव त्रिधातु पृथिवी उत द्यौर्वैश्वानर व्रतमग्ने सचन्त ।
त्वं भासा रोदसी आ ततन्थाजस्रेण शोचिषा शोशुचानः ॥
verses.rom:
tava tridhatu prithivi uta dyaurvaishvanara vratamagne sachanta |
tvam bhasa rodasi a tatanthajasrena shochisha shoshuchanah ||
verses.en:
Agni Vaisvanara, both Earth and Heaven submit them to thy threefold jurisdiction.
Refulgent in thine undecaying lustre thou hast invested both the worlds with splendour.

verses.sa:
त्वामग्ने हरितो वावशाना गिरः सचन्ते धुनयो घृताचीः ।
पतिं कृष्टीनां रथ्यं रयीणां वैश्वानरमुषसां केतुमह्नाम् ॥
verses.rom:
tvamagne harito vavashana girah sachante dhunayo ghritachih |
patim krishtinam rathyam rayinam vaishvanaramushasam ketumahnam ||
verses.en:
Agni, the tawny horses, loudly neighing our resonant hymns that drop with oil, attend thee;
Lord of the tribes, our Charioteer of riches, Ensign of days, Vaisvanara of mornings.

verses.sa:
त्वे असुर्यं वसवो न्यृण्वन्क्रतुं हि ते मित्रमहो जुषन्त ।
त्वं दस्यूँरोकसो अग्न आज उरु ज्योतिर्जनयन्नार्याय ॥
verses.rom:
tve asuryam vasavo nyrinvankratum hi te mitramaho jushanta |
tvam dasyunrokaso agna aja uru jyotirjanayannaryaya ||
verses.en:
In thee, O bright as Mitra, Vasus seated the might of Aduras, for they loved thy spirit.
Thou drivest Dasyus from their home, O Agni, and broughtest forth broad light to light the Arya.

verses.sa:
स जायमानः परमे व्योमन्वायुर्न पाथः परि पासि सद्यः ।
त्वं भुवना जनयन्नभि क्रन्नपत्याय जातवेदो दशस्यन् ॥
verses.rom:
sa jayamanah parame vyomanvayurna pathah pari pasi sadyah |
tvam bhuvana janayannabhi krannapatyaya jatavedo dashasyan ||
verses.en:
Born in the loftiest heaven thou in a moment reachest, like wind, the place where Gods inhabit.
Thou, favouring thine offspring, roaredst loudly when giving life to creatures, Jatavedas.

verses.sa:
तामग्ने अस्मे इषमेरयस्व वैश्वानर द्युमतीं जातवेदः ।
यया राधः पिन्वसि विश्ववार पृथु श्रवो दाशुषे मर्त्याय ॥
verses.rom:
tamagne asme ishamerayasva vaishvanara dyumatim jatavedah |
yaya radhah pinvasi vishvavara prithu shravo dashushe martyaya ||
verses.en:
Send us that strength, Vaisvanara, send it, Agni, that strength, O Jatavedas, full of splendour,
Wherewith, all-bounteous God, thou pourest riches, as fame wide-spreading, on the man who offers.

verses.sa:
तं नो अग्ने मघवद्भ्यः पुरुक्षुं रयिं नि वाजं श्रुत्यं युवस्व ।
वैश्वानर महि नः शर्म यच्छ रुद्रेभिरग्ने वसुभिः सजोषाः ॥
verses.rom:
tam no agne maghavadbhyah purukshum rayim ni vajam shrutyam yuvasva |
vaishvanara mahi nah sharma yachchha rudrebhiragne vasubhih sajoshah ||
verses.en:
Agni, bestow upon our chiefs and nobles that famous power, that wealth which feedeth many.
Accordant with the Vasus and the Rudras, Agni, Vaisvanara, give us sure protection.

verses.sa:
प्र सम्राजो असुरस्य प्रशस्तिं पुंसः कृष्टीनामनुमाद्यस्य ।
इन्द्रस्येव प्र तवसस्कृतानि वन्दे दारुं वन्दमानो विवक्मि ॥
verses.rom:
pra samrajo asurasya prashastim pumsah krishtinamanumadyasya |
indrasyeva pra tavasaskritani vande darum vandamano vivakmi ||
verses.en:
PRAISE of the Asura, high imperial Ruler, the Manly One in whom the folk shall triumph-
I laud his deeds who is as strong as Indra, and lauding celebrate the Fort-destroyer.

verses.sa:
कविं केतुं धासिं भानुमद्रेर्हिन्वन्ति शं राज्यं रोदस्योः ।
पुरंदरस्य गीर्भिरा विवासेऽग्नेर्व्रतानि पूर्व्या महानि ॥
verses.rom:
kavim ketum dhasim bhanumadrerhinvanti sham rajyam rodasyoh |
puramdarasya girbhira vivase'gnervratani purvya mahani ||
verses.en:
Sage, Sing, Food, Light,-they bring him from the mountain, the blessed Sovran of the earth and heaven.
I decorate with songs the mighty actions which Agni, Fort-destroyer, did aforetime.

verses.sa:
न्यक्रतून्ग्रथिनो मृध्रवाचः पणीँरश्रद्धाँ अवृधाँ अयज्ञान् ।
प्रप्र तान्दस्यूँरग्निर्विवाय पूर्वश्चकारापराँ अयज्यून् ॥
verses.rom:
nyakratungrathino mridhravachah paninrashraddhan avridhan ayajnan |
prapra tandasyunragnirvivaya purvashchakaraparan ayajyun ||
verses.en:
The foolish, faithless, rudely-speaking niggards, without belief or sacrifice or worship,-
Far far away hath Agni chased those Dasyus, and, in the cast, hath turned the godless westward.

verses.sa:
यो अपाचीने तमसि मदन्तीः प्राचीश्चकार नृतमः शचीभिः ।
तमीशानं वस्वो अग्निं गृणीषेऽनानतं दमयन्तं पृतन्यून् ॥
verses.rom:
yo apachine tamasi madantih prachishchakara nritamah shachibhih |
tamishanam vasvo agnim grinishe'nanatam damayantam pritanyun ||
verses.en:
Him who brought eastward, manliest with his prowess, the Maids rejoicing in the western darkness,
That Agni I extol, the Lord of riches, unyielding tamer of assailing foemen.

verses.sa:
यो देह्यो अनमयद्वधस्नैर्यो अर्यपत्नीरुषसश्चकार ।
स निरुध्या नहुषो यह्वो अग्निर्विशश्चक्रे बलिहृतः सहोभिः ॥
verses.rom:
yo dehyo anamayadvadhasnairyo aryapatnirushasashchakara |
sa nirudhya nahusho yahvo agnirvishashchakre balihritah sahobhih ||
verses.en:
Him who brake down the walls with deadly weapons, and gave the Mornings to a noble Husband,
Young Agni, who with conquering strength subduing the tribes of Nahus made them bring their tribute.

verses.sa:
यस्य शर्मन्नुप विश्वे जनास एवैस्तस्थुः सुमतिं भिक्षमाणाः ।
वैश्वानरो वरमा रोदस्योराग्निः ससाद पित्रोरुपस्थम् ॥
verses.rom:
yasya sharmannupa vishve janasa evaistasthuh sumatim bhikshamanah |
vaishvanaro varama rodasyoragnih sasada pitrorupastham ||
verses.en:
In whose protection all men rest by nature, desiring to enjoy his gracious favour-
Agni Vaisvanara in his Parents, bosom hath found the choicest seat in earth and heaven.

verses.sa:
आ देवो ददे बुध्न्या वसूनि वैश्वानर उदिता सूर्यस्य ।
आ समुद्रादवरादा परस्मादाग्निर्ददे दिव आ पृथिव्याः ॥
verses.rom:
a devo dade budhnya vasuni vaishvanara udita suryasya |
a samudradavarada parasmadagnirdade diva a prithivyah ||
verses.en:
Vaisvanara the God, at the sun's setting, hath taken to himself deep-hidden treasures:
Agni hath taken them from earth and heaven, from the sea under and the sea above us.

verses.sa:
प्र वो देवं चित्सहसानमग्निमश्वं न वाजिनं हिषे नमोभिः ।
भवा नो दूतो अध्वरस्य विद्वान्त्मना देवेषु विविदे मितद्रुः ॥
verses.rom:
pra vo devam chitsahasanamagnimashvam na vajinam hishe namobhih |
bhava no duto adhvarasya vidvantmana deveshu vivide mitadruh ||
verses.en:
I SEND forth even your God, victorious Agni, like a strong courser, with mine adoration.
Herald of sacrifice be he who knoweth he hath reached Gods, himself, with measured motion.

verses.sa:
आ याह्यग्ने पथ्या अनु स्वा मन्द्रो देवानां सख्यं जुषाणः ।
आ सानु शुष्मैर्नदयन्पृथिव्या जम्भेभिर्विश्वमुशधग्वनानि ॥
verses.rom:
a yahyagne pathya anu sva mandro devanam sakhyam jushanah |
a sanu shushmairnadayanprithivya jambhebhirvishvamushadhagvanani ||
verses.en:
By paths that are thine own come hither, Agni, joyous, delighting in the Gods' alliance,
Making the heights of earth roar with thy fury, burning with eager teeth the woods and forests.

verses.sa:
प्राचीनो यज्ञः सुधितं हि बर्हिः प्रीणीते अग्निरीळितो न होता ।
आ मातरा विश्ववारे हुवानो यतो यविष्ठ जज्ञिषे सुशेवः ॥
verses.rom:
prachino yajnah sudhitam hi barhih prinite agnirilito na hota |
a matara vishvavare huvano yato yavishtha jajnishe sushevah ||
verses.en:
The grass is strewn; the sacrifice advances adored as Priest, Agni is made propitious,
Invoking both All-boon-bestowing Mothers of whom, Most Youthful! thou wast born to help us.

verses.sa:
सद्यो अध्वरे रथिरं जनन्त मानुषासो विचेतसो य एषाम् ।
विशामधायि विश्पतिर्दुरोणेऽग्निर्मन्द्रो मधुवचा ऋतावा ॥
verses.rom:
sadyo adhvare rathiram jananta manushaso vichetaso ya esham |
vishamadhayi vishpatirdurone'gnirmandro madhuvacha ritava ||
verses.en:
Forthwith the men, the best of these for wisdom, have made him leader in the solemn worship.
As Lord in homes of men is Agni stablished, the Holy One, the joyous, sweetly speaking.

verses.sa:
असादि वृतो वह्निराजगन्वानग्निर्ब्रह्मा नृषदने विधर्ता ।
द्यौश्च यं पृथिवी वावृधाते आ यं होता यजति विश्ववारम् ॥
verses.rom:
asadi vrito vahnirajaganvanagnirbrahma nrishadane vidharta |
dyaushcha yam prithivi vavridhate a yam hota yajati vishvavaram ||
verses.en:
He hath come, chosen bearer, and is seated in man's home, Brahman, Agni, the Supporter,
He whom both Heaven and Earth exalt and strengthen whom, Giver of all boons, the Hotar worships.

verses.sa:
एते द्युम्नेभिर्विश्वमातिरन्त मन्त्रं ये वारं नर्या अतक्षन् ।
प्र ये विशस्तिरन्त श्रोषमाणा आ ये मे अस्य दीधयन्नृतस्य ॥
verses.rom:
ete dyumnebhirvishvamatiranta mantram ye varam narya atakshan |
pra ye vishastiranta shroshamana a ye me asya didhayannritasya ||
verses.en:
These have passed all in glory, who, the manly, have wrought with skill the hymn of adoration;
Who, listening, have advanced the people's welfare, and set their thoughts on this my holy statute.

verses.sa:
नू त्वामग्न ईमहे वसिष्ठा ईशानं सूनो सहसो वसूनाम् ।
इषं स्तोतृभ्यो मघवद्भ्य आनड्यूयं पात स्वस्तिभिः सदा नः ॥
verses.rom:
nu tvamagna imahe vasishtha ishanam suno sahaso vasunam |
isham stotribhyo maghavadbhya anadyuyam pata svastibhih sada nah ||
verses.en:
We, the Vasisthas, now implore thee, Agni, O Son of Strength, the Lord of wealth and treasure.
Thou hast brought food to singers and to nobles. Ye Gods, preserve us evermore with blessings.

verses.sa:
इन्धे राजा समर्यो नमोभिर्यस्य प्रतीकमाहुतं घृतेन ।
नरो हव्येभिरीळते सबाध आग्निरग्र उषसामशोचि ॥
verses.rom:
indhe raja samaryo namobhiryasya pratikamahutam ghritena |
naro havyebhirilate sabadha agniragra ushasamashochi ||
verses.en:
THE King whose face is decked with oil is kindled with homage offered by his faithful servant.
The men, the priests adore him with oblations. Agni hath shone forth when the dawn is breaking.

verses.sa:
अयमु ष्य सुमहाँ अवेदि होता मन्द्रो मनुषो यह्वो अग्निः ।
वि भा अकः ससृजानः पृथिव्यां कृष्णपविरोषधीभिर्ववक्षे ॥
verses.rom:
ayamu shya sumahan avedi hota mandro manusho yahvo agnih |
vi bha akah sasrijanah prithivyam krishnapaviroshadhibhirvavakshe ||
verses.en:
Yea, he hath been acknowledged as most mighty, the joyous Priest of men, the youthful Agni.
He, spreading o'er the earth, made light around him, and grew among the plants with blackened fellies..

verses.sa:
कया नो अग्ने वि वसः सुवृक्तिं कामु स्वधामृणवः शस्यमानः ।
कदा भवेम पतयः सुदत्र रायो वन्तारो दुष्टरस्य साधोः ॥
verses.rom:
kaya no agne vi vasah suvriktim kamu svadhamrinavah shasyamanah |
kada bhavema patayah sudatra rayo vantaro dushtarasya sadhoh ||
verses.en:
How dost thou decorate our hymn, O Agni? What power dost thou exert when thou art lauded?
When, Bounteous God, may we be lords of riches, winners of precious wealth which none may conquer?

verses.sa:
प्रप्रायमग्निर्भरतस्य शृण्वे वि यत्सूर्यो न रोचते बृहद्भाः ।
अभि यः पूरुं पृतनासु तस्थौ द्युतानो दैव्यो अतिथिः शुशोच ॥
verses.rom:
praprayamagnirbharatasya shrinve vi yatsuryo na rochate brihadbhah |
abhi yah purum pritanasu tasthau dyutano daivyo atithih shushocha ||
verses.en:
Far famed is this the Bharata's own Agni he shineth like the Sun with lofty splendour.
He who hath vanquished Puru in the battle, the heavenly guest hath glowed in full refulgence.

verses.sa:
असन्नित्त्वे आहवनानि भूरि भुवो विश्वेभिः सुमना अनीकैः ।
स्तुतश्चिदग्ने शृण्विषे गृणानः स्वयं वर्धस्व तन्वं सुजात ॥
verses.rom:
asannittve ahavanani bhuri bhuvo vishvebhih sumana anikaih |
stutashchidagne shrinvishe grinanah svayam vardhasva tanvam sujata ||
verses.en:
Full many oblations are in thee collected: with all thine aspects thou hast waxen gracious.
Thou art already famed as praised and lauded, yet still, O nobly born, increase thy body.

verses.sa:
इदं वचः शतसाः संसहस्रमुदग्नये जनिषीष्ट द्विबर्हाः ।
शं यत्स्तोतृभ्य आपये भवाति द्युमदमीवचातनं रक्षोहा ॥
verses.rom:
idam vachah shatasah samsahasramudagnaye janishishta dvibarhah |
sham yatstotribhya apaye bhavati dyumadamivachatanam rakshoha ||
verses.en:
Be this my song, that winneth countless treasure, engendered with redoubled force for Agni,
That, splendid, chasing sickness, slaying demons, it may delight our friend and bless the singers.

verses.sa:
नू त्वामग्न ईमहे वसिष्ठा ईशानं सूनो सहसो वसूनाम् ।
इषं स्तोतृभ्यो मघवद्भ्य आनड्यूयं पात स्वस्तिभिः सदा नः ॥
verses.rom:
nu tvamagna imahe vasishtha ishanam suno sahaso vasunam |
isham stotribhyo maghavadbhya anadyuyam pata svastibhih sada nah ||
verses.en:
We, the Vasisthas, now implore thee, Agni, O Son of Strength, the Lord of wealth and riches.
Thou hast brought food to singers and to nobles. Ye Gods, preserve us evermore with blessings.

verses.sa:
अबोधि जार उषसामुपस्थाद्धोता मन्द्रः कवितमः पावकः ।
दधाति केतुमुभयस्य जन्तोर्हव्या देवेषु द्रविणं सुकृत्सु ॥
verses.rom:
abodhi jara ushasamupasthaddhota mandrah kavitamah pavakah |
dadhati ketumubhayasya jantorhavya deveshu dravinam sukritsu ||
verses.en:
ROUSED from their bosom is the Dawns' beloved, the joyous Priest, most sapient, Purifier.
He gives a signal both to Gods and mortals, to Gods oblations, riches to the pious.

verses.sa:
स सुक्रतुर्यो वि दुरः पणीनां पुनानो अर्कं पुरुभोजसं नः ।
होता मन्द्रो विशां दमूनास्तिरस्तमो ददृशे राम्याणाम् ॥
verses.rom:
sa sukraturyo vi durah paninam punano arkam purubhojasam nah |
hota mandro visham damunastirastamo dadrishe ramyanam ||
verses.en:
Most wise is he who, forcing doors of Panis, brought the bright Sun to us who feedeth many.
The cheerful Priest, men's Friend and home-companion, through still night's darkness he is made apparent.

verses.sa:
अमूरः कविरदितिर्विवस्वान्सुसंसन्मित्रो अतिथिः शिवो नः ।
चित्रभानुरुषसां भात्यग्रेऽपां गर्भः प्रस्व आ विवेश ॥
verses.rom:
amurah kaviraditirvivasvansusamsanmitro atithih shivo nah |
chitrabhanurushasam bhatyagre'pam garbhah prasva a vivesha ||
verses.en:
Wise, ne.'er deceived, uncircumscribed, refulgent, our gracious guest, a Friend with good attendants,
Shines forth with wondrous light before the Mornings; the young plants hath he entered, Child of Waters.

verses.sa:
ईळेन्यो वो मनुषो युगेषु समनगा अशुचज्जातवेदाः ।
सुसंदृशा भानुना यो विभाति प्रति गावः समिधानं बुधन्त ॥
verses.rom:
ilenyo vo manusho yugeshu samanaga ashuchajjatavedah |
susamdrisha bhanuna yo vibhati prati gavah samidhanam budhanta ||
verses.en:
Seeking our gatherings, he, your Jatavedas, hath shone adorable through human ages,
Who gleams refulgent with his lovely lustre: the kine have waked to meet him when enkindled.

verses.sa:
अग्ने याहि दूत्यं मा रिषण्यो देवाँ अच्छा ब्रह्मकृता गणेन ।
सरस्वतीं मरुतो अश्विनापो यक्षि देवान्रत्नधेयाय विश्वान् ॥
verses.rom:
agne yahi dutyam ma rishanyo devan achchha brahmakrita ganena |
sarasvatim maruto ashvinapo yakshi devanratnadheyaya vishvan ||
verses.en:
Go on thy message to the Gods, and fail not, O Agni, with their band who pray and worship.
Bring all the Gods that they may give us riches, Sarasvati, the Maruts, Asvins, Waters.

verses.sa:
त्वामग्ने समिधानो वसिष्ठो जरूथं हन्यक्षि राये पुरंधिम् ।
पुरुणीथा जातवेदो जरस्व यूयं पात स्वस्तिभिः सदा नः ॥
verses.rom:
tvamagne samidhano vasishtho jarutham hanyakshi raye puramdhim |
purunitha jatavedo jarasva yuyam pata svastibhih sada nah ||
verses.en:
Vasistha, when enkindling thee, O Agni, hath slain jarutha. Give us wealth in plenty.
Sing praise in choral song, O Jatavedas. Ye Gods, preserve us evermore with blessings.

verses.sa:
उषो न जारः पृथु पाजो अश्रेद्दविद्युतद्दीद्यच्छोशुचानः ।
वृषा हरिः शुचिरा भाति भासा धियो हिन्वान उशतीरजीगः ॥
verses.rom:
usho na jarah prithu pajo ashreddavidyutaddidyachchhoshuchanah |
vrisha harih shuchira bhati bhasa dhiyo hinvana ushatirajigah ||
verses.en:
HE hath sent forth, bright, radiant, and refulgent, like the Dawn's Lover, his far-spreading lustre.
Pure in his splendour shines the golden Hero: our longing thoughts hath he aroused and wakened.

verses.sa:
स्वर्ण वस्तोरुषसामरोचि यज्ञं तन्वाना उशिजो न मन्म ।
अग्निर्जन्मानि देव आ वि विद्वान्द्रवद्दूतो देवयावा वनिष्ठः ॥
verses.rom:
svarna vastorushasamarochi yajnam tanvana ushijo na manma |
agnirjanmani deva a vi vidvandravadduto devayava vanishthah ||
verses.en:
He, like the Sun, hath shone while Morn is breaking, and priests who weave the sacrifice sing praises,
Agni, the God, who knows their generations and visits Gods, most bounteous, rapid envoy.

verses.sa:
अच्छा गिरो मतयो देवयन्तीरग्निं यन्ति द्रविणं भिक्षमाणाः ।
सुसंदृशं सुप्रतीकं स्वञ्चं हव्यवाहमरतिं मानुषाणाम् ॥
verses.rom:
achchha giro matayo devayantiragnim yanti dravinam bhikshamanah |
susamdrisham supratikam svancham havyavahamaratim manushanam ||
verses.en:
Our songs and holy hymns go forth to Agni, seeking the God and asking him for riches,
Him fair to see, of goodly aspect, mighty, men's messenger who carries their oblations.

verses.sa:
इन्द्रं नो अग्ने वसुभिः सजोषा रुद्रं रुद्रेभिरा वहा बृहन्तम् ।
आदित्येभिरदितिं विश्वजन्यां बृहस्पतिमृक्वभिर्विश्ववारम् ॥
verses.rom:
indram no agne vasubhih sajosha rudram rudrebhira vaha brihantam |
adityebhiraditim vishvajanyam brihaspatimrikvabhirvishvavaram ||
verses.en:
Joined with the Vasus, Agni, bring thou Indra bring hither mighty Rudra with the Rudras,
Aditi good to all men with Adityas, Brhaspati All-bounteous, with the Singers.

verses.sa:
मन्द्रं होतारमुशिजो यविष्ठमग्निं विश ईळते अध्वरेषु ।
स हि क्षपावाँ अभवद्रयीणामतन्द्रो दूतो यजथाय देवान् ॥
verses.rom:
mandram hotaramushijo yavishthamagnim visha ilate adhvareshu |
sa hi kshapavan abhavadrayinamatandro duto yajathaya devan ||
verses.en:
Men eagerly implore at sacrifices Agni, Most Youthful God, the joyous Herald.
For he is Lord and Ruler over riches, and for Gods' worship an unwearied envoy.

verses.sa:
महाँ अस्यध्वरस्य प्रकेतो न ऋते त्वदमृता मादयन्ते ।
आ विश्वेभिः सरथं याहि देवैर्न्यग्ने होता प्रथमः सदेह ॥
verses.rom:
mahan asyadhvarasya praketo na rite tvadamrita madayante |
a vishvebhih saratham yahi devairnyagne hota prathamah sadeha ||
verses.en:
GREAT art thou, Agni, sacrifice's Herald: not without thee are deathless Gods made joyful.
Come hither with all Deities about thee here take thy seat, the first, as Priest, O Agni.

verses.sa:
त्वामीळते अजिरं दूत्याय हविष्मन्तः सदमिन्मानुषासः ।
यस्य देवैरासदो बर्हिरग्नेऽहान्यस्मै सुदिना भवन्ति ॥
verses.rom:
tvamilate ajiram dutyaya havishmantah sadaminmanushasah |
yasya devairasado barhiragne'hanyasmai sudina bhavanti ||
verses.en:
Men with oblations evermore entreat thee, the swift, to undertake an envoy's duty.
He on whose sacred grass with Gods thou sittest, to him, O Agni, are the days propitious.

verses.sa:
त्रिश्चिदक्तोः प्र चिकितुर्वसूनि त्वे अन्तर्दाशुषे मर्त्याय ।
मनुष्वदग्न इह यक्षि देवान्भवा नो दूतो अभिशस्तिपावा ॥
verses.rom:
trishchidaktoh pra chikiturvasuni tve antardashushe martyaya |
manushvadagna iha yakshi devanbhava no duto abhishastipava ||
verses.en:
Three times a day in thee are shown the treasures sent for the mortal who presents oblation.
Bring the Gods hither like a man, O Agni: be thou our envoy, guarding us from curses.

verses.sa:
अग्निरीशे बृहतो अध्वरस्याग्निर्विश्वस्य हविषः कृतस्य ।
क्रतुं ह्यस्य वसवो जुषन्ताथा देवा दधिरे हव्यवाहम् ॥
verses.rom:
agnirishe brihato adhvarasyagnirvishvasya havishah kritasya |
kratum hyasya vasavo jushantatha deva dadhire havyavaham ||
verses.en:
Lord of the lofty sacrifice is Agni, Agni is Lord of every gift presented.
The Vasus were contented with his wisdom, so the Gods made him their oblation bearer.

verses.sa:
आग्ने वह हविरद्याय देवानिन्द्रज्येष्ठास इह मादयन्ताम् ।
इमं यज्ञं दिवि देवेषु धेहि यूयं पात स्वस्तिभिः सदा नः ॥
verses.rom:
agne vaha haviradyaya devanindrajyeshthasa iha madayantam |
imam yajnam divi deveshu dhehi yuyam pata svastibhih sada nah ||
verses.en:
O Agni, bring the Gods to taste our presents: with Indra leading, here let them be joyful.
Convey this sacrifice to Gods in heaven. Ye Gods, preserve us evermore with blessings.

verses.sa:
अगन्म महा नमसा यविष्ठं यो दीदाय समिद्धः स्वे दुरोणे ।
चित्रभानुं रोदसी अन्तरुर्वी स्वाहुतं विश्वतः प्रत्यञ्चम् ॥
verses.rom:
aganma maha namasa yavishtham yo didaya samiddhah sve durone |
chitrabhanum rodasi antarurvi svahutam vishvatah pratyancham ||
verses.en:
WE with great reverence have approached The Youngest who hath shone forth well-kindled in his dwelling,
With wondrous light between wide earth and heaven, well-worshipped, looking forth in all directions.

verses.sa:
स मह्ना विश्वा दुरितानि साह्वानग्नि ष्टवे दम आ जातवेदाः ।
स नो रक्षिषद्दुरितादवद्यादस्मान्गृणत उत नो मघोनः ॥
verses.rom:
sa mahna vishva duritani sahvanagni shtave dama a jatavedah |
sa no rakshishadduritadavadyadasmangrinata uta no maghonah ||
verses.en:
Through his great might o'ercoming all misfortunes, praised in the house is Agni Jatavedas.
May he protect us from disgrace and trouble, both us who laud him and our noble patrons.

verses.sa:
त्वं वरुण उत मित्रो अग्ने त्वां वर्धन्ति मतिभिर्वसिष्ठाः ।
त्वे वसु सुषणनानि सन्तु यूयं पात स्वस्तिभिः सदा नः ॥
verses.rom:
tvam varuna uta mitro agne tvam vardhanti matibhirvasishthah |
tve vasu sushananani santu yuyam pata svastibhih sada nah ||
verses.en:
O Agni, thou art Varuna and Mitra: Vasisthas with their holy hymns exalt thee.
With thee be most abundant gain of treasure. Ye Gods, preserve us evermore with blessings.

verses.sa:
प्राग्नये विश्वशुचे धियंधेऽसुरघ्ने मन्म धीतिं भरध्वम् ।
भरे हविर्न बर्हिषि प्रीणानो वैश्वानराय यतये मतीनाम् ॥
verses.rom:
pragnaye vishvashuche dhiyamdhe'suraghne manma dhitim bharadhvam |
bhare havirna barhishi prinano vaishvanaraya yataye matinam ||
verses.en:
BRING song and hymn to Agni, Asura-slayer, enlightener of all and thought-bestower.
Like an oblation on the grass, to please him, I bring this to Vaisvanara, hymn-inspirer.

verses.sa:
त्वमग्ने शोचिषा शोशुचान आ रोदसी अपृणा जायमानः ।
त्वं देवाँ अभिशस्तेरमुञ्चो वैश्वानर जातवेदो महित्वा ॥
verses.rom:
tvamagne shochisha shoshuchana a rodasi aprina jayamanah |
tvam devan abhishasteramuncho vaishvanara jatavedo mahitva ||
verses.en:
Thou with thy flame, O Agni, brightly glowing, hast at thy birth filled full the earth and heaven.
Thou with thy might, Vaisvanara Jatavedas, settest the Gods free from the curse that bound them.

verses.sa:
जातो यदग्ने भुवना व्यख्यः पशून्न गोपा इर्यः परिज्मा ।
वैश्वानर ब्रह्मणे विन्द गातुं यूयं पात स्वस्तिभिः सदा नः ॥
verses.rom:
jato yadagne bhuvana vyakhyah pashunna gopa iryah parijma |
vaishvanara brahmane vinda gatum yuyam pata svastibhih sada nah ||
verses.en:
Agni, when, born thou lookedst on all creatures, like a brisk herdsman moving round his cattle.
The path to prayer, Vaisvanara, thou foundest. Ye Gods, preserve us evermore with blessings.

verses.sa:
समिधा जातवेदसे देवाय देवहूतिभिः ।
हविर्भिः शुक्रशोचिषे नमस्विनो वयं दाशेमाग्नये ॥
verses.rom:
samidha jatavedase devaya devahutibhih |
havirbhih shukrashochishe namasvino vayam dashemagnaye ||
verses.en:
WITH reverence and with offered gifts serve we the God whose flame is bright:
Let us bring Jatavedas fuel, and adore Agni when we invoke the Gods.

verses.sa:
वयं ते अग्ने समिधा विधेम वयं दाशेम सुष्टुती यजत्र ।
वयं घृतेनाध्वरस्य होतर्वयं देव हविषा भद्रशोचे ॥
verses.rom:
vayam te agne samidha vidhema vayam dashema sushtuti yajatra |
vayam ghritenadhvarasya hotarvayam deva havisha bhadrashoche ||
verses.en:
Agni, may we perform thy rites with fuel, and honour thee, O Holy one, with praises:
Honour thee, Priest of sacrifice! with butter, thee, God of blessed light! with our oblation.

verses.sa:
आ नो देवेभिरुप देवहूतिमग्ने याहि वषट्कृतिं जुषाणः ।
तुभ्यं देवाय दाशतः स्याम यूयं पात स्वस्तिभिः सदा नः ॥
verses.rom:
a no devebhirupa devahutimagne yahi vashatkritim jushanah |
tubhyam devaya dashatah syama yuyam pata svastibhih sada nah ||
verses.en:
Come, Agni, with the Gods to our invoking, come, pleased, to offerings sanctified with Vasat.
May we be his who pays thee, God, due honour. Ye Gods, preserve us evermore with blessings.

verses.sa:
उपसद्याय मीळ्हुष आस्ये जुहुता हविः ।
यो नो नेदिष्ठमाप्यम् ॥
verses.rom:
upasadyaya milhusha asye juhuta havih |
yo no nedishthamapyam ||
verses.en:
OFFER oblations in his mouth, the bounteous God's whom we must serve.
His who is nearest kin to us:

verses.sa:
यः पञ्च चर्षणीरभि निषसाद दमेदमे ।
कविर्गृहपतिर्युवा ॥
verses.rom:
yah pancha charshanirabhi nishasada damedame |
kavirgrihapatiryuva ||
verses.en:
Who for the Fivefold People's take hath seated him in every home
Wise, Youthful, Master of the house.

verses.sa:
स नो वेदो अमात्यमग्नी रक्षतु विश्वतः ।
उतास्मान्पात्वंहसः ॥
verses.rom:
sa no vedo amatyamagni rakshatu vishvatah |
utasmanpatvamhasah ||
verses.en:
On all sides may that Agni guard our household folk and property;
May he deliver us from woe.

verses.sa:
नवं नु स्तोममग्नये दिवः श्येनाय जीजनम् ।
वस्वः कुविद्वनाति नः ॥
verses.rom:
navam nu stomamagnaye divah shyenaya jijanam |
vasvah kuvidvanati nah ||
verses.en:
I have begotten this new hymn for Agni, Falcon of the sky:
Will he not give us of his wealth?

verses.sa:
स्पार्हा यस्य श्रियो दृशे रयिर्वीरवतो यथा ।
अग्रे यज्ञस्य शोचतः ॥
verses.rom:
sparha yasya shriyo drishe rayirviravato yatha |
agre yajnasya shochatah ||
verses.en:
Whose glories when he glows in front of sacrifice are fair to see,
Like wealth of one with hero sons.

verses.sa:
सेमां वेतु वषट्कृतिमग्निर्जुषत नो गिरः ।
यजिष्ठो हव्यवाहनः ॥
verses.rom:
semam vetu vashatkritimagnirjushata no girah |
yajishtho havyavahanah ||
verses.en:
May he enjoy this hallowed gift, Agni accept our songs, who bears
Oblations, best of worshippers.

verses.sa:
नि त्वा नक्ष्य विश्पते द्युमन्तं देव धीमहि ।
सुवीरमग्न आहुत ॥
verses.rom:
ni tva nakshya vishpate dyumantam deva dhimahi |
suviramagna ahuta ||
verses.en:
Lord of the house, whom men must seek, we set thee down, O Worshipped One
Bright, rich in heroes, Agni! God

verses.sa:
क्षप उस्रश्च दीदिहि स्वग्नयस्त्वया वयम् ।
सुवीरस्त्वमस्मयुः ॥
verses.rom:
kshapa usrashcha didihi svagnayastvaya vayam |
suvirastvamasmayuh ||
verses.en:
Shine forth at night and morn: through thee with fires are we provided well.
Thou, rich in heroes, art our Friend.

verses.sa:
उप त्वा सातये नरो विप्रासो यन्ति धीतिभिः ।
उपाक्षरा सहस्रिणी ॥
verses.rom:
upa tva sataye naro vipraso yanti dhitibhih |
upakshara sahasrini ||
verses.en:
The men come near thee for their gain, the singers with their songs of praise:
Speech, thousand fold, comes near to thee.

verses.sa:
अग्नी रक्षांसि सेधति शुक्रशोचिरमर्त्यः ।
शुचिः पावक ईड्यः ॥
verses.rom:
agni rakshamsi sedhati shukrashochiramartyah |
shuchih pavaka idyah ||
verses.en:
Bright, Purifier, meet for praise, Immortal with refulgent glow,
Agni drives Raksasas away.

verses.sa:
स नो राधांस्या भरेशानः सहसो यहो ।
भगश्च दातु वार्यम् ॥
verses.rom:
sa no radhamsya bhareshanah sahaso yaho |
bhagashcha datu varyam ||
verses.en:
As such, bring us abundant wealth, young Child of Strength, for this thou canst
May Bhaga give us what is choice.

verses.sa:
त्वमग्ने वीरवद्यशो देवश्च सविता भगः ।
दितिश्च दाति वार्यम् ॥
verses.rom:
tvamagne viravadyasho devashcha savita bhagah |
ditishcha dati varyam ||
verses.en:
Thou, Agni, givest hero fame: Bhaga and Savitar the God,
And Did give us what is good.

verses.sa:
अग्ने रक्षा णो अंहसः प्रति ष्म देव रीषतः ।
तपिष्ठैरजरो दह ॥
verses.rom:
agne raksha no amhasah prati shma deva rishatah |
tapishthairajaro daha ||
verses.en:
Agni, preserve us from distress: consume our enemies, O God,
Eternal, with the hottest flames.

verses.sa:
अधा मही न आयस्यनाधृष्टो नृपीतये ।
पूर्भवा शतभुजिः ॥
verses.rom:
adha mahi na ayasyanadhrishto nripitaye |
purbhava shatabhujih ||
verses.en:
And, irresistible, be thou a mighty iron fort to us,
With hundred walls for man's defense.

verses.sa:
त्वं नः पाह्यंहसो दोषावस्तरघायतः ।
दिवा नक्तमदाभ्य ॥
verses.rom:
tvam nah pahyamhaso doshavastaraghayatah |
diva naktamadabhya ||
verses.en:
Do thou preserve us, eve and morn, from sorrow, from the wicked men,
Infallible! by day and night.

verses.sa:
एना वो अग्निं नमसोर्जो नपातमा हुवे ।
प्रियं चेतिष्ठमरतिं स्वध्वरं विश्वस्य दूतममृतम् ॥
verses.rom:
ena vo agnim namasorjo napatama huve |
priyam chetishthamaratim svadhvaram vishvasya dutamamritam ||
verses.en:
WITH this my reverent hymn I call Agni for you, the Son of Strength,
Dear, wisest envoy, served with noble sacrifice, immortal messenger of all.

verses.sa:
स योजते अरुषा विश्वभोजसा स दुद्रवत्स्वाहुतः ।
सुब्रह्मा यज्ञः सुशमी वसूनां देवं राधो जनानाम् ॥
verses.rom:
sa yojate arusha vishvabhojasa sa dudravatsvahutah |
subrahma yajnah sushami vasunam devam radho jananam ||
verses.en:
His two red horses, all-supporting, let him yoke: let him, well-worshipped, urge them fast.
Then hath the sacrifice good prayers and happy end, and heavenly gift of wealth to men.

verses.sa:
उदस्य शोचिरस्थादाजुह्वानस्य मीळ्हुषः ।
उद्धूमासो अरुषासो दिविस्पृशः समग्निमिन्धते नरः ॥
verses.rom:
udasya shochirasthadajuhvanasya milhushah |
uddhumaso arushaso divisprishah samagnimindhate narah ||
verses.en:
The flame of him the Bountiful, the Much-invoked, hath mounted up,
And his red-coloured smoke-clouds reach and touch the sky: the men are kindling Agni well.

verses.sa:
तं त्वा दूतं कृण्महे यशस्तमं देवाँ आ वीतये वह ।
विश्वा सूनो सहसो मर्तभोजना रास्व तद्यत्त्वेमहे ॥
verses.rom:
tam tva dutam krinmahe yashastamam devan a vitaye vaha |
vishva suno sahaso martabhojana rasva tadyattvemahe ||
verses.en:
Thee, thee Most Glorious One we make our messenger. Bring the Gods hither to the feast.
Give us, O Son of Strength, all food that feedeth man: give that for which we pray to thee.

verses.sa:
त्वमग्ने गृहपतिस्त्वं होता नो अध्वरे ।
त्वं पोता विश्ववार प्रचेता यक्षि वेषि च वार्यम् ॥
verses.rom:
tvamagne grihapatistvam hota no adhvare |
tvam pota vishvavara pracheta yakshi veshi cha varyam ||
verses.en:
Thou, Agni, art the homestead's Lord, our Herald at the sacrifice.
Lord of all boons, thou art the Cleanser and a Sage. Pay worship, and enjoy the good.

verses.sa:
कृधि रत्नं यजमानाय सुक्रतो त्वं हि रत्नधा असि ।
आ न ऋते शिशीहि विश्वमृत्विजं सुशंसो यश्च दक्षते ॥
verses.rom:
kridhi ratnam yajamanaya sukrato tvam hi ratnadha asi |
a na rite shishihi vishvamritvijam sushamso yashcha dakshate ||
verses.en:
Give riches to the sacrificer, O Most Wise, for thou art he who granteth wealth.
Inspire with zeal each priest at this our solemn rite; all who are skilled in singing praise.

verses.sa:
त्वे अग्ने स्वाहुत प्रियासः सन्तु सूरयः ।
यन्तारो ये मघवानो जनानामूर्वान्दयन्त गोनाम् ॥
verses.rom:
tve agne svahuta priyasah santu surayah |
yantaro ye maghavano jananamurvandayanta gonam ||
verses.en:
O Agni who art worshipped well, dear let our princes be to thee,
Our wealthy patrons who are governors of men, who part, as gifts, their stalls of kine.

verses.sa:
येषामिळा घृतहस्ता दुरोण आँ अपि प्राता निषीदति ।
ताँस्त्रायस्व सहस्य द्रुहो निदो यच्छा नः शर्म दीर्घश्रुत् ॥
verses.rom:
yeshamila ghritahasta durona an api prata nishidati |
tanstrayasva sahasya druho nido yachchha nah sharma dirghashrut ||
verses.en:
They in whose home, her hand bearing the sacred oil, Ila sits down well-satisfied-
Guard them, Victorious God, from slander and from harm. give us a refuge famed afar.

verses.sa:
स मन्द्रया च जिह्वया वह्निरासा विदुष्टरः ।
अग्ने रयिं मघवद्भ्यो न आ वह हव्यदातिं च सूदय ॥
verses.rom:
sa mandraya cha jihvaya vahnirasa vidushtarah |
agne rayim maghavadbhyo na a vaha havyadatim cha sudaya ||
verses.en:
Do thou, a Priest with pleasant tongue, most wise, and very near to us,
Agni, bring riches hither to our liberal chiefs, and speed the offering of our gifts.

verses.sa:
ये राधांसि ददत्यश्व्या मघा कामेन श्रवसो महः ।
ताँ अंहसः पिपृहि पर्तृभिष्ट्वं शतं पूर्भिर्यविष्ठ्य ॥
verses.rom:
ye radhamsi dadatyashvya magha kamena shravaso mahah |
tan amhasah piprihi partribhishtvam shatam purbhiryavishthya ||
verses.en:
They who bestow as bounty plenteous wealth of steeds, moved by desire of great renown-
Do thou with saving help preserve them from distress, Most Youthful! with a hundred forts.

verses.sa:
देवो वो द्रविणोदाः पूर्णां विवष्ट्यासिचम् ।
उद्वा सिञ्चध्वमुप वा पृणध्वमादिद्वो देव ओहते ॥
verses.rom:
devo vo dravinodah purnam vivashtyasicham |
udva sinchadhvamupa va prinadhvamadidvo deva ohate ||
verses.en:
The God who gives your wealth demands a full libation poured to him.
Pour ye it forth, then fill the vessel full again: then doth the God pay heed to you.

verses.sa:
तं होतारमध्वरस्य प्रचेतसं वह्निं देवा अकृण्वत ।
दधाति रत्नं विधते सुवीर्यमग्निर्जनाय दाशुषे ॥
verses.rom:
tam hotaramadhvarasya prachetasam vahnim deva akrinvata |
dadhati ratnam vidhate suviryamagnirjanaya dashushe ||
verses.en:
Him have the Gods appointed Priest of sacrifice, oblation-bearer, passing wise.
Agni gives wealth and valour to the worshipper, to folk who offer up their gifts.

verses.sa: अग्ने भव सुषमिधा समिद्ध उत बर्हिरुर्विया वि स्तृणीताम् ॥
verses.rom: agne bhava sushamidha samiddha uta barhirurviya vi strinitam ||
verses.en: AGNI, be kindled well with proper fuel, and let the grass be scattered wide about thee.

verses.sa: उत द्वार उशतीर्वि श्रयन्तामुत देवाँ उशत आ वहेह ॥
verses.rom: uta dvara ushatirvi shrayantamuta devan ushata a vaheha ||
verses.en: Let the impatient Portals be thrown open bring thou the Gods impatient to come hither.

verses.sa: अग्ने वीहि हविषा यक्षि देवान्स्वध्वरा कृणुहि जातवेदः ॥
verses.rom: agne vihi havisha yakshi devansvadhvara krinuhi jatavedah ||
verses.en: Taste, Agni: serve the Gods with our oblation. Offer good sacrifices, Jatavedas!

verses.sa: स्वध्वरा करति जातवेदा यक्षद्देवाँ अमृतान्पिप्रयच्च ॥
verses.rom: svadhvara karati jataveda yakshaddevan amritanpiprayachcha ||
verses.en: Let Jatavedas pay fair sacrifices, worship and gratify the Gods Immortal.

verses.sa: वंस्व विश्वा वार्याणि प्रचेतः सत्या भवन्त्वाशिषो नो अद्य ॥
verses.rom: vamsva vishva varyani prachetah satya bhavantvashisho no adya ||
verses.en: Wise God, win for us things that are all-goodly, and let the prayers, we pray today be fruitful.

verses.sa: त्वामु ते दधिरे हव्यवाहं देवासो अग्न ऊर्ज आ नपातम् ॥
verses.rom: tvamu te dadhire havyavaham devaso agna urja a napatam ||
verses.en: Thee, even thee, the Son of Strength, O Agni, those Gods have made the bearer of oblations.

verses.sa: ते ते देवाय दाशतः स्याम महो नो रत्ना वि दध इयानः ॥
verses.rom: te te devaya dashatah syama maho no ratna vi dadha iyanah ||
verses.en: To thee the God may we perform our worship: do thou, besought, grant us abundant riches.

verses.sa:
त्वे ह यत्पितरश्चिन्न इन्द्र विश्वा वामा जरितारो असन्वन् ।
त्वे गावः सुदुघास्त्वे ह्यश्वास्त्वं वसु देवयते वनिष्ठः ॥
verses.rom:
tve ha yatpitarashchinna indra vishva vama jaritaro asanvan |
tve gavah sudughastve hyashvastvam vasu devayate vanishthah ||
verses.en:
ALL is with thee, O Indra, all the treasures which erst our fathers won who sang thy praises.
With thee are milch-kine good to milk, and horses: best winner thou of riches for the pious.

verses.sa:
राजेव हि जनिभिः क्षेष्येवाव द्युभिरभि विदुष्कविः सन् ।
पिशा गिरो मघवन्गोभिरश्वैस्त्वायतः शिशीहि राये अस्मान् ॥
verses.rom:
rajeva hi janibhih ksheshyevava dyubhirabhi vidushkavih san |
pisha giro maghavangobhirashvaistvayatah shishihi raye asman ||
verses.en:
For like a King among his wives thou dwellest: with glories, as a Sage, surround and help us.
Make us, thy servants, strong for wealth, and honour our songs wirth kine and steeds and decoration.

verses.sa:
इमा उ त्वा पस्पृधानासो अत्र मन्द्रा गिरो देवयन्तीरुप स्थुः ।
अर्वाची ते पथ्या राय एतु स्याम ते सुमताविन्द्र शर्मन् ॥
verses.rom:
ima u tva paspridhanaso atra mandra giro devayantirupa sthuh |
arvachi te pathya raya etu syama te sumatavindra sharman ||
verses.en:
Here these our holy hymns with joy and gladness in pious emulation have approached thee.
Hitherward come thy path that leads to riches: may we find shelter in thy favour, Indra.

verses.sa:
धेनुं न त्वा सूयवसे दुदुक्षन्नुप ब्रह्माणि ससृजे वसिष्ठः ।
त्वामिन्मे गोपतिं विश्व आहा न इन्द्रः सुमतिं गन्त्वच्छ ॥
verses.rom:
dhenum na tva suyavase dudukshannupa brahmani sasrije vasishthah |
tvaminme gopatim vishva aha na indrah sumatim gantvachchha ||
verses.en:
Vasistha hath poured forth his prayers, desiring to milk thee like a cow in goodly pasture.
All these my people call thee Lord of cattle: may Indra. come unto the prayer we offer.

verses.sa:
अर्णांसि चित्पप्रथाना सुदास इन्द्रो गाधान्यकृणोत्सुपारा ।
शर्धन्तं शिम्युमुचथस्य नव्यः शापं सिन्धूनामकृणोदशस्तीः ॥
verses.rom:
arnamsi chitpaprathana sudasa indro gadhanyakrinotsupara |
shardhantam shimyumuchathasya navyah shapam sindhunamakrinodashastih ||
verses.en:
What though the floods spread widely, Indra made them shallow and easy for Sudas to traverse.
He, worthy of our praises, caused the Simyu, foe of our hymn, to curse the rivers' fury.

verses.sa:
पुरोळा इत्तुर्वशो यक्षुरासीद्राये मत्स्यासो निशिता अपीव ।
श्रुष्टिं चक्रुर्भृगवो द्रुह्यवश्च सखा सखायमतरद्विषूचोः ॥
verses.rom:
purola itturvasho yakshurasidraye matsyaso nishita apiva |
shrushtim chakrurbhrigavo druhyavashcha sakha sakhayamataradvishuchoh ||
verses.en:
Eager for spoil was Turvasa Purodas, fain to win wealth, like fishes urged by hunger.
The Bhrgus and the Druhyus quickly listened: friend rescued friend mid the two distant peoples.

verses.sa:
आ पक्थासो भलानसो भनन्तालिनासो विषाणिनः शिवासः ।
आ योऽनयत्सधमा आर्यस्य गव्या तृत्सुभ्यो अजगन्युधा नॄन् ॥
verses.rom:
a pakthaso bhalanaso bhanantalinaso vishaninah shivasah |
a yo'nayatsadhama aryasya gavya tritsubhyo ajaganyudha nrin ||
verses.en:
Together came the Pakthas, the Bhalanas, the Alinas, the Sivas, the Visanins.
Yet to the Trtsus came the Arya's Comrade, through love of spoil and heroes' war, to lead them.

verses.sa:
दुराध्यो अदितिं स्रेवयन्तोऽचेतसो वि जगृभ्रे परुष्णीम् ।
मह्नाविव्यक्पृथिवीं पत्यमानः पशुष्कविरशयच्चायमानः ॥
verses.rom:
duradhyo aditim srevayanto'chetaso vi jagribhre parushnim |
mahnavivyakprithivim patyamanah pashushkavirashayachchayamanah ||
verses.en:
Fools, in their folly fain to waste her waters, they parted inexhaustible Parusni.
Lord of the Earth, he with his might repressed them: still lay the herd and the affrighted herdsman.

verses.sa:
ईयुरर्थं न न्यर्थं परुष्णीमाशुश्चनेदभिपित्वं जगाम ।
सुदास इन्द्रः सुतुकाँ अमित्रानरन्धयन्मानुषे वध्रिवाचः ॥
verses.rom:
iyurartham na nyartham parushnimashushchanedabhipitvam jagama |
sudasa indrah sutukan amitranarandhayanmanushe vadhrivachah ||
verses.en:
As to their goal they sped to their destruction: they sought Parusni; e'en the swift returned not.
Indra abandoned, to Sudas the manly, the swiftly flying foes, unmanly babblers.

verses.sa:
ईयुर्गावो न यवसादगोपा यथाकृतमभि मित्रं चितासः ।
पृश्निगावः पृश्निनिप्रेषितासः श्रुष्टिं चक्रुर्नियुतो रन्तयश्च ॥
verses.rom:
iyurgavo na yavasadagopa yathakritamabhi mitram chitasah |
prishnigavah prishninipreshitasah shrushtim chakrurniyuto rantayashcha ||
verses.en:
They went like kine unherded from the pasture, each clinging to a friend as chance directed.
They who drive spotted steeds, sent down by Prsni, gave ear, the Warriors and the harnessed horses.

verses.sa:
एकं च यो विंशतिं च श्रवस्या वैकर्णयोर्जनान्राजा न्यस्तः ।
दस्मो न सद्मन्नि शिशाति बर्हिः शूरः सर्गमकृणोदिन्द्र एषाम् ॥
verses.rom:
ekam cha yo vimshatim cha shravasya vaikarnayorjananraja nyastah |
dasmo na sadmanni shishati barhih shurah sargamakrinodindra esham ||
verses.en:
The King who scattered one-and-twenty people of both Vaikarna tribes through lust of glory-
As the skilled priest clips grass within the chamber, so hath the Hero Indra, wrought their downfall.

verses.sa:
अध श्रुतं कवषं वृद्धमप्स्वनु द्रुह्युं नि वृणग्वज्रबाहुः ।
वृणाना अत्र सख्याय सख्यं त्वायन्तो ये अमदन्ननु त्वा ॥
verses.rom:
adha shrutam kavasham vriddhamapsvanu druhyum ni vrinagvajrabahuh |
vrinana atra sakhyaya sakhyam tvayanto ye amadannanu tva ||
verses.en:
Thou, thunder-armed, o'erwhelmedst in the waters famed ancient Kavasa and then the Druhyu.
Others here claiming friendship to their friendship, devoted unto thee, in thee were joyful.

verses.sa:
वि सद्यो विश्वा दृंहितान्येषामिन्द्रः पुरः सहसा सप्त दर्दः ।
व्यानवस्य तृत्सवे गयं भाग्जेष्म पूरुं विदथे मृध्रवाचम् ॥
verses.rom:
vi sadyo vishva drimhitanyeshamindrah purah sahasa sapta dardah |
vyanavasya tritsave gayam bhagjeshma purum vidathe mridhravacham ||
verses.en:
Indra at once with conquering might demolished all their strong places and their seven castles.
The goods of Anu's son he gave to Trtsu. May we in sacrifice conquer scorned Puru.

verses.sa:
नि गव्यवोऽनवो द्रुह्यवश्च षष्टिः शता सुषुपुः षट् सहस्रा ।
षष्टिर्वीरासो अधि षड्दुवोयु विश्वेदिन्द्रस्य वीर्या कृतानि ॥
verses.rom:
ni gavyavo'navo druhyavashcha shashtih shata sushupuh shat sahasra |
shashtirviraso adhi shadduvoyu vishvedindrasya virya kritani ||
verses.en:
The Anavas and Druhyus, seeking booty, have slept, the sixty hundred, yea, six thousand,
And six-and-sixty heroes. For the pious were all these mighty exploits done by Indra.

verses.sa:
इन्द्रेणैते तृत्सवो वेविषाणा आपो न सृष्टा अधवन्त नीचीः ।
दुर्मित्रासः प्रकलविन्मिमाना जहुर्विश्वानि भोजना सुदासे ॥
verses.rom:
indrenaite tritsavo vevishana apo na srishta adhavanta nichih |
durmitrasah prakalavinmimana jahurvishvani bhojana sudase ||
verses.en:
These Trtsus under Indra's careful guidance came speeding like loosed waters rushing downward.
The foemen, measuring exceeding closely, abandoned to Sudas all their provisions.

verses.sa:
अर्धं वीरस्य शृतपामनिन्द्रं परा शर्धन्तं नुनुदे अभि क्षाम् ।
इन्द्रो मन्युं मन्युम्यो मिमाय भेजे पथो वर्तनिं पत्यमानः ॥
verses.rom:
ardham virasya shritapamanindram para shardhantam nunude abhi ksham |
indro manyum manyumyo mimaya bheje patho vartanim patyamanah ||
verses.en:
The hero's side who drank the dressed oblation, Indra's denier, far o'er earth he scattered.
Indra brought down the fierce destroyer's fury. He gave them various roads, the path's Controller.

verses.sa:
आध्रेण चित्तद्वेकं चकार सिंह्यं चित्पेत्वेना जघान ।
अव स्रक्तीर्वेश्यावृश्चदिन्द्रः प्रायच्छद्विश्वा भोजना सुदासे ॥
verses.rom:
adhrena chittadvekam chakara simhyam chitpetvena jaghana |
ava sraktirveshyavrishchadindrah prayachchhadvishva bhojana sudase ||
verses.en:
E'en with the weak he wrought this matchless exploit: e'en with a goat he did to death a lion.
He pared the pillar's angles with a needle. Thus to Sudas Indra gave all provisions.

verses.sa:
शश्वन्तो हि शत्रवो रारधुष्टे भेदस्य चिच्छर्धतो विन्द रन्धिम् ।
मर्ताँ एन स्तुवतो यः कृणोति तिग्मं तस्मिन्नि जहि वज्रमिन्द्र ॥
verses.rom:
shashvanto hi shatravo raradhushte bhedasya chichchhardhato vinda randhim |
martan ena stuvato yah krinoti tigmam tasminni jahi vajramindra ||
verses.en:
To thee have all thine enemies submitted: e'en the fierce Bheda hast thou made thy subject.
Cast down thy sharpened thunderbolt, O Indra, on him who harms the men who sing thy praises.

verses.sa:
आवदिन्द्रं यमुना तृत्सवश्च प्रात्र भेदं सर्वताता मुषायत् ।
अजासश्च शिग्रवो यक्षवश्च बलिं शीर्षाणि जभ्रुरश्व्यानि ॥
verses.rom:
avadindram yamuna tritsavashcha pratra bhedam sarvatata mushayat |
ajasashcha shigravo yakshavashcha balim shirshani jabhrurashvyani ||
verses.en:
Yamuna and the Trtsus aided Indra. There he stripped Bheda bare of all his treasures.
The Ajas and the Sigrus and the Yaksus brought in to him as tribute heads of horses.

verses.sa:
न त इन्द्र सुमतयो न रायः संचक्षे पूर्वा उषसो न नूत्नाः ।
देवकं चिन्मान्यमानं जघन्थाव त्मना बृहतः शम्बरं भेत् ॥
verses.rom:
na ta indra sumatayo na rayah samchakshe purva ushaso na nutnah |
devakam chinmanyamanam jaghanthava tmana brihatah shambaram bhet ||
verses.en:
Not to be scorned, but like Dawns past and recent, O Indra, are thy favours and thy riches.
Devaka, Manyamana's son, thou slewest, and smotest Sambara from the lofty mountain.

verses.sa:
प्र ये गृहादममदुस्त्वाया पराशरः शतयातुर्वसिष्ठः ।
न ते भोजस्य सख्यं मृषन्ताधा सूरिभ्यः सुदिना व्युच्छान् ॥
verses.rom:
pra ye grihadamamadustvaya parasharah shatayaturvasishthah |
na te bhojasya sakhyam mrishantadha suribhyah sudina vyuchchhan ||
verses.en:
They who, from home, have gladdened thee, thy servants Parasara, Vasistha, Satayatu,
Will not forget thy friendship, liberal Giver. So shall the days dawn prosperous for the princes.

verses.sa:
द्वे नप्तुर्देववतः शते गोर्द्वा रथा वधूमन्ता सुदासः ।
अर्हन्नग्ने पैजवनस्य दानं होतेव सद्म पर्येमि रेभन् ॥
verses.rom:
dve napturdevavatah shate gordva ratha vadhumanta sudasah |
arhannagne paijavanasya danam hoteva sadma paryemi rebhan ||
verses.en:
Priest-like, with praise, I move around the altar, earning Paijavana's reward, O Agni,
Two hundred cows from Devavan's descendant, two chariots from Sudas with mares to draw them.

verses.sa:
चत्वारो मा पैजवनस्य दानाः स्मद्दिष्टयः कृशनिनो निरेके ।
ऋज्रासो मा पृथिविष्ठाः सुदासस्तोकं तोकाय श्रवसे वहन्ति ॥
verses.rom:
chatvaro ma paijavanasya danah smaddishtayah krishanino nireke |
rijraso ma prithivishthah sudasastokam tokaya shravase vahanti ||
verses.en:
Gift of Paijavana, four horses bear me in foremost place, trained steeds with pearl to deck them.
Sudas's brown steeds, firmly-stepping, carry me and my son for progeny and glory.

verses.sa:
यस्य श्रवो रोदसी अन्तरुर्वी शीर्ष्णेशीर्ष्णे विबभाजा विभक्ता ।
सप्तेदिन्द्रं न स्रवतो गृणन्ति नि युध्यामधिमशिशादभीके ॥
verses.rom:
yasya shravo rodasi antarurvi shirshneshirshne vibabhaja vibhakta |
saptedindram na sravato grinanti ni yudhyamadhimashishadabhike ||
verses.en:
Him whose fame spreads between wide earth and heaven, who, as dispenser, gives each chief his portion,
Seven flowing Rivers glorify like Indra. He slew Yudhyamadhi in close encounter.

verses.sa:
इमं नरो मरुतः सश्चतानु दिवोदासं न पितरं सुदासः ।
अविष्टना पैजवनस्य केतं दूणाशं क्षत्रमजरं दुवोयु ॥
verses.rom:
imam naro marutah sashchatanu divodasam na pitaram sudasah |
avishtana paijavanasya ketam dunasham kshatramajaram duvoyu ||
verses.en:
Attend on him O ye heroic Maruts as on Sudas's father Divodasa.
Further Paijavana's desire with favour. Guard faithfully his lasting firm dominion.

verses.sa:
यस्तिग्मशृङ्गो वृषभो न भीम एकः कृष्टीश्च्यावयति प्र विश्वाः ।
यः शश्वतो अदाशुषो गयस्य प्रयन्तासि सुष्वितराय वेदः ॥
verses.rom:
yastigmashringo vrishabho na bhima ekah krishtishchyavayati pra vishvah |
yah shashvato adashusho gayasya prayantasi sushvitaraya vedah ||
verses.en:
HE like a bull with sharpened horns, terrific, singly excites and agitates all the people:
Thou givest him who largely pours libations his goods who pours not, for his own possession.

verses.sa:
त्वं ह त्यदिन्द्र कुत्समावः शुश्रूषमाणस्तन्वा समर्ये ।
दासं यच्छुष्णं कुयवं न्यस्मा अरन्धय आर्जुनेयाय शिक्षन् ॥
verses.rom:
tvam ha tyadindra kutsamavah shushrushamanastanva samarye |
dasam yachchhushnam kuyavam nyasma arandhaya arjuneyaya shikshan ||
verses.en:
Thou, verily, Indra, gavest help to Kutsa, willingly giving car to him in battle,
When, aiding Arjuneya, thou subduedst to him both Kuyava and the Dasa Susna.

verses.sa:
त्वं धृष्णो धृषता वीतहव्यं प्रावो विश्वाभिरूतिभिः सुदासम् ।
प्र पौरुकुत्सिं त्रसदस्युमावः क्षेत्रसाता वृत्रहत्येषु पूरुम् ॥
verses.rom:
tvam dhrishno dhrishata vitahavyam pravo vishvabhirutibhih sudasam |
pra paurukutsim trasadasyumavah kshetrasata vritrahatyeshu purum ||
verses.en:
O Bold One, thou with all thine aids hast boldly holpen Sudas whose offerings were accepted,
Puru in winning land and slaying foemen, and Trasadasyu son of Purukutsa.

verses.sa:
त्वं नृभिर्नृमणो देववीतौ भूरीणि वृत्रा हर्यश्व हंसि ।
त्वं नि दस्युं चुमुरिं धुनिं चास्वापयो दभीतये सुहन्तु ॥
verses.rom:
tvam nribhirnrimano devavitau bhurini vritra haryashva hamsi |
tvam ni dasyum chumurim dhunim chasvapayo dabhitaye suhantu ||
verses.en:
At the Gods' banquet, hero-souled! with Heroes, Lord of Bay Steeds, thou slewest many foemen.
Thou sentest in swift death to sleep the Dasyu, both Cumuri and Dhuni, for Dabhiti.

verses.sa:
तव च्यौत्नानि वज्रहस्त तानि नव यत्पुरो नवतिं च सद्यः ।
निवेशने शततमाविवेषीरहञ्च वृत्रं नमुचिमुताहन् ॥
verses.rom:
tava chyautnani vajrahasta tani nava yatpuro navatim cha sadyah |
niveshane shatatamaviveshirahancha vritram namuchimutahan ||
verses.en:
These were thy mighty powers that, Thunder-wielder, thou swiftly crushedst nine-and-ninety castles:
Thou capturedst the hundredth in thine onslaught; thou slewest Namuci, thou slewest Vrtra.

verses.sa:
सना ता त इन्द्र भोजनानि रातहव्याय दाशुषे सुदासे ।
वृष्णे ते हरी वृषणा युनज्मि व्यन्तु ब्रह्माणि पुरुशाक वाजम् ॥
verses.rom:
sana ta ta indra bhojanani ratahavyaya dashushe sudase |
vrishne te hari vrishana yunajmi vyantu brahmani purushaka vajam ||
verses.en:
Old are the blessings, Indra, which thou gavest Sudas the worshipper who brought oblations.
For thee, the Strong, I yoke thy strong Bay Horses: may our prayers reach thee and win strength, Most Mighty!

verses.sa:
मा ते अस्यां सहसावन्परिष्टावघाय भूम हरिवः परादै ।
त्रायस्व नोऽवृकेभिर्वरूथैस्तव प्रियासः सूरिषु स्याम ॥
verses.rom:
ma te asyam sahasavanparishtavaghaya bhuma harivah paradai |
trayasva no'vrikebhirvaruthaistava priyasah surishu syama ||
verses.en:
Give us not up, Lord of Bay Horses, Victor, in this thine own assembly, to the wicked.
Deliver us with true and faithful succours: dear may we be to thee among the princes.

verses.sa:
प्रियास इत्ते मघवन्नभिष्टौ नरो मदेम शरणे सखायः ।
नि तुर्वशं नि याद्वं शिशीह्यतिथिग्वाय शंस्यं करिष्यन् ॥
verses.rom:
priyasa itte maghavannabhishtau naro madema sharane sakhayah |
ni turvasham ni yadvam shishihyatithigvaya shamsyam karishyan ||
verses.en:
May we men, Maghavan, the friends thou lovest, near thee be joyful under thy protection.
Fain to fulfil the wish of Atithigva humble. the pride of Turvasa and Yadva.

verses.sa:
सद्यश्चिन्नु ते मघवन्नभिष्टौ नरः शंसन्त्युक्थशास उक्था ।
ये ते हवेभिर्वि पणीँरदाशन्नस्मान्वृणीष्व युज्याय तस्मै ॥
verses.rom:
sadyashchinnu te maghavannabhishtau narah shamsantyukthashasa uktha |
ye te havebhirvi paninradashannasmanvrinishva yujyaya tasmai ||
verses.en:
Swiftly, in truth, O Maghavan, about thee men skilled in hymning sing their songs and praises. '
Elect us also into their assembly who by their calls on thee despoiled the niggards.

verses.sa:
एते स्तोमा नरां नृतम तुभ्यमस्मद्र्यञ्चो ददतो मघानि ।
तेषामिन्द्र वृत्रहत्ये शिवो भूः सखा च शूरोऽविता च नृणाम् ॥
verses.rom:
ete stoma naram nritama tubhyamasmadryancho dadato maghani |
teshamindra vritrahatye shivo bhuh sakha cha shuro'vita cha nrinam ||
verses.en:
Thine are these lauds, O manliest of heroes, lauds which revert to us and give us riches.
Favour these, Indra, when they fight with foemen, as Friend and Hero and the heroes' Helper.

verses.sa:
नू इन्द्र शूर स्तवमान ऊती ब्रह्मजूतस्तन्वा वावृधस्व ।
उप नो वाजान्मिमीह्युप स्तीन्यूयं पात स्वस्तिभिः सदा नः ॥
verses.rom:
nu indra shura stavamana uti brahmajutastanva vavridhasva |
upa no vajanmimihyupa stinyuyam pata svastibhih sada nah ||
verses.en:
Now, lauded for thine aid, Heroic Indra, sped by our prayer, wax mighty in thy body.
Apportion to us strength and habitations. Ye Gods, protect us evermore with blessings.

verses.sa:
उग्रो जज्ञे वीर्याय स्वधावाञ्चक्रिरपो नर्यो यत्करिष्यन् ।
जग्मिर्युवा नृषदनमवोभिस्त्राता न इन्द्र एनसो महश्चित् ॥
verses.rom:
ugro jajne viryaya svadhavanchakrirapo naryo yatkarishyan |
jagmiryuva nrishadanamavobhistrata na indra enaso mahashchit ||
verses.en:
STRONG, Godly-natured, born for hero exploit, man's Friend, he doth whatever deed he willeth.
Saving us e'en from great transgression, Indra, the Youthful, visiteth man's home with favour.

verses.sa:
हन्ता वृत्रमिन्द्रः शूशुवानः प्रावीन्नु वीरो जरितारमूती ।
कर्ता सुदासे अह वा उ लोकं दाता वसु मुहुरा दाशुषे भूत् ॥
verses.rom:
hanta vritramindrah shushuvanah pravinnu viro jaritaramuti |
karta sudase aha va u lokam data vasu muhura dashushe bhut ||
verses.en:
Waxing greatness Indra slayeth Vrtra: the Hero with his aid hath helped the singer.
He gave Sudas wide room and space, and often hath granted wealth to him who brought oblations.

verses.sa:
युध्मो अनर्वा खजकृत्समद्वा शूरः सत्राषाड्जनुषेमषाळ्हः ।
व्यास इन्द्रः पृतनाः स्वोजा अधा विश्वं शत्रूयन्तं जघान ॥
verses.rom:
yudhmo anarva khajakritsamadva shurah satrashadjanushemashalhah |
vyasa indrah pritanah svoja adha vishvam shatruyantam jaghana ||
verses.en:
Soldier unchecked, war-rousing, battling Hero, unconquered from of old, victorious ever,
Indra the very strong hath scattered armies; yea, he hath slain each foe who fought against him.

verses.sa:
उभे चिदिन्द्र रोदसी महित्वा पप्राथ तविषीभिस्तुविष्मः ।
नि वज्रमिन्द्रो हरिवान्मिमिक्षन्समन्धसा मदेषु वा उवोच ॥
verses.rom:
ubhe chidindra rodasi mahitva papratha tavishibhistuvishmah |
ni vajramindro harivanmimikshansamandhasa madeshu va uvocha ||
verses.en:
Thou with thy greatness hast filled full, O Indra, even both the worlds with might, O thou Most Mighty.
Lord of Bays, Indra, brandishing his thunder, is gratified with Soma at the banquet.

verses.sa:
वृषा जजान वृषणं रणाय तमु चिन्नारी नर्यं ससूव ।
प्र यः सेनानीरध नृभ्यो अस्तीनः सत्वा गवेषणः स धृष्णुः ॥
verses.rom:
vrisha jajana vrishanam ranaya tamu chinnari naryam sasuva |
pra yah senaniradha nribhyo astinah satva gaveshanah sa dhrishnuh ||
verses.en:
A Bull begat the Bull for joy of battle, and a strong Mother brought forth him the manly.
He who is Chief of men, their armies' Leader, is strong Hero, bold, and fain for booty.

verses.sa:
नू चित्स भ्रेषते जनो न रेषन्मनो यो अस्य घोरमाविवासात् ।
यज्ञैर्य इन्द्रे दधते दुवांसि क्षयत्स राय ऋतपा ऋतेजाः ॥
verses.rom:
nu chitsa bhreshate jano na reshanmano yo asya ghoramavivasat |
yajnairya indre dadhate duvamsi kshayatsa raya ritapa ritejah ||
verses.en:
The people falter not, nor suffer sorrow, who win themselves this God's terrific spirit.
He who with sacrifices worships Indra is lord of wealth, law-born and law's protector.

verses.sa:
यदिन्द्र पूर्वो अपराय शिक्षन्नयज्ज्यायान्कनीयसो देष्णम् ।
अमृत इत्पर्यासीत दूरमा चित्र चित्र्यं भरा रयिं नः ॥
verses.rom:
yadindra purvo aparaya shikshannayajjyayankaniyaso deshnam |
amrita itparyasita durama chitra chitryam bhara rayim nah ||
verses.en:
Whene'er the elder fain would help the younger the greater cometh to the lesser's present.
Shall the Immortal sit aloof' inactive? O Wondrous Indra, bring us wondrous riches.

verses.sa:
यस्त इन्द्र प्रियो जनो ददाशदसन्निरेके अद्रिवः सखा ते ।
वयं ते अस्यां सुमतौ चनिष्ठाः स्याम वरूथे अघ्नतो नृपीतौ ॥
verses.rom:
yasta indra priyo jano dadashadasannireke adrivah sakha te |
vayam te asyam sumatau chanishthah syama varuthe aghnato nripitau ||
verses.en:
Thy dear folk, Indra, who present oblations, are, in chief place, thy friends, O Thunder-wielder.
May we be best content in this thy favour, sheltered by One who slays not, but preserves us.

verses.sa:
एष स्तोमो अचिक्रदद्वृषा त उत स्तामुर्मघवन्नक्रपिष्ट ।
रायस्कामो जरितारं त आगन्त्वमङ्ग शक्र वस्व आ शको नः ॥
verses.rom:
esha stomo achikradadvrisha ta uta stamurmaghavannakrapishta |
rayaskamo jaritaram ta agantvamanga shakra vasva a shako nah ||
verses.en:
To thee the mighty hymn hath clamoured loudly, and, Maghavan, the eloquent hath besought thee.
Desire of wealth hath come upon thy singer: help us then, Sakra, to our share of riches.

verses.sa:
स न इन्द्र त्वयताया इषे धास्त्मना च ये मघवानो जुनन्ति ।
वस्वी षु ते जरित्रे अस्तु शक्तिर्यूयं पात स्वस्तिभिः सदा नः ॥
verses.rom:
sa na indra tvayataya ishe dhastmana cha ye maghavano junanti |
vasvi shu te jaritre astu shaktiryuyam pata svastibhih sada nah ||
verses.en:
Place us by food which thou hast given, O Indra, us and the wealthy patrons who command us.
Let thy great power bring good to him who lauds thee. Ye Gods, preserve us evermore with blessings.

verses.sa:
असावि देवं गोऋजीकमन्धो न्यस्मिन्निन्द्रो जनुषेमुवोच ।
बोधामसि त्वा हर्यश्व यज्ञैर्बोधा न स्तोममन्धसो मदेषु ॥
verses.rom:
asavi devam gorijikamandho nyasminnindro janushemuvocha |
bodhamasi tva haryashva yajnairbodha na stomamandhaso madeshu ||
verses.en:
