PRESSED is the juice divine with milk commingled: thereto hath Indra ever been accustomed.
We wake thee, Lord of Bays, with sacrifices: mark this our laud in the wild joy of Soma.

verses.sa:
प्र यन्ति यज्ञं विपयन्ति बर्हिः सोममादो विदथे दुध्रवाचः ।
न्यु भ्रियन्ते यशसो गृभादा दूरउपब्दो वृषणो नृषाचः ॥
verses.rom:
pra yanti yajnam vipayanti barhih somamado vidathe dudhravachah |
nyu bhriyante yashaso gribhada duraupabdo vrishano nrishachah ||
verses.en:
On to the rite they move, the grass they scatter, these Soma-drinkers eloquent in synod.
Hither, for men to grasp, are brought the press-stones, far-thundering, famous, strong, that wait on heroes.

verses.sa:
त्वमिन्द्र स्रवितवा अपस्कः परिष्ठिता अहिना शूर पूर्वीः ।
त्वद्वावक्रे रथ्यो न धेना रेजन्ते विश्वा कृत्रिमाणि भीषा ॥
verses.rom:
tvamindra sravitava apaskah parishthita ahina shura purvih |
tvadvavakre rathyo na dhena rejante vishva kritrimani bhisha ||
verses.en:
Indra, thou settest free the many waters that were encompassed, Hero, by the Dragon.
Down rolled, as if on chariots borne, the rivers: through fear of thee all things created tremble.

verses.sa:
भीमो विवेषायुधेभिरेषामपांसि विश्वा नर्याणि विद्वान् ।
इन्द्रः पुरो जर्हृषाणो वि दूधोद्वि वज्रहस्तो महिना जघान ॥
verses.rom:
bhimo viveshayudhebhireshamapamsi vishva naryani vidvan |
indrah puro jarhrishano vi dudhodvi vajrahasto mahina jaghana ||
verses.en:
Skilled in all manly deeds the God terrific hath with his weapons mastered these opponents.
Indra in rapturous joy shook down their castles he slew them in his might, the Thunder-wielder.

verses.sa:
न यातव इन्द्र जूजुवुर्नो न वन्दना शविष्ठ वेद्याभिः ।
स शर्धदर्यो विषुणस्य जन्तोर्मा शिश्नदेवा अपि गुरृतं नः ॥
verses.rom:
na yatava indra jujuvurno na vandana shavishtha vedyabhih |
sa shardhadaryo vishunasya jantorma shishnadeva api gurritam nah ||
verses.en:
No evil spirits have impelled us, Indra, nor fiends, O Mightiest God, with their devices.
Let our true God subdue the hostile rabble: let not the lewd approach our holy worship.

verses.sa:
अभि क्रत्वेन्द्र भूरध ज्मन्न ते विव्यङ्महिमानं रजांसि ।
स्वेना हि वृत्रं शवसा जघन्थ न शत्रुरन्तं विविदद्युधा ते ॥
verses.rom:
abhi kratvendra bhuradha jmanna te vivyanmahimanam rajamsi |
svena hi vritram shavasa jaghantha na shatrurantam vividadyudha te ||
verses.en:
Thou in thy strength surpassest Earth and Heaven: the regions comprehend not all thy greatness.
With thine own power and might thou slewest Vrtra: no foe hath found the end of thee in battle.

verses.sa:
देवाश्चित्ते असुर्याय पूर्वेऽनु क्षत्राय ममिरे सहांसि ।
इन्द्रो मघानि दयते विषह्येन्द्रं वाजस्य जोहुवन्त सातौ ॥
verses.rom:
devashchitte asuryaya purve'nu kshatraya mamire sahamsi |
indro maghani dayate vishahyendram vajasya johuvanta satau ||
verses.en:
Even the earlier Deities submitted their powers to thy supreme divine dominion.
Indra wins wealth and deals it out to other's: men in the strife for booty call on Indra.

verses.sa:
कीरिश्चिद्धि त्वामवसे जुहावेशानमिन्द्र सौभगस्य भूरेः ।
अवो बभूथ शतमूते अस्मे अभिक्षत्तुस्त्वावतो वरूता ॥
verses.rom:
kirishchiddhi tvamavase juhaveshanamindra saubhagasya bhureh |
avo babhutha shatamute asme abhikshattustvavato varuta ||
verses.en:
The humble hath invoked thee for protection, thee, Lord of great felicity, O Indra.
Thou with a hundred aids hast been our Helper: one who brings gifts like thee hath his defender.

verses.sa:
सखायस्त इन्द्र विश्वह स्याम नमोवृधासो महिना तरुत्र ।
वन्वन्तु स्मा तेऽवसा समीकेऽभीतिमर्यो वनुषां शवांसि ॥
verses.rom:
sakhayasta indra vishvaha syama namovridhaso mahina tarutra |
vanvantu sma te'vasa samike'bhitimaryo vanusham shavamsi ||
verses.en:
May we, O Indra, be thy friends for ever, eagerly, Conqueror, yielding greater homage.
May, through thy grace, the strength of us who battle quell in the shock the onset of the foeman.

verses.sa:
स न इन्द्र त्वयताया इषे धास्त्मना च ये मघवानो जुनन्ति ।
वस्वी षु ते जरित्रे अस्तु शक्तिर्यूयं पात स्वस्तिभिः सदा नः ॥
verses.rom:
sa na indra tvayataya ishe dhastmana cha ye maghavano junanti |
vasvi shu te jaritre astu shaktiryuyam pata svastibhih sada nah ||
verses.en:
Place us by food which thou hast given, O Indra, us and the wealthy patrons who command us.
Let thy great power bring good to him who lauds thee. Ye Gods, preserve us evermore with blessings.

verses.sa:
पिबा सोममिन्द्र मन्दतु त्वा यं ते सुषाव हर्यश्वाद्रिः ।
सोतुर्बाहुभ्यां सुयतो नार्वा ॥
verses.rom:
piba somamindra mandatu tva yam te sushava haryashvadrih |
soturbahubhyam suyato narva ||
verses.en:
DRINK Soma, Lord of Bays, and let it cheer thee: Indra, the stone, like a well guided courser,
Directed by the presser's arms hath pressed it.

verses.sa:
यस्ते मदो युज्यश्चारुरस्ति येन वृत्राणि हर्यश्व हंसि ।
स त्वामिन्द्र प्रभूवसो ममत्तु ॥
verses.rom:
yaste mado yujyashcharurasti yena vritrani haryashva hamsi |
sa tvamindra prabhuvaso mamattu ||
verses.en:
So let the draught of joy, thy dear companion, by which, O Lord of Bays, thou slayest foemen,
Delight thee, Indra, Lord of princely treasures.

verses.sa:
बोधा सु मे मघवन्वाचमेमां यां ते वसिष्ठो अर्चति प्रशस्तिम् ।
इमा ब्रह्म सधमादे जुषस्व ॥
verses.rom:
bodha su me maghavanvachamemam yam te vasishtho archati prashastim |
ima brahma sadhamade jushasva ||
verses.en:
Mark closely, Maghavan, the words I utter, this eulogy recited by Vasistha:
Accept the prayers I offer at thy banquet.

verses.sa:
श्रुधी हवं विपिपानस्याद्रेर्बोधा विप्रस्यार्चतो मनीषाम् ।
कृष्वा दुवांस्यन्तमा सचेमा ॥
verses.rom:
shrudhi havam vipipanasyadrerbodha viprasyarchato manisham |
krishva duvamsyantama sachema ||
verses.en:
Hear thou the call of the juice-drinking press-stone: hear thou the Brahman's hymn who sings and lauds thee.
Take to thine inmost self these adorations.

verses.sa:
न ते गिरो अपि मृष्ये तुरस्य न सुष्टुतिमसुर्यस्य विद्वान् ।
सदा ते नाम स्वयशो विवक्मि ॥
verses.rom:
na te giro api mrishye turasya na sushtutimasuryasya vidvan |
sada te nama svayasho vivakmi ||
verses.en:
I know and ne'er forget the hymns and praises of thee, the Conqueror, and thy strength immortal.
Thy name I ever utter. Self-Refulgent

verses.sa:
भूरि हि ते सवना मानुषेषु भूरि मनीषी हवते त्वामित् ।
मारे अस्मन्मघवञ्ज्योक्कः ॥
verses.rom:
bhuri hi te savana manusheshu bhuri manishi havate tvamit |
mare asmanmaghavanjyokkah ||
verses.en:
Among mankind many are thy libations, and many a time the pious sage invokes thee.
O Maghavan, be not long distant from us.

verses.sa:
तुभ्येदिमा सवना शूर विश्वा तुभ्यं ब्रह्माणि वर्धना कृणोमि ।
त्वं नृभिर्हव्यो विश्वधासि ॥
verses.rom:
tubhyedima savana shura vishva tubhyam brahmani vardhana krinomi |
tvam nribhirhavyo vishvadhasi ||
verses.en:
All these libations are for thee, O Hero: to thee I offer these my prayers. that strengthen.
Ever, in every place, must men invoke thee.

verses.sa:
नू चिन्नु ते मन्यमानस्य दस्मोदश्नुवन्ति महिमानमुग्र ।
न वीर्यमिन्द्र ते न राधः ॥
verses.rom:
nu chinnu te manyamanasya dasmodashnuvanti mahimanamugra |
na viryamindra te na radhah ||
verses.en:
Never do men attain, O Wonder-Worker, thy greatness, Mighty One, who must be lauded,
Nor, Indra, thine heroic power and bounty.

verses.sa:
ये च पूर्व ऋषयो ये च नूत्ना इन्द्र ब्रह्माणि जनयन्त विप्राः ।
अस्मे ते सन्तु सख्या शिवानि यूयं पात स्वस्तिभिः सदा नः ॥
verses.rom:
ye cha purva rishayo ye cha nutna indra brahmani janayanta viprah |
asme te santu sakhya shivani yuyam pata svastibhih sada nah ||
verses.en:
Among all Rsis, Indra, old and recent, who have engendered hymns as sacred singers,
Even with us be thine auspicious friendships. Ye Gods, preserve us evermore with blessings.

verses.sa:
उदु ब्रह्माण्यैरत श्रवस्येन्द्रं समर्ये महया वसिष्ठ ।
आ यो विश्वानि शवसा ततानोपश्रोता म ईवतो वचांसि ॥
verses.rom:
udu brahmanyairata shravasyendram samarye mahaya vasishtha |
a yo vishvani shavasa tatanopashrota ma ivato vachamsi ||
verses.en:
PRAYERS have been offered up through love of glory: Vasistha, honour Indra in the battle.
He who with might extends through all existence hears words which I, his faithful servant, utter.

verses.sa:
अयामि घोष इन्द्र देवजामिरिरज्यन्त यच्छुरुधो विवाचि ।
नहि स्वमायुश्चिकिते जनेषु तानीदंहांस्यति पर्ष्यस्मान् ॥
verses.rom:
ayami ghosha indra devajamirirajyanta yachchhurudho vivachi |
nahi svamayushchikite janeshu tanidamhamsyati parshyasman ||
verses.en:
A cry was raised which reached the Gods, O Indra, a cry to them to send us strength in combat.
None among men knows his own life's duration: bear us in safety over these our troubles.

verses.sa:
युजे रथं गवेषणं हरिभ्यामुप ब्रह्माणि जुजुषाणमस्थुः ।
वि बाधिष्ट स्य रोदसी महित्वेन्द्रो वृत्राण्यप्रती जघन्वान् ॥
verses.rom:
yuje ratham gaveshanam haribhyamupa brahmani jujushanamasthuh |
vi badhishta sya rodasi mahitvendro vritranyaprati jaghanvan ||
verses.en:
The Bays, the booty-seeking car I harness: my prayers have reached him who accepts them gladly.
Indra, when he had slain resistless foemen, forced with his might the two world-halves asunder.

verses.sa:
आपश्चित्पिप्यु स्तर्यो न गावो नक्षन्नृतं जरितारस्त इन्द्र ।
याहि वायुर्न नियुतो नो अच्छा त्वं हि धीभिर्दयसे वि वाजान् ॥
verses.rom:
apashchitpipyu staryo na gavo nakshannritam jaritarasta indra |
yahi vayurna niyuto no achchha tvam hi dhibhirdayase vi vajan ||
verses.en:
Like barren cows, moreover, swelled the waters: the singers sought thy holy rite, O Indra.
Come unto us as with his team comes Vayu: thou, through our solemn hymns bestowest booty.

verses.sa:
ते त्वा मदा इन्द्र मादयन्तु शुष्मिणं तुविराधसं जरित्रे ।
एको देवत्रा दयसे हि मर्तानस्मिञ्छूर सवने मादयस्व ॥
verses.rom:
te tva mada indra madayantu shushminam tuviradhasam jaritre |
eko devatra dayase hi martanasminchhura savane madayasva ||
verses.en:
So may these gladdening draughts rejoice thee, Indra, the Mighty, very bounteous to the singer.
Alone among the Gods thou pitiest mortals: O Hero, make thee glad at this libation.

verses.sa:
एवेदिन्द्रं वृषणं वज्रबाहुं वसिष्ठासो अभ्यर्चन्त्यर्कैः ।
स न स्तुतो वीरवद्धातु गोमद्यूयं पात स्वस्तिभिः सदा नः ॥
verses.rom:
evedindram vrishanam vajrabahum vasishthaso abhyarchantyarkaih |
sa na stuto viravaddhatu gomadyuyam pata svastibhih sada nah ||
verses.en:
Thus the Vasisthas glorify with praises Indra, the Powerful whose arm wields thunder.
Praised, may he guard our wealth in kine and heroes. Ye Gods, preserve us evermore with blessings.

verses.sa:
योनिष्ट इन्द्र सदने अकारि तमा नृभिः पुरुहूत प्र याहि ।
असो यथा नोऽविता वृधे च ददो वसूनि ममदश्च सोमैः ॥
verses.rom:
yonishta indra sadane akari tama nribhih puruhuta pra yahi |
aso yatha no'vita vridhe cha dado vasuni mamadashcha somaih ||
verses.en:
A HOME is made for thee to dwell in, Indra: O Much-invoked, go thitherwith the heroes.
That thou, to prosper us, mayst be our Helper, vouchsafe us wealth, rejoice with draughts of Soma.

verses.sa:
गृभीतं ते मन इन्द्र द्विबर्हाः सुतः सोमः परिषिक्ता मधूनि ।
विसृष्टधेना भरते सुवृक्तिरियमिन्द्रं जोहुवती मनीषा ॥
verses.rom:
gribhitam te mana indra dvibarhah sutah somah parishikta madhuni |
visrishtadhena bharate suvriktiriyamindram johuvati manisha ||
verses.en:
Indra, thy wish, twice-strong, is comprehended: pressed is the Soma, poured are pleasant juices.
This hymn of praise, from loosened tongue, made perfect, draws Indra to itself with loud invoking.

verses.sa:
आ नो दिव आ पृथिव्या ऋजीषिन्निदं बर्हिः सोमपेयाय याहि ।
वहन्तु त्वा हरयो मद्र्यञ्चमाङ्गूषमच्छा तवसं मदाय ॥
verses.rom:
a no diva a prithivya rijishinnidam barhih somapeyaya yahi |
vahantu tva harayo madryanchamangushamachchha tavasam madaya ||
verses.en:
Come, thou Impetuous; God, from earth or heaven; come to our holy grass to drink the Soma.
Hither to me let thy Bay Horses bring thee to listen to our hymns and make thee joyful.

verses.sa:
आ नो विश्वाभिरूतिभिः सजोषा ब्रह्म जुषाणो हर्यश्व याहि ।
वरीवृजत्स्थविरेभिः सुशिप्रास्मे दधद्वृषणं शुष्ममिन्द्र ॥
verses.rom:
a no vishvabhirutibhih sajosha brahma jushano haryashva yahi |
varivrijatsthavirebhih sushiprasme dadhadvrishanam shushmamindra ||
verses.en:
Come unto us with all thine aids, accordant, Lord of Bay Steeds, accepting our devotions,
Fair-helmeted, o'ercoming with the mighty, and lending us the strength of bulls, O Indra.

verses.sa:
एष स्तोमो मह उग्राय वाहे धुरीवात्यो न वाजयन्नधायि ।
इन्द्र त्वायमर्क ईट्टे वसूनां दिवीव द्यामधि नः श्रोमतं धाः ॥
verses.rom:
esha stomo maha ugraya vahe dhurivatyo na vajayannadhayi |
indra tvayamarka itte vasunam diviva dyamadhi nah shromatam dhah ||
verses.en:
As to the chariot pole a vigorous courser, this laud is brought to the great strong Upholder.
This hymn solicits wealth of thee: in heaven, as 'twere above the sky, set thou our glory.

verses.sa:
एवा न इन्द्र वार्यस्य पूर्धि प्र ते महीं सुमतिं वेविदाम ।
इषं पिन्व मघवद्भ्यः सुवीरां यूयं पात स्वस्तिभिः सदा नः ॥
verses.rom:
eva na indra varyasya purdhi pra te mahim sumatim vevidama |
isham pinva maghavadbhyah suviram yuyam pata svastibhih sada nah ||
verses.en:
With precious things. O Indra, thus content us: may we attain to thine exalted favour.
Send our chiefs plenteous food with hero children. Preserve us evermore, ye Gods, with blessings.

verses.sa:
आ ते मह इन्द्रोत्युग्र समन्यवो यत्समरन्त सेनाः ।
पताति दिद्युन्नर्यस्य बाह्वोर्मा ते मनो विष्वद्र्यग्वि चारीत् ॥
verses.rom:
a te maha indrotyugra samanyavo yatsamaranta senah |
patati didyunnaryasya bahvorma te mano vishvadryagvi charit ||
verses.en:
WHEN with thy mighty help, O potent Indra, the armies rush together in their fury.
When from the strong man's arm the lightning flieth, let not the mind go forth to side with others.

verses.sa:
नि दुर्ग इन्द्र श्नथिह्यमित्राँ अभि ये नो मर्तासो अमन्ति ।
आरे तं शंसं कृणुहि निनित्सोरा नो भर सम्भरणं वसूनाम् ॥
verses.rom:
ni durga indra shnathihyamitran abhi ye no martaso amanti |
are tam shamsam krinuhi ninitsora no bhara sambharanam vasunam ||
verses.en:
O Indra, where the ground is hard to traverse, smite down our foes, the mortals who assail us,
Keep far from us the curse of the reviler: bring us accumulated store of treasures.

verses.sa:
शतं ते शिप्रिन्नूतयः सुदासे सहस्रं शंसा उत रातिरस्तु ।
जहि वधर्वनुषो मर्त्यस्यास्मे द्युम्नमधि रत्नं च धेहि ॥
verses.rom:
shatam te shiprinnutayah sudase sahasram shamsa uta ratirastu |
jahi vadharvanusho martyasyasme dyumnamadhi ratnam cha dhehi ||
verses.en:
God of the fair helm, give Sudas a hundred succours, a thousand blessings, and thy bounty.
Strike down the weapon of our mortal foeman: bestow upon us splendid fame and riches.

verses.sa:
त्वावतो हीन्द्र क्रत्वे अस्मि त्वावतोऽवितुः शूर रातौ ।
विश्वेदहानि तविषीव उग्रँ ओकः कृणुष्व हरिवो न मर्धीः ॥
verses.rom:
tvavato hindra kratve asmi tvavato'vituh shura ratau |
vishvedahani tavishiva ugran okah krinushva harivo na mardhih ||
verses.en:
I wait the power of one like thee, O Indra, gifts of a Helper such as thou art, Hero.
Strong, Mighty God, dwell with me now and ever: Lord of Bay Horses, do not thou desert us.

verses.sa:
कुत्सा एते हर्यश्वाय शूषमिन्द्रे सहो देवजूतमियानाः ।
सत्रा कृधि सुहना शूर वृत्रा वयं तरुत्राः सनुयाम वाजम् ॥
verses.rom:
kutsa ete haryashvaya shushamindre saho devajutamiyanah |
satra kridhi suhana shura vritra vayam tarutrah sanuyama vajam ||
verses.en:
Here are the Kutsas supplicating Indra for might, the Lord of Bays for God-sent conquest.
Make our foes ever easy to be vanquished: may we, victorious, win the spoil, O Hero.

verses.sa:
एवा न इन्द्र वार्यस्य पूर्धि प्र ते महीं सुमतिं वेविदाम ।
इषं पिन्व मघवद्भ्यः सुवीरां यूयं पात स्वस्तिभिः सदा नः ॥
verses.rom:
eva na indra varyasya purdhi pra te mahim sumatim vevidama |
isham pinva maghavadbhyah suviram yuyam pata svastibhih sada nah ||
verses.en:
With precious things, O Indra, thus content us: may we attain to thine exalted favour.
Send our chiefs plenteous food with hero children. Preserve us evermore, ye Gods, with blessings.

verses.sa:
न सोम इन्द्रमसुतो ममाद नाब्रह्माणो मघवानं सुतासः ।
तस्मा उक्थं जनये यज्जुजोषन्नृवन्नवीयः शृणवद्यथा नः ॥
verses.rom:
na soma indramasuto mamada nabrahmano maghavanam sutasah |
tasma uktham janaye yajjujoshannrivannaviyah shrinavadyatha nah ||
verses.en:
SOMA unpressed ne'er gladdened liberal Indra, no juices pressed without a prayer have pleased him.
I generate a laud that shall delight him, new and heroic, so that he may hear us.

verses.sa:
उक्थौक्थे सोम इन्द्रं ममाद नीथेनीथे मघवानं सुतासः ।
यदीं सबाधः पितरं न पुत्राः समानदक्षा अवसे हवन्ते ॥
verses.rom:
ukthaukthe soma indram mamada nithenithe maghavanam sutasah |
yadim sabadhah pitaram na putrah samanadaksha avase havante ||
verses.en:
At every laud the Soma gladdens Indra: pressed juices please him as each psalm is chanted,
What time the priests with one united effort call him to aid, as sons invoke their father.

verses.sa:
चकार ता कृणवन्नूनमन्या यानि ब्रुवन्ति वेधसः सुतेषु ।
जनीरिव पतिरेकः समानो नि मामृजे पुर इन्द्रः सु सर्वाः ॥
verses.rom:
chakara ta krinavannunamanya yani bruvanti vedhasah suteshu |
janiriva patirekah samano ni mamrije pura indrah su sarvah ||
verses.en:
These deeds he did; let him achieve new exploits, such as the priests declare at their libations.
Indra hath taken and possessed all castles, like as one common husband doth his spouses.

verses.sa:
एवा तमाहुरुत शृण्व इन्द्र एको विभक्ता तरणिर्मघानाम् ।
मिथस्तुर ऊतयो यस्य पूर्वीरस्मे भद्राणि सश्चत प्रियाणि ॥
verses.rom:
eva tamahuruta shrinva indra eko vibhakta taranirmaghanam |
mithastura utayo yasya purvirasme bhadrani sashchata priyani ||
verses.en:
Even thus have they declared him. Famed is Indra as Conqueror, sole distributer of treasures;
Whose many succours come in close succession. May dear delightful benefits attend us.

verses.sa:
एवा वसिष्ठ इन्द्रमूतये नॄन्कृष्टीनां वृषभं सुते गृणाति ।
सहस्रिण उप नो माहि वाजान्यूयं पात स्वस्तिभिः सदा नः ॥
verses.rom:
eva vasishtha indramutaye nrinkrishtinam vrishabham sute grinati |
sahasrina upa no mahi vajanyuyam pata svastibhih sada nah ||
verses.en:
Thus, to bring help to men, Vasistha laudeth Indra, the peoples' Hero, at libation.
Bestow upon us strength and wealth in thousands. Preserve us evermore, ye Gods, with blessings.

verses.sa:
इन्द्रं नरो नेमधिता हवन्ते यत्पार्या युनजते धियस्ताः ।
शूरो नृषाता शवसश्चकान आ गोमति व्रजे भजा त्वं नः ॥
verses.rom:
indram naro nemadhita havante yatparya yunajate dhiyastah |
shuro nrishata shavasashchakana a gomati vraje bhaja tvam nah ||
verses.en:
MEN call on Indra in the armed encounter that he may make the hymns they sing decisive.
Hero, rejoicing in thy might, in combat give us a portion of the stall of cattle,

verses.sa:
य इन्द्र शुष्मो मघवन्ते अस्ति शिक्षा सखिभ्यः पुरुहूत नृभ्यः ।
त्वं हि दृळ्हा मघवन्विचेता अपा वृधि परिवृतं न राधः ॥
verses.rom:
ya indra shushmo maghavante asti shiksha sakhibhyah puruhuta nribhyah |
tvam hi drilha maghavanvicheta apa vridhi parivritam na radhah ||
verses.en:
Grant, Indra Maghavan, invoked of many, to these my friends the strength which thou possessest.
Thou, Maghavan, hast rent strong places open: unclose for us, Wise God, thy hidden bounty.

verses.sa:
इन्द्रो राजा जगतश्चर्षणीनामधि क्षमि विषुरूपं यदस्ति ।
ततो ददाति दाशुषे वसूनि चोदद्राध उपस्तुतश्चिदर्वाक् ॥
verses.rom:
indro raja jagatashcharshaninamadhi kshami vishurupam yadasti |
tato dadati dashushe vasuni chodadradha upastutashchidarvak ||
verses.en:
King of the living world, of men, is Indra, of all in varied form that earth containeth.
Thence to the worshipper he giveth riches: may he enrich us also when we laud him.

verses.sa:
नू चिन्न इन्द्रो मघवा सहूती दानो वाजं नि यमते न ऊती ।
अनूना यस्य दक्षिणा पीपाय वामं नृभ्यो अभिवीता सखिभ्यः ॥
verses.rom:
nu chinna indro maghava sahuti dano vajam ni yamate na uti |
anuna yasya dakshina pipaya vamam nribhyo abhivita sakhibhyah ||
verses.en:
Maghavan Indra, when we all invoke him, bountiful ever sendeth strength to aid us:
Whose perfect guerdon, never failing, bringeth wealth to the men, to friends the thing they covet.

verses.sa:
नू इन्द्र राये वरिवस्कृधी न आ ते मनो ववृत्याम मघाय ।
गोमदश्वावद्रथवद्व्यन्तो यूयं पात स्वस्तिभिः सदा नः ॥
verses.rom:
nu indra raye varivaskridhi na a te mano vavrityama maghaya |
gomadashvavadrathavadvyanto yuyam pata svastibhih sada nah ||
verses.en:
Quick, Indra, give us room and way to riches, and let us bring thy mind to grant us treasures,
That we may win us cars and Steeds and cattle. Preserve us evermore, ye Gods, with blessings.

verses.sa:
ब्रह्मा ण इन्द्रोप याहि विद्वानर्वाञ्चस्ते हरयः सन्तु युक्ताः ।
विश्वे चिद्धि त्वा विहवन्त मर्ता अस्माकमिच्छृणुहि विश्वमिन्व ॥
verses.rom:
brahma na indropa yahi vidvanarvanchaste harayah santu yuktah |
vishve chiddhi tva vihavanta marta asmakamichchhrinuhi vishvaminva ||
verses.en:
COME to our prayers, O Indra, thou who knowest: let thy Bay Steeds be yoked and guided hither.
Though mortal men on every side invoke thee, still give thine ear to us, O All-impeller.

verses.sa:
हवं त इन्द्र महिमा व्यानड्ब्रह्म यत्पासि शवसिन्नृषीणाम् ।
आ यद्वज्रं दधिषे हस्त उग्र घोरः सन्क्रत्वा जनिष्ठा अषाळ्हः ॥
verses.rom:
havam ta indra mahima vyanadbrahma yatpasi shavasinnrishinam |
a yadvajram dadhishe hasta ugra ghorah sankratva janishtha ashalhah ||
verses.en:
Thy greatness reacheth to our invocation, the sages' prayer which, Potent God, thou guardest.
What time thy hand, O Mighty, holds the thunder, awful in strength thou hast become resistless.

verses.sa:
तव प्रणीतीन्द्र जोहुवानान्सं यन्नॄन्न रोदसी निनेथ ।
महे क्षत्राय शवसे हि जज्ञेऽतूतुजिं चित्तूतुजिरशिश्नत् ॥
verses.rom:
tava pranitindra johuvanansam yannrinna rodasi ninetha |
mahe kshatraya shavase hi jajne'tutujim chittutujirashishnat ||
verses.en:
What time thou drewest both world-halves together, like heroes led by thee who call each other-
For thou wast born for strength and high dominion-then e'en the active overthrew the sluggish.

verses.sa:
एभिर्न इन्द्राहभिर्दशस्य दुर्मित्रासो हि क्षितयः पवन्ते ।
प्रति यच्चष्टे अनृतमनेना अव द्विता वरुणो मायी नः सात् ॥
verses.rom:
ebhirna indrahabhirdashasya durmitraso hi kshitayah pavante |
prati yachchashte anritamanena ava dvita varuno mayi nah sat ||
verses.en:
Honour us in these present days, O Indra, for hostile men are making expiation.
Our sin that sinless Varuna discovered, the Wondrous-Wise hath long ago forgiven.

verses.sa:
वोचेमेदिन्द्रं मघवानमेनं महो रायो राधसो यद्ददन्नः ।
यो अर्चतो ब्रह्मकृतिमविष्ठो यूयं पात स्वस्तिभिः सदा नः ॥
verses.rom:
vochemedindram maghavanamenam maho rayo radhaso yaddadannah |
yo archato brahmakritimavishtho yuyam pata svastibhih sada nah ||
verses.en:
We will address this liberal Lord, this Indra, that he may grant us gifts of ample riches,
Best favourer of the singer's prayer and praises. Preserve us evermore, ye Gods, with blessings.

verses.sa:
अयं सोम इन्द्र तुभ्यं सुन्व आ तु प्र याहि हरिवस्तदोकाः ।
पिबा त्वस्य सुषुतस्य चारोर्ददो मघानि मघवन्नियानः ॥
verses.rom:
ayam soma indra tubhyam sunva a tu pra yahi harivastadokah |
piba tvasya sushutasya charordado maghani maghavanniyanah ||
verses.en:
THIS Soma hath been pressed for thee, O Indra: come hither, Lord of Bays, for this thou lovest.
Drink of this fair, this well-effused libation: Maghavan, give us wealth when we implore thee.

verses.sa:
ब्रह्मन्वीर ब्रह्मकृतिं जुषाणोऽर्वाचीनो हरिभिर्याहि तूयम् ।
अस्मिन्नू षु सवने मादयस्वोप ब्रह्माणि शृणव इमा नः ॥
verses.rom:
brahmanvira brahmakritim jushano'rvachino haribhiryahi tuyam |
asminnu shu savane madayasvopa brahmani shrinava ima nah ||
verses.en:
Come to us quickly with thy Bay Steeds, Hero, come to our prayer, accepting our devotion.
Enjoy thyself aright at this libation, and listen thou unto the prayers we offer.

verses.sa:
का ते अस्त्यरंकृतिः सूक्तैः कदा नूनं ते मघवन्दाशेम ।
विश्वा मतीरा ततने त्वायाधा म इन्द्र शृणवो हवेमा ॥
verses.rom:
ka te astyaramkritih suktaih kada nunam te maghavandashema |
vishva matira tatane tvayadha ma indra shrinavo havema ||
verses.en:
What satisfaction do our hymns afford thee? When, Maghavan? Now let us do thee service.
Hymns, only hymns, with love for thee, I weave thee: then hear, O Indra, these mine invocations.

verses.sa:
उतो घा ते पुरुष्या इदासन्येषां पूर्वेषामशृणोरृषीणाम् ।
अधाहं त्वा मघवञ्जोहवीमि त्वं न इन्द्रासि प्रमतिः पितेव ॥
verses.rom:
uto gha te purushya idasanyesham purveshamashrinorrishinam |
adhaham tva maghavanjohavimi tvam na indrasi pramatih piteva ||
verses.en:
They, verily, were also human beings whom thou wast wont to hear, those earlier sages.
Hence I, O Indra Maghavan, invoke thee: thou art our Providence, even as a Father.

verses.sa:
वोचेमेदिन्द्रं मघवानमेनं महो रायो राधसो यद्ददन्नः ।
यो अर्चतो ब्रह्मकृतिमविष्ठो यूयं पात स्वस्तिभिः सदा नः ॥
verses.rom:
vochemedindram maghavanamenam maho rayo radhaso yaddadannah |
yo archato brahmakritimavishtho yuyam pata svastibhih sada nah ||
verses.en:
We will address this liberal Lord, this Indra, that he may grant us gifts of ample riches,
Best favourer of the singer's prayer and praises. Preserve us evermore, ye Gods, with blessings.

verses.sa:
आ नो देव शवसा याहि शुष्मिन्भवा वृध इन्द्र रायो अस्य ।
महे नृम्णाय नृपते सुवज्र महि क्षत्राय पौंस्याय शूर ॥
verses.rom:
a no deva shavasa yahi shushminbhava vridha indra rayo asya |
mahe nrimnaya nripate suvajra mahi kshatraya paumsyaya shura ||
verses.en:
WITH power and strength, O Mighty God, approach us: be the augmenter, Indra, of these riches;
Strong Thunderer, Lord of men, for potent valour, for manly exploit and for high dominion.

verses.sa:
हवन्त उ त्वा हव्यं विवाचि तनूषु शूराः सूर्यस्य सातौ ।
त्वं विश्वेषु सेन्यो जनेषु त्वं वृत्राणि रन्धया सुहन्तु ॥
verses.rom:
havanta u tva havyam vivachi tanushu shurah suryasya satau |
tvam vishveshu senyo janeshu tvam vritrani randhaya suhantu ||
verses.en:
Thee, worth invoking, in the din of battle, heroes invoke in fray for life and sunlight.
Among all people thou art foremost fighter: give up our enemies to easy slaughter.

verses.sa:
अहा यदिन्द्र सुदिना व्युच्छान्दधो यत्केतुमुपमं समत्सु ।
न्यग्निः सीददसुरो न होता हुवानो अत्र सुभगाय देवान् ॥
verses.rom:
aha yadindra sudina vyuchchhandadho yatketumupamam samatsu |
nyagnih sidadasuro na hota huvano atra subhagaya devan ||
verses.en:
When fair bright days shall dawn on us, O Indra, and thou shalt bring thy banner near in battle,
Agni the Asura shall sit as Herald, calling Gods hither for our great good fortune.

verses.sa:
वयं ते त इन्द्र ये च देव स्तवन्त शूर ददतो मघानि ।
यच्छा सूरिभ्य उपमं वरूथं स्वाभुवो जरणामश्नवन्त ॥
verses.rom:
vayam te ta indra ye cha deva stavanta shura dadato maghani |
yachchha suribhya upamam varutham svabhuvo jaranamashnavanta ||
verses.en:
Thine are we, Indra, thine, both these who praise thee, and those who give rich gifts, O God and Hero.
Grant to our princes excellent protection, may they wax old and still be strong and happy.

verses.sa:
वोचेमेदिन्द्रं मघवानमेनं महो रायो राधसो यद्ददन्नः ।
यो अर्चतो ब्रह्मकृतिमविष्ठो यूयं पात स्वस्तिभिः सदा नः ॥
verses.rom:
vochemedindram maghavanamenam maho rayo radhaso yaddadannah |
yo archato brahmakritimavishtho yuyam pata svastibhih sada nah ||
verses.en:
We will address this liberal Lord, this Indra that he may grant us gifts of ample riches:
Best favourer of the singer's prayer and praises. Preserve us evermore, ye Gods, with blessings.

verses.sa:
प्र व इन्द्राय मादनं हर्यश्वाय गायत ।
सखायः सोमपाव्ने ॥
verses.rom:
pra va indraya madanam haryashvaya gayata |
sakhayah somapavne ||
verses.en:
SING ye a song, to make him glad, to Indra, Lord of Tawny Steeds,
The Soma-drinker, O my friends.

verses.sa:
शंसेदुक्थं सुदानव उत द्युक्षं यथा नरः ।
चकृमा सत्यराधसे ॥
verses.rom:
shamseduktham sudanava uta dyuksham yatha narah |
chakrima satyaradhase ||
verses.en: To him the Bounteous say the laud, and let us glorify, as men May do, the Giver of true gifts.

verses.sa:
त्वं न इन्द्र वाजयुस्त्वं गव्युः शतक्रतो ।
त्वं हिरण्ययुर्वसो ॥
verses.rom:
tvam na indra vajayustvam gavyuh shatakrato |
tvam hiranyayurvaso ||
verses.en:
O Indra, Lord of boundless might, for us thou winnest strength and kine,
Thou winnest gold for us, Good Lord.

verses.sa:
वयमिन्द्र त्वायवोऽभि प्र णोनुमो वृषन् ।
विद्धी त्वस्य नो वसो ॥
verses.rom:
vayamindra tvayavo'bhi pra nonumo vrishan |
viddhi tvasya no vaso ||
verses.en: Faithful to thee we loudly sing, heroic Indra, songs to thee: Mark, O Good Lord, this act of ours.

verses.sa:
मा नो निदे च वक्तवेऽर्यो रन्धीरराव्णे ।
त्वे अपि क्रतुर्मम ॥
verses.rom:
ma no nide cha vaktave'ryo randhiraravne |
tve api kraturmama ||
verses.en: Give us not up to man's reproach, to foeman's hateful calumny: In thee alone is all my strength.

verses.sa:
त्वं वर्मासि सप्रथः पुरोयोधश्च वृत्रहन् ।
त्वया प्रति ब्रुवे युजा ॥
verses.rom:
tvam varmasi saprathah puroyodhashcha vritrahan |
tvaya prati bruve yuja ||
verses.en:
Thou art mine ample coat of mail, my Champion, Vrtra-Slayer, thou:
With thee for Friend I brave the foe.

verses.sa:
महाँ उतासि यस्य तेऽनु स्वधावरी सहः ।
मम्नाते इन्द्र रोदसी ॥
verses.rom:
mahan utasi yasya te'nu svadhavari sahah |
mamnate indra rodasi ||
verses.en:
Yea, great art thou whose conquering might two independent Powers confess.
The Heaven, O India, and the Earth.

verses.sa:
तं त्वा मरुत्वती परि भुवद्वाणी सयावरी ।
नक्षमाणा सह द्युभिः ॥
verses.rom:
tam tva marutvati pari bhuvadvani sayavari |
nakshamana saha dyubhih ||
verses.en:
So let the voice surround thee, which attends the Maruts on their way,
Reaching thee with the rays of light.

verses.sa:
ऊर्ध्वासस्त्वान्विन्दवो भुवन्दस्ममुप द्यवि ।
सं ते नमन्त कृष्टयः ॥
verses.rom:
urdhvasastvanvindavo bhuvandasmamupa dyavi |
sam te namanta krishtayah ||
verses.en:
Let the ascending drops attain to thee, the Wondrous God, in heaven:
Let all the folk bow down to thee.

verses.sa:
प्र वो महे महिवृधे भरध्वं प्रचेतसे प्र सुमतिं कृणुध्वम् ।
विशः पूर्वीः प्र चरा चर्षणिप्राः ॥
verses.rom:
pra vo mahe mahivridhe bharadhvam prachetase pra sumatim krinudhvam |
vishah purvih pra chara charshaniprah ||
verses.en:
Bring to the Wise, the Great, who waxeth mighty, your offerings, and make ready your devotion;
To many clans he goeth, man's controller.

verses.sa:
उरुव्यचसे महिने सुवृक्तिमिन्द्राय ब्रह्म जनयन्त विप्राः ।
तस्य व्रतानि न मिनन्ति धीराः ॥
verses.rom:
uruvyachase mahine suvriktimindraya brahma janayanta viprah |
tasya vratani na minanti dhirah ||
verses.en:
For Indra, the sublime, the far-pervading, have singers generated prayer and praises:
The sages never violate his statutes.

verses.sa:
इन्द्रं वाणीरनुत्तमन्युमेव सत्रा राजानं दधिरे सहध्यै ।
हर्यश्वाय बर्हया समापीन् ॥
verses.rom:
indram vaniranuttamanyumeva satra rajanam dadhire sahadhyai |
haryashvaya barhaya samapin ||
verses.en:
The choirs have stablished Indra King for ever, for victory, him whose anger is resistless:
And, for the Bays' Lord, strengthened those he loveth.

verses.sa:
मो षु त्वा वाघतश्चनारे अस्मन्नि रीरमन् ।
आरात्ताच्चित्सधमादं न आ गहीह वा सन्नुप श्रुधि ॥
verses.rom:
mo shu tva vaghatashchanare asmanni riraman |
arattachchitsadhamadam na a gahiha va sannupa shrudhi ||
verses.en:
LET none, no, not thy worshippers, delay thee far away from us.
Even from far away come thou unto our feast, or listen if already here.

verses.sa:
इमे हि ते ब्रह्मकृतः सुते सचा मधौ न मक्ष आसते ।
इन्द्रे कामं जरितारो वसूयवो रथे न पादमा दधुः ॥
verses.rom:
ime hi te brahmakritah sute sacha madhau na maksha asate |
indre kamam jaritaro vasuyavo rathe na padama dadhuh ||
verses.en:
For here, like flies on honey, these who pray to thee sit by the juice that they have poured.
Wealth-craving singers have on Indra set their hope, as men set foot upon a car.

verses.sa: रायस्कामो वज्रहस्तं सुदक्षिणं पुत्रो न पितरं हुवे ॥
verses.rom: rayaskamo vajrahastam sudakshinam putro na pitaram huve ||
verses.en:
Longing for wealth I call on him, the Thunderer with the strong right hand,
As a son calleth on his sire.

verses.sa:
इम इन्द्राय सुन्विरे सोमासो दध्याशिरः ।
ताँ आ मदाय वज्रहस्त पीतये हरिभ्यां याह्योक आ ॥
verses.rom:
ima indraya sunvire somaso dadhyashirah |
tan a madaya vajrahasta pitaye haribhyam yahyoka a ||
verses.en:
These Soma juices, mixed with curd, have been expressed for Indra here.
Come with thy Bay Steeds, Thunder-wielder, to our home, to drink them till they make thee glad.

verses.sa:
श्रवच्छ्रुत्कर्ण ईयते वसूनां नू चिन्नो मर्धिषद्गिरः ।
सद्यश्चिद्यः सहस्राणि शता ददन्नकिर्दित्सन्तमा मिनत् ॥
verses.rom:
shravachchhrutkarna iyate vasunam nu chinno mardhishadgirah |
sadyashchidyah sahasrani shata dadannakirditsantama minat ||
verses.en:
May he whose ear is open hear us. He is asked for wealth: will he despise our prayer?
Him who bestows at once a hundred thousand gifts none shall restrain when he would give.

verses.sa:
स वीरो अप्रतिष्कुत इन्द्रेण शूशुवे नृभिः ।
यस्ते गभीरा सवनानि वृत्रहन्सुनोत्या च धावति ॥
verses.rom:
sa viro apratishkuta indrena shushuve nribhih |
yaste gabhira savanani vritrahansunotya cha dhavati ||
verses.en:
The hero never checked by men hath gained his strength through Indra, he
Who presses out and pours his deep libations forth, O Vrtra-slayer, unto thee.

verses.sa:
भवा वरूथं मघवन्मघोनां यत्समजासि शर्धतः ।
वि त्वाहतस्य वेदनं भजेमह्या दूणाशो भरा गयम् ॥
verses.rom:
bhava varutham maghavanmaghonam yatsamajasi shardhatah |
vi tvahatasya vedanam bhajemahya dunasho bhara gayam ||
verses.en:
When thou dost drive the fighting men together be, thou Mighty One, the mighty's shield.
May we divide the wealth of him whom thou hast slain: bring us, Unreachable, his goods.

verses.sa:
सुनोता सोमपाव्ने सोममिन्द्राय वज्रिणे ।
पचता पक्तीरवसे कृणुध्वमित्पृणन्नित्पृणते मयः ॥
verses.rom:
sunota somapavne somamindraya vajrine |
pachata paktiravase krinudhvamitprinannitprinate mayah ||
verses.en:
For Indra, Soma-drinker, armed with thunder, press the Soma juice.
Make ready your dressed meats: cause him to favour us. The Giver blesses him who gives.

verses.sa:
मा स्रेधत सोमिनो दक्षता महे कृणुध्वं राय आतुजे ।
तरणिरिज्जयति क्षेति पुष्यति न देवासः कवत्नवे ॥
verses.rom:
ma sredhata somino dakshata mahe krinudhvam raya atuje |
taranirijjayati ksheti pushyati na devasah kavatnave ||
verses.en:
Grudge not, ye Soma pourers; stir you, pay the rites, for wealth, to the great Conqueror.
Only the active conquers dwells in peace, and thrives: not for the niggard are the Gods.

verses.sa:
नकिः सुदासो रथं पर्यास न रीरमत् ।
इन्द्रो यस्याविता यस्य मरुतो गमत्स गोमति व्रजे ॥
verses.rom:
nakih sudaso ratham paryasa na riramat |
indro yasyavita yasya maruto gamatsa gomati vraje ||
verses.en:
No one hath overturned or stayed the car of him who freely gives.
The man whom Indra and the Marut host defend comes to a stable full of kine.

verses.sa:
गमद्वाजं वाजयन्निन्द्र मर्त्यो यस्य त्वमविता भुवः ।
अस्माकं बोध्यविता रथानामस्माकं शूर नृणाम् ॥
verses.rom:
gamadvajam vajayannindra martyo yasya tvamavita bhuvah |
asmakam bodhyavita rathanamasmakam shura nrinam ||
verses.en:
Indra, that man when fighting shall obtain the spoil, whose strong defender thou wilt be.
Be thou the gracious helper, Hero I of our cars, be thou the helper of our men.

verses.sa:
उदिन्न्वस्य रिच्यतेऽंशो धनं न जिग्युषः ।
य इन्द्रो हरिवान्न दभन्ति तं रिपो दक्षं दधाति सोमिनि ॥
verses.rom:
udinnvasya richyate'msho dhanam na jigyushah |
ya indro harivanna dabhanti tam ripo daksham dadhati somini ||
verses.en:
His portion is exceeding great like a victorious soldier's spoil.
Him who is Indra, Lord of Bays, no foes subdue. He gives the Soma-pourer strength.

verses.sa:
मन्त्रमखर्वं सुधितं सुपेशसं दधात यज्ञियेष्वा ।
पूर्वीश्चन प्रसितयस्तरन्ति तं य इन्द्रे कर्मणा भुवत् ॥
verses.rom:
mantramakharvam sudhitam supeshasam dadhata yajniyeshva |
purvishchana prasitayastaranti tam ya indre karmana bhuvat ||
verses.en:
Make for the Holy Gods a hymn that is not mean, but well-arranged and fair of form.
Even many snares and bonds subdue not him who dwells with Indra through his sacrifice.

verses.sa:
कस्तमिन्द्र त्वावसुमा मर्त्यो दधर्षति ।
श्रद्धा इत्ते मघवन्पार्ये दिवि वाजी वाजं सिषासति ॥
verses.rom:
kastamindra tvavasuma martyo dadharshati |
shraddha itte maghavanparye divi vaji vajam sishasati ||
verses.en:
Indra, what mortal will attack the man who hath his wealth in thee?
The strong will win the spoil on the decisive day through faith in thee, O Maghavan.

verses.sa:
मघोनः स्म वृत्रहत्येषु चोदय ये ददति प्रिया वसु ।
तव प्रणीती हर्यश्व सूरिभिर्विश्वा तरेम दुरिता ॥
verses.rom:
maghonah sma vritrahatyeshu chodaya ye dadati priya vasu |
tava praniti haryashva suribhirvishva tarema durita ||
verses.en:
In battles with the foe urge on our mighty ones who give the treasures dear to thee,
And may we with our princes, Lord of Tawny Steeds! pass through all peril, led by thee.

verses.sa:
तवेदिन्द्रावमं वसु त्वं पुष्यसि मध्यमम् ।
सत्रा विश्वस्य परमस्य राजसि नकिष्ट्वा गोषु वृण्वते ॥
verses.rom:
tavedindravamam vasu tvam pushyasi madhyamam |
satra vishvasya paramasya rajasi nakishtva goshu vrinvate ||
verses.en:
Thine, Indra, is the lowest wealth, thou cherishest the mid-most wealth,
Thou ever rulest all the highest: in the fray for cattle none resisteth thee.

verses.sa:
त्वं विश्वस्य धनदा असि श्रुतो य ईं भवन्त्याजयः ।
तवायं विश्वः पुरुहूत पार्थिवोऽवस्युर्नाम भिक्षते ॥
verses.rom:
tvam vishvasya dhanada asi shruto ya im bhavantyajayah |
tavayam vishvah puruhuta parthivo'vasyurnama bhikshate ||
verses.en:
Thou art renowned as giving wealth to every one in all the battles that are fought.
Craving protection, all these people of the earth, O Much-invoked, implore thy name.

verses.sa:
यदिन्द्र यावतस्त्वमेतावदहमीशीय ।
स्तोतारमिद्दिधिषेय रदावसो न पापत्वाय रासीय ॥
verses.rom:
yadindra yavatastvametavadahamishiya |
stotaramiddidhisheya radavaso na papatvaya rasiya ||
verses.en:
If I, O Indra, were the Lord of riches ample as thine own,
I should support the singer, God. who givest wealth! and not abandon him to woe.

verses.sa:
शिक्षेयमिन्महयते दिवेदिवे राय आ कुहचिद्विदे ।
नहि त्वदन्यन्मघवन्न आप्यं वस्यो अस्ति पिता चन ॥
verses.rom:
shiksheyaminmahayate divedive raya a kuhachidvide |
nahi tvadanyanmaghavanna apyam vasyo asti pita chana ||
verses.en:
Each day would I enrich the man who sang my praise, in whatsoever place he were.
No kinship is there better, Maghavan, than thine: a father even is no more.

verses.sa:
तरणिरित्सिषासति वाजं पुरंध्या युजा ।
आ व इन्द्रं पुरुहूतं नमे गिरा नेमिं तष्टेव सुद्र्वम् ॥
verses.rom:
taraniritsishasati vajam puramdhya yuja |
a va indram puruhutam name gira nemim tashteva sudrvam ||
verses.en:
With Plenty for his true ally the active man will gain the spoil.
Your Indra, Much-invoked, I bend with song, as bends a wright his wheel of solid wood.

verses.sa:
न दुष्टुती मर्त्यो विन्दते वसु न स्रेधन्तं रयिर्नशत् ।
सुशक्तिरिन्मघवन्तुभ्यं मावते देष्णं यत्पार्ये दिवि ॥
verses.rom:
na dushtuti martyo vindate vasu na sredhantam rayirnashat |
sushaktirinmaghavantubhyam mavate deshnam yatparye divi ||
verses.en:
A moral wins no riches by unworthy praise: wealth comes not to the niggard churl.
Light is the task to give, O Maghavan, to one like me on the decisive day.

verses.sa:
अभि त्वा शूर नोनुमोऽदुग्धा इव धेनवः ।
ईशानमस्य जगतः स्वर्दृशमीशानमिन्द्र तस्थुषः ॥
verses.rom:
abhi tva shura nonumo'dugdha iva dhenavah |
ishanamasya jagatah svardrishamishanamindra tasthushah ||
verses.en:
Like kine unmilked we call aloud, Hero, to thee, and sing thy praise,
Looker on heavenly light, Lord of this moving world, Lord, Indra, of what moveth not.

verses.sa:
न त्वावाँ अन्यो दिव्यो न पार्थिवो न जातो न जनिष्यते ।
अश्वायन्तो मघवन्निन्द्र वाजिनो गव्यन्तस्त्वा हवामहे ॥
verses.rom:
na tvavan anyo divyo na parthivo na jato na janishyate |
ashvayanto maghavannindra vajino gavyantastva havamahe ||
verses.en:
None other like to thee, of earth or of the heavens, hath been or ever will be born.
Desiring horses, Indra Maghavan! and kine, as men of might we call on thee.

verses.sa:
अभी षतस्तदा भरेन्द्र ज्यायः कनीयसः ।
पुरूवसुर्हि मघवन्सनादसि भरेभरे च हव्यः ॥
verses.rom:
abhi shatastada bharendra jyayah kaniyasah |
puruvasurhi maghavansanadasi bharebhare cha havyah ||
verses.en:
Bring, Indra, the Victorious Ones; bring, elder thou, the younger host.
For, Maghavan, thou art rich in treasures from of old, and must be called in every fight.

verses.sa:
परा णुदस्व मघवन्नमित्रान्सुवेदा नो वसू कृधि ।
अस्माकं बोध्यविता महाधने भवा वृधः सखीनाम् ॥
verses.rom:
para nudasva maghavannamitransuveda no vasu kridhi |
asmakam bodhyavita mahadhane bhava vridhah sakhinam ||
verses.en:
Drive thou away our enemies, O Maghavan: make riches easy to be won.
Be thou our good Protector in the strife for spoil: Cherisher of our friends be thou.

verses.sa:
इन्द्र क्रतुं न आ भर पिता पुत्रेभ्यो यथा ।
शिक्षा णो अस्मिन्पुरुहूत यामनि जीवा ज्योतिरशीमहि ॥
verses.rom:
indra kratum na a bhara pita putrebhyo yatha |
shiksha no asminpuruhuta yamani jiva jyotirashimahi ||
verses.en:
O Indra, give us wisdom as a sire gives wisdom to his sons.
Guide us, O Much-invoked, in this our way may we still live and look upon the light.

verses.sa:
मा नो अज्ञाता वृजना दुराध्यो माशिवासो अव क्रमुः ।
त्वया वयं प्रवतः शश्वतीरपोऽति शूर तरामसि ॥
verses.rom:
ma no ajnata vrijana duradhyo mashivaso ava kramuh |
tvaya vayam pravatah shashvatirapo'ti shura taramasi ||
verses.en:
Grant that no mighty foes, unknown, malevolent, unhallowed, tread us to the ground.
With thine assistance, Hero, may we ass through all the waters that are rul`ng down.

verses.sa:
श्वित्यञ्चो मा दक्षिणतस्कपर्दा धियंजिन्वासो अभि हि प्रमन्दुः ।
उत्तिष्ठन्वोचे परि बर्हिषो नॄन्न मे दूरादवितवे वसिष्ठाः ॥
verses.rom:
shvityancho ma dakshinataskaparda dhiyamjinvaso abhi hi pramanduh |
uttishthanvoche pari barhisho nrinna me duradavitave vasishthah ||
verses.en:
THESE who wear hair-knots on the right, the movers of holy thought, white-robed, have won me over.
I warned the men, when from the grass I raised me, Not from afar can my Vasisthas help you.

verses.sa:
दूरादिन्द्रमनयन्ना सुतेन तिरो वैशन्तमति पान्तमुग्रम् ।
पाशद्युम्नस्य वायतस्य सोमात्सुतादिन्द्रोऽवृणीता वसिष्ठान् ॥
verses.rom:
duradindramanayanna sutena tiro vaishantamati pantamugram |
pashadyumnasya vayatasya somatsutadindro'vrinita vasishthan ||
verses.en:
With soma they brought Indra from a distance, Over Vaisanta, from the strong libation.
Indra preferred Vasisthas to the Soma pressed by the son of Vayata, Pasadyumna.

verses.sa:
एवेन्नु कं सिन्धुमेभिस्ततारेवेन्नु कं भेदमेभिर्जघान ।
एवेन्नु कं दाशराज्ञे सुदासं प्रावदिन्द्रो ब्रह्मणा वो वसिष्ठाः ॥
verses.rom:
evennu kam sindhumebhistatarevennu kam bhedamebhirjaghana |
evennu kam dasharajne sudasam pravadindro brahmana vo vasishthah ||
verses.en:
So, verily, with these he crossed the river, in company with these he slaughtered Bheda.
So in the fight with the Ten Kings, Vasisthas! did Indra help Sudas through your devotions.

verses.sa:
जुष्टी नरो ब्रह्मणा वः पितॄणामक्षमव्ययं न किला रिषाथ ।
यच्छक्वरीषु बृहता रवेणेन्द्रे शुष्ममदधाता वसिष्ठाः ॥
verses.rom:
jushti naro brahmana vah pitrinamakshamavyayam na kila rishatha |
yachchhakvarishu brihata ravenendre shushmamadadhata vasishthah ||
verses.en:
I gladly, men I with prayer prayed by our fathers have fixed your axle: ye shall not be injured:
Since, when ye sang aloud the Sakvari verses, Vasisthas! ye invigorated Indra.

verses.sa:
उद्द्यामिवेत्तृष्णजो नाथितासोऽदीधयुर्दाशराज्ञे वृतासः ।
वसिष्ठस्य स्तुवत इन्द्रो अश्रोदुरुं तृत्सुभ्यो अकृणोदु लोकम् ॥
verses.rom:
uddyamivettrishnajo nathitaso'didhayurdasharajne vritasah |
vasishthasya stuvata indro ashrodurum tritsubhyo akrinodu lokam ||
verses.en:
Like thirsty men they looked to heaven, in battle with the Ten Kings, surrounded and imploring.
Then Indra heard Vasistha as he praised him, and gave the Trtsus ample room and freedom.

verses.sa:
दण्डा इवेद्गोअजनास आसन्परिच्छिन्ना भरता अर्भकासः ।
अभवच्च पुरएता वसिष्ठ आदित्तृत्सूनां विशो अप्रथन्त ॥
verses.rom:
danda ivedgoajanasa asanparichchhinna bharata arbhakasah |
abhavachcha puraeta vasishtha adittritsunam visho aprathanta ||
verses.en:
Like sticks and staves wherewith they drive the cattle, Stripped bare, the Bharatas were found defenceless:
Vasistha then became their chief and leader: then widely. were the Trtsus' clans extended.

verses.sa:
त्रयः कृण्वन्ति भुवनेषु रेतस्तिस्रः प्रजा आर्या ज्योतिरग्राः ।
त्रयो घर्मास उषसं सचन्ते सर्वाँ इत्ताँ अनु विदुर्वसिष्ठाः ॥
verses.rom:
trayah krinvanti bhuvaneshu retastisrah praja arya jyotiragrah |
trayo gharmasa ushasam sachante sarvan ittan anu vidurvasishthah ||
verses.en:
Three fertilize the worlds with genial moisture: three noble Creatures cast a light before them.
Three that give warmth to all attend the morning. All these have they discovered, these Vasisthas.

verses.sa:
सूर्यस्येव वक्षथो ज्योतिरेषां समुद्रस्येव महिमा गभीरः ।
वातस्येव प्रजवो नान्येन स्तोमो वसिष्ठा अन्वेतवे वः ॥
verses.rom:
suryasyeva vakshatho jyotiresham samudrasyeva mahima gabhirah |
vatasyeva prajavo nanyena stomo vasishtha anvetave vah ||
verses.en:
Like the Sun's growing glory is their splendour, and like the sea's is their unflathomed greatness.
Their course is like the wind's. Your laud, Vasisthas, can never be attained by any other.

verses.sa:
त इन्निण्यं हृदयस्य प्रकेतैः सहस्रवल्शमभि सं चरन्ति ।
यमेन ततं परिधिं वयन्तोऽप्सरस उप सेदुर्वसिष्ठाः ॥
verses.rom:
ta inninyam hridayasya praketaih sahasravalshamabhi sam charanti |
yamena tatam paridhim vayanto'psarasa upa sedurvasishthah ||
verses.en:
They with perceptions of the heart in secret resort to that which spreads a thousand branches.
The Apsaras brought hither the Vasisthas wearing the vesture spun for them by Yama.

verses.sa:
विद्युतो ज्योतिः परि संजिहानं मित्रावरुणा यदपश्यतां त्वा ।
तत्ते जन्मोतैकं वसिष्ठागस्त्यो यत्त्वा विश आजभार ॥
verses.rom:
vidyuto jyotih pari samjihanam mitravaruna yadapashyatam tva |
tatte janmotaikam vasishthagastyo yattva visha ajabhara ||
verses.en:
A form of lustre springing from the lightning wast thou, when Varuna and Mitra saw thee.
Thy one and only birth was then, Vasistha, when from thy stock Agastya brought thee hither.

verses.sa:
उतासि मैत्रावरुणो वसिष्ठोर्वश्या ब्रह्मन्मनसोऽधि जातः ।
द्रप्सं स्कन्नं ब्रह्मणा दैव्येन विश्वे देवाः पुष्करे त्वाददन्त ॥
verses.rom:
utasi maitravaruno vasishthorvashya brahmanmanaso'dhi jatah |
drapsam skannam brahmana daivyena vishve devah pushkare tvadadanta ||
verses.en:
Born of their love for Urvasi, Vasistha thou, priest, art son of Varuna and Mitra;
And as a fallen drop, in heavenly fervour, all the Gods laid thee on a lotus-blossom.

verses.sa:
स प्रकेत उभयस्य प्रविद्वान्सहस्रदान उत वा सदानः ।
यमेन ततं परिधिं वयिष्यन्नप्सरसः परि जज्ञे वसिष्ठः ॥
verses.rom:
sa praketa ubhayasya pravidvansahasradana uta va sadanah |
yamena tatam paridhim vayishyannapsarasah pari jajne vasishthah ||
verses.en:
He thinker, knower both of earth and heaven, endowed with many a gift, bestowing thousands,
Destined to wear the vesture spun by Yama, sprang from the Apsaras to life, Vasistha.

verses.sa:
सत्रे ह जाताविषिता नमोभिः कुम्भे रेतः सिषिचतुः समानम् ।
ततो ह मान उदियाय मध्यात्ततो जातमृषिमाहुर्वसिष्ठम् ॥
verses.rom:
satre ha jatavishita namobhih kumbhe retah sishichatuh samanam |
tato ha mana udiyaya madhyattato jatamrishimahurvasishtham ||
verses.en:
Born at the sacrifice, urged by adorations, both with a common flow bedewed the pitcher.
Then from the midst thereof there rose up Mana, and thence they say was born the sage Vasistha.

verses.sa:
उक्थभृतं सामभृतं बिभर्ति ग्रावाणं बिभ्रत्प्र वदात्यग्रे ।
उपैनमाध्वं सुमनस्यमाना आ वो गच्छाति प्रतृदो वसिष्ठः ॥
verses.rom:
ukthabhritam samabhritam bibharti gravanam bibhratpra vadatyagre |
upainamadhvam sumanasyamana a vo gachchhati pratrido vasishthah ||
verses.en:
He brings the bearer of the laud and Saman: first shall he speak bringing the stone for pressing.
With grateful hearts in reverence approach him: to you, O Pratrdas, Vasistha cometh.

verses.sa: प्र शुक्रैतु देवी मनीषा अस्मत्सुतष्टो रथो न वाजी ॥
verses.rom: pra shukraitu devi manisha asmatsutashto ratho na vaji ||
verses.en: MAY our divine and brilliant hymn go forth, like a swift chariot wrought and fashioned well.

verses.sa: विदुः पृथिव्या दिवो जनित्रं शृण्वन्त्यापो अध क्षरन्तीः ॥
verses.rom: viduh prithivya divo janitram shrinvantyapo adha ksharantih ||
verses.en: The waters listen as they flow along: they know the origin of heaven and earth.

verses.sa: आपश्चिदस्मै पिन्वन्त पृथ्वीर्वृत्रेषु शूरा मंसन्त उग्राः ॥
verses.rom: apashchidasmai pinvanta prithvirvritreshu shura mamsanta ugrah ||
verses.en: Yea, the broad waters swell their flood for him: of him strong heroes think amid their foes.

verses.sa: आ धूर्ष्वस्मै दधाताश्वानिन्द्रो न वज्री हिरण्यबाहुः ॥
verses.rom: a dhurshvasmai dadhatashvanindro na vajri hiranyabahuh ||
verses.en: Set ye for him the coursers to the pole: like Indra Thunderer is the Golden-armed.

verses.sa: अभि प्र स्थाताहेव यज्ञं यातेव पत्मन्त्मना हिनोत ॥
verses.rom: abhi pra sthataheva yajnam yateva patmantmana hinota ||
verses.en: Arouse you, like the days, to sacrifice speed gladly like a traveller on the way.

verses.sa: त्मना समत्सु हिनोत यज्ञं दधात केतुं जनाय वीरम् ॥
verses.rom: tmana samatsu hinota yajnam dadhata ketum janaya viram ||
verses.en: Go swift to battles, to the sacrifice: set up a flag, a hero for the folk.

verses.sa: उदस्य शुष्माद्भानुर्नार्त बिभर्ति भारं पृथिवी न भूम ॥
verses.rom: udasya shushmadbhanurnarta bibharti bharam prithivi na bhuma ||
verses.en: Up from his strength hath risen as 'twere a light: it bears the load as earth bears living things.

verses.sa: ह्वयामि देवाँ अयातुरग्ने साधन्नृतेन धियं दधामि ॥
verses.rom: hvayami devan ayaturagne sadhannritena dhiyam dadhami ||
verses.en: Agni, no demon I invoke the Gods: by law completing it, I form a hymn.

verses.sa: अभि वो देवीं धियं दधिध्वं प्र वो देवत्रा वाचं कृणुध्वम् ॥
verses.rom: abhi vo devim dhiyam dadhidhvam pra vo devatra vacham krinudhvam ||
verses.en: Closely about you lay your heavenly song, and send your voice to where the Gods abide.

verses.sa: आ चष्ट आसां पाथो नदीनां वरुण उग्रः सहस्रचक्षाः ॥
verses.rom: a chashta asam patho nadinam varuna ugrah sahasrachakshah ||
verses.en: Varuna, Mighty, with a thousand eyes, beholds the paths wherein these rivers run.

verses.sa: राजा राष्ट्रानां पेशो नदीनामनुत्तमस्मै क्षत्रं विश्वायु ॥
verses.rom: raja rashtranam pesho nadinamanuttamasmai kshatram vishvayu ||
verses.en: He, King of kings, the glory of the floods, o'er all that liveth hath resistless sway.

verses.sa: अविष्टो अस्मान्विश्वासु विक्ष्वद्युं कृणोत शंसं निनित्सोः ॥
verses.rom: avishto asmanvishvasu vikshvadyum krinota shamsam ninitsoh ||
verses.en: May he assist us among all the tribes, and make the envier's praise devoid of light.

verses.sa: व्येतु दिद्युद्द्विषामशेवा युयोत विष्वग्रपस्तनूनाम् ॥
verses.rom: vyetu didyuddvishamasheva yuyota vishvagrapastanunam ||
verses.en: May the foes' threatening arrow pass us by: may he put far from us our bodies' sin.

verses.sa: अवीन्नो अग्निर्हव्यान्नमोभिः प्रेष्ठो अस्मा अधायि स्तोमः ॥
verses.rom: avinno agnirhavyannamobhih preshtho asma adhayi stomah ||
verses.en: Agni, oblation-cater, through our prayers aid us: to him our dearest laud is brought.

verses.sa: सजूर्देवेभिरपां नपातं सखायं कृध्वं शिवो नो अस्तु ॥
verses.rom: sajurdevebhirapam napatam sakhayam kridhvam shivo no astu ||
verses.en: Accordant with the Gods choose for our Friend the Waters' Child: may he be good to us.

verses.sa: अब्जामुक्थैरहिं गृणीषे बुध्ने नदीनां रजस्सु षीदन् ॥
verses.rom: abjamukthairahim grinishe budhne nadinam rajassu shidan ||
verses.en: With lauds I sing the Dragon born of floods: he sits beneath the streams in middle air.

verses.sa: मा नोऽहिर्बुध्न्यो रिषे धान्मा यज्ञो अस्य स्रिधदृतायोः ॥
verses.rom: ma no'hirbudhnyo rishe dhanma yajno asya sridhadritayoh ||
verses.en: Ne'er may the Dragon of the Deep harm us: ne'er fail this faithful servant's sacrifice.

verses.sa: उत न एषु नृषु श्रवो धुः प्र राये यन्तु शर्धन्तो अर्यः ॥
verses.rom: uta na eshu nrishu shravo dhuh pra raye yantu shardhanto aryah ||
verses.en: To these our heroes may they grant renown: may pious men march boldly on to wealth.

verses.sa: तपन्ति शत्रुं स्वर्ण भूमा महासेनासो अमेभिरेषाम् ॥
verses.rom: tapanti shatrum svarna bhuma mahasenaso amebhiresham ||
verses.en: Leading great hosts, with fierce attacks of these, they burn their foes as the Sun burns the earth.

verses.sa: आ यन्नः पत्नीर्गमन्त्यच्छा त्वष्टा सुपाणिर्दधातु वीरान् ॥
verses.rom: a yannah patnirgamantyachchha tvashta supanirdadhatu viran ||
verses.en: What time our wives draw near to us, may he, left-handed Tvastar, give us hero sons.

verses.sa: प्रति न स्तोमं त्वष्टा जुषेत स्यादस्मे अरमतिर्वसूयुः ॥
verses.rom: prati na stomam tvashta jusheta syadasme aramatirvasuyuh ||
verses.en: May Tvastar find our hymn acceptable, and may Aramati, seeking wealth, be ours.

verses.sa:
ता नो रासन्रातिषाचो वसून्या रोदसी वरुणानी शृणोतु ।
वरूत्रीभिः सुशरणो नो अस्तु त्वष्टा सुदत्रो वि दधातु रायः ॥
verses.rom:
ta no rasanratishacho vasunya rodasi varunani shrinotu |
varutribhih susharano no astu tvashta sudatro vi dadhatu rayah ||
verses.en:
May they who lavish gifts bestow those treasures: may Rodasi and Varunani listen.
May he, with the Varutris, be our refuge, may bountiful Tvastar give us store of riches.

verses.sa:
तन्नो रायः पर्वतास्तन्न आपस्तद्रातिषाच ओषधीरुत द्यौः ।
वनस्पतिभिः पृथिवी सजोषा उभे रोदसी परि पासतो नः ॥
verses.rom:
tanno rayah parvatastanna apastadratishacha oshadhiruta dyauh |
vanaspatibhih prithivi sajosha ubhe rodasi pari pasato nah ||
verses.en:
So may rich Mountains and the liberal Waters, so may all Herbs that grow on ground, and Heaven,
And Earth accordant with the Forest-Sovrans, and both the World-halves round about protect us.

verses.sa:
अनु तदुर्वी रोदसी जिहातामनु द्युक्षो वरुण इन्द्रसखा ।
अनु विश्वे मरुतो ये सहासो रायः स्याम धरुणं धियध्यै ॥
verses.rom:
anu tadurvi rodasi jihatamanu dyuksho varuna indrasakha |
anu vishve maruto ye sahaso rayah syama dharunam dhiyadhyai ||
verses.en:
To this may both the wide Worlds lend approval, and Varuna in heaven, whose Friend is Indra.
May all the Maruts give consent, the Victors, that we may hold great wealth in firm possession.

verses.sa:
तन्न इन्द्रो वरुणो मित्रो अग्निराप ओषधीर्वनिनो जुषन्त ।
शर्मन्स्याम मरुतामुपस्थे यूयं पात स्वस्तिभिः सदा नः ॥
verses.rom:
tanna indro varuno mitro agnirapa oshadhirvanino jushanta |
sharmansyama marutamupasthe yuyam pata svastibhih sada nah ||
verses.en:
May Indra, Varuna, Mitra, and Agni, Waters, Herbs, Trees accept the praise we offer.
May we find refuge in the Marut's bosom. Protect us evermore, ye Gods, with blessings.

verses.sa:
शं न इन्द्राग्नी भवतामवोभिः शं न इन्द्रावरुणा रातहव्या ।
शमिन्द्रासोमा सुविताय शं योः शं न इन्द्रापूषणा वाजसातौ ॥
verses.rom:
sham na indragni bhavatamavobhih sham na indravaruna ratahavya |
shamindrasoma suvitaya sham yoh sham na indrapushana vajasatau ||
verses.en:
BEFRIEND us with their aids Indra and Agni, Indra and Varuna who receive oblations!
Indra and Soma give health, strength and comfort, Indra and Pusan be our help in battle.

verses.sa:
शं नो भगः शमु नः शंसो अस्तु शं नः पुरंधिः शमु सन्तु रायः ।
शं नः सत्यस्य सुयमस्य शंसः शं नो अर्यमा पुरुजातो अस्तु ॥
verses.rom:
sham no bhagah shamu nah shamso astu sham nah puramdhih shamu santu rayah |
sham nah satyasya suyamasya shamsah sham no aryama purujato astu ||
verses.en:
Auspicious Friends to us be Bhaga, Sathsa, auspicious be Purandhi aid all Riches;
The blessing of the true and well-conducted, and Aryaman in many forms apparent.

verses.sa:
शं नो धाता शमु धर्ता नो अस्तु शं न उरूची भवतु स्वधाभिः ।
शं रोदसी बृहती शं नो अद्रिः शं नो देवानां सुहवानि सन्तु ॥
verses.rom:
sham no dhata shamu dharta no astu sham na uruchi bhavatu svadhabhih |
sham rodasi brihati sham no adrih sham no devanam suhavani santu ||
verses.en:
Kind unto us he Maker and Sustainer, and the far-reaching Pair with God-like natures.
Auspicious unto us be Earth and Heaven, the Mountain, and the Gods' fair invocations.

verses.sa:
शं नो अग्निर्ज्योतिरनीको अस्तु शं नो मित्रावरुणावश्विना शम् ।
शं नः सुकृतां सुकृतानि सन्तु शं न इषिरो अभि वातु वातः ॥
verses.rom:
sham no agnirjyotiraniko astu sham no mitravarunavashvina sham |
sham nah sukritam sukritani santu sham na ishiro abhi vatu vatah ||
verses.en:
Favour us Agni with his face of splendour, and Varuva and Mitra and the Asvins.
Favour us noble actions of the pious, impetuous vita blow on us with favour.

verses.sa:
शं नो द्यावापृथिवी पूर्वहूतौ शमन्तरिक्षं दृशये नो अस्तु ।
शं न ओषधीर्वनिनो भवन्तु शं नो रजसस्पतिरस्तु जिष्णुः ॥
verses.rom:
sham no dyavaprithivi purvahutau shamantariksham drishaye no astu |
sham na oshadhirvanino bhavantu sham no rajasaspatirastu jishnuh ||
verses.en:
Early invoked, may Heaven and Earth be friendly, and Air's mid-region good for us to look on.
To us may Herbs and Forest-Trees be gracious, gracious the Lord Victorious of the region.

verses.sa:
शं न इन्द्रो वसुभिर्देवो अस्तु शमादित्येभिर्वरुणः सुशंसः ।
शं नो रुद्रो रुद्रेभिर्जलाषः शं नस्त्वष्टा ग्नाभिरिह शृणोतु ॥
verses.rom:
sham na indro vasubhirdevo astu shamadityebhirvarunah sushamsah |
sham no rudro rudrebhirjalashah sham nastvashta gnabhiriha shrinotu ||
verses.en:
Be the God Indra with the Vasus friendly, and, with Adityas, Varuna who blesseth.
Kind, with the Rudras, be the Healer Rudra, and, with the Dames, may Tvastar kindly listen.

verses.sa:
शं नः सोमो भवतु ब्रह्म शं नः शं नो ग्रावाणः शमु सन्तु यज्ञाः ।
शं नः स्वरूणां मितयो भवन्तु शं नः प्रस्वः शम्वस्तु वेदिः ॥
verses.rom:
sham nah somo bhavatu brahma sham nah sham no gravanah shamu santu yajnah |
sham nah svarunam mitayo bhavantu sham nah prasvah shamvastu vedih ||
verses.en:
Blest unto us be Soma, and devotions, blest be the Sacrifice, the Stones for pressing.
Blest be the fixing of the sacred Pillars, blest be the tender Grass and blest the Altar.

verses.sa:
शं नः सूर्य उरुचक्षा उदेतु शं नश्चतस्रः प्रदिशो भवन्तु ।
शं नः पर्वता ध्रुवयो भवन्तु शं नः सिन्धवः शमु सन्त्वापः ॥
verses.rom:
sham nah surya uruchaksha udetu sham nashchatasrah pradisho bhavantu |
sham nah parvata dhruvayo bhavantu sham nah sindhavah shamu santvapah ||
verses.en:
May the far-seeing Sun rise up to bless us: be the four Quarters of the sky auspicious.
Auspicious be the firmly-seated Mountains, auspicious be the Rivers and the Waters.

verses.sa:
शं नो अदितिर्भवतु व्रतेभिः शं नो भवन्तु मरुतः स्वर्काः ।
शं नो विष्णुः शमु पूषा नो अस्तु शं नो भवित्रं शम्वस्तु वायुः ॥
verses.rom:
sham no aditirbhavatu vratebhih sham no bhavantu marutah svarkah |
sham no vishnuh shamu pusha no astu sham no bhavitram shamvastu vayuh ||
verses.en:
May Adid through holy works be gracioas, and may the Maruts, loud in song, be friendly.
May Visnu give felicity, and Pusan, the Air that cherisheth our life, and Vayu.

verses.sa:
शं नो देवः सविता त्रायमाणः शं नो भवन्तूषसो विभातीः ।
शं नः पर्जन्यो भवतु प्रजाभ्यः शं नः क्षेत्रस्य पतिरस्तु शम्भुः ॥
verses.rom:
sham no devah savita trayamanah sham no bhavantushaso vibhatih |
sham nah parjanyo bhavatu prajabhyah sham nah kshetrasya patirastu shambhuh ||
verses.en:
Prosper us Savitar, the God who rescues, and let the radiant Mornings be propitious.
Auspicious to all creatures be Parjanya, auspicious be the field's benign Protector.

verses.sa:
शं नो देवा विश्वदेवा भवन्तु शं सरस्वती सह धीभिरस्तु ।
शमभिषाचः शमु रातिषाचः शं नो दिव्याः पार्थिवाः शं नो अप्याः ॥
verses.rom:
sham no deva vishvadeva bhavantu sham sarasvati saha dhibhirastu |
shamabhishachah shamu ratishachah sham no divyah parthivah sham no apyah ||
verses.en:
May all the fellowship of Gods befriend us, Sarasvati, with Holy Thoughts, be gracious.
Friendly be they, the Liberal Ones who seek us, yea, those who dwell in heaven, on earth, in waters.

verses.sa:
शं नः सत्यस्य पतयो भवन्तु शं नो अर्वन्तः शमु सन्तु गावः ।
शं न ऋभवः सुकृतः सुहस्ताः शं नो भवन्तु पितरो हवेषु ॥
verses.rom:
sham nah satyasya patayo bhavantu sham no arvantah shamu santu gavah |
sham na ribhavah sukritah suhastah sham no bhavantu pitaro haveshu ||
verses.en:
May the great Lords of Truth protect and aid us: blest to us be our horses and our cattle.
Kind be the pious skilful-handed Rbhus, kind be the Fathers at our invocations.

verses.sa:
शं नो अज एकपाद्देवो अस्तु शं नोऽहिर्बुध्न्यः शं समुद्रः ।
शं नो अपां नपात्पेरुरस्तु शं नः पृश्निर्भवतु देवगोपा ॥
verses.rom:
sham no aja ekapaddevo astu sham no'hirbudhnyah sham samudrah |
sham no apam napatperurastu sham nah prishnirbhavatu devagopa ||
verses.en:
May Aja-Ekapad, the God, be gracious, gracious the Dragon of the Deep, and Ocean.
Gracious be he the swelling Child of Waters, gracious be Prsni who hath Gods to guard her.

verses.sa:
आदित्या रुद्रा वसवो जुषन्तेदं ब्रह्म क्रियमाणं नवीयः ।
शृण्वन्तु नो दिव्याः पार्थिवासो गोजाता उत ये यज्ञियासः ॥
verses.rom:
aditya rudra vasavo jushantedam brahma kriyamanam naviyah |
shrinvantu no divyah parthivaso gojata uta ye yajniyasah ||
verses.en:
So may the Rudras, Vasus, and Adityas accept the new hymn which we now are making.
May all the Holy Ones of earth and heaven, and the Cow's offipring hear our invocation.

verses.sa:
ये देवानां यज्ञिया यज्ञियानां मनोर्यजत्रा अमृता ऋतज्ञाः ।
ते नो रासन्तामुरुगायमद्य यूयं पात स्वस्तिभिः सदा नः ॥
verses.rom:
ye devanam yajniya yajniyanam manoryajatra amrita ritajnah |
te no rasantamurugayamadya yuyam pata svastibhih sada nah ||
verses.en:
They who of Holy Gods are very holy, Immortal, knowing Law, whom man must worship,-
May these to-day give us broad paths to travel. Preserve us evermore, ye Gods, with blessings.

verses.sa:
प्र ब्रह्मैतु सदनादृतस्य वि रश्मिभिः ससृजे सूर्यो गाः ।
वि सानुना पृथिवी सस्र उर्वी पृथु प्रतीकमध्येधे अग्निः ॥
verses.rom:
pra brahmaitu sadanadritasya vi rashmibhih sasrije suryo gah |
vi sanuna prithivi sasra urvi prithu pratikamadhyedhe agnih ||
verses.en:
LET the prayer issue from the seat of Order, for Surya with his beams hath loosed the cattle.
With lofty ridges earth is far extended, and Agni's flame hath lit the spacious surface.

verses.sa:
इमां वां मित्रावरुणा सुवृक्तिमिषं न कृण्वे असुरा नवीयः ।
इनो वामन्यः पदवीरदब्धो जनं च मित्रो यतति ब्रुवाणः ॥
verses.rom:
imam vam mitravaruna suvriktimisham na krinve asura naviyah |
ino vamanyah padaviradabdho janam cha mitro yatati bruvanah ||
verses.en:
O Asuras, O Varuna and Mitra, this hymn to you, like food, anew I offer.
One of you is a strong unerring Leader, and Mitra, speaking, stirreth men to labour.

verses.sa:
आ वातस्य ध्रजतो रन्त इत्या अपीपयन्त धेनवो न सूदाः ।
महो दिवः सदने जायमानोऽचिक्रदद्वृषभः सस्मिन्नूधन् ॥
verses.rom:
a vatasya dhrajato ranta itya apipayanta dhenavo na sudah |
maho divah sadane jayamano'chikradadvrishabhah sasminnudhan ||
verses.en:
The movements of the gliding wind come hither: like cows, the springs are filled to overflowing.
Born in the station e'en of lofty heaven the Bull hath loudly bellowed in this region.

verses.sa:
गिरा य एता युनजद्धरी त इन्द्र प्रिया सुरथा शूर धायू ।
प्र यो मन्युं रिरिक्षतो मिनात्या सुक्रतुमर्यमणं ववृत्याम् ॥
verses.rom:
gira ya eta yunajaddhari ta indra priya suratha shura dhayu |
pra yo manyum ririkshato minatya sukratumaryamanam vavrityam ||
verses.en:
May I bring hither with my song, O Indra, wise Aryaman who yokes thy dear Bay Horses,
Voracious, with thy noble car, O Hero, him who defeats the wrath of the malicious.

verses.sa:
यजन्ते अस्य सख्यं वयश्च नमस्विनः स्व ऋतस्य धामन् ।
वि पृक्षो बाबधे नृभि स्तवान इदं नमो रुद्राय प्रेष्ठम् ॥
verses.rom:
yajante asya sakhyam vayashcha namasvinah sva ritasya dhaman |
vi priksho babadhe nribhi stavana idam namo rudraya preshtham ||
verses.en:
In their own place of sacrifice adorers worship to gain long life and win his friendship.
He hath poured food on men when they have praised him; be this, the dearest reverence, paid to Rudra.

verses.sa:
आ यत्साकं यशसो वावशानाः सरस्वती सप्तथी सिन्धुमाता ।
याः सुष्वयन्त सुदुघाः सुधारा अभि स्वेन पयसा पीप्यानाः ॥
verses.rom:
a yatsakam yashaso vavashanah sarasvati saptathi sindhumata |
yah sushvayanta sudughah sudhara abhi svena payasa pipyanah ||
verses.en:
Coming together, glorious, loudly roaring - Sarasvati, Mother of Floods, the seventh-
With copious milk, with fair streams, strongly flowing, full swelling with the volume of their water;

verses.sa:
उत त्ये नो मरुतो मन्दसाना धियं तोकं च वाजिनोऽवन्तु ।
मा नः परि ख्यदक्षरा चरन्त्यवीवृधन्युज्यं ते रयिं नः ॥
verses.rom:
uta tye no maruto mandasana dhiyam tokam cha vajino'vantu |
ma nah pari khyadakshara charantyavivridhanyujyam te rayim nah ||
verses.en:
And may the mighty Maruts, too, rejoicing, aid our devotion and protect our offspring.
Let not swift-moving Aksara neglect us: they have increased our own appropriate riches,

verses.sa:
प्र वो महीमरमतिं कृणुध्वं प्र पूषणं विदथ्यं न वीरम् ।
भगं धियोऽवितारं नो अस्याः सातौ वाजं रातिषाचं पुरंधिम् ॥
verses.rom:
pra vo mahimaramatim krinudhvam pra pushanam vidathyam na viram |
bhagam dhiyo'vitaram no asyah satau vajam ratishacham puramdhim ||
verses.en:
Bring ye the great Aramati before you, and Pusan as the Hero of the synod,
Bhaga who looks upon this hymn with favour, and, as our strength, the bountiful Purandbi.

verses.sa:
अच्छायं वो मरुतः श्लोक एत्वच्छा विष्णुं निषिक्तपामवोभिः ।
उत प्रजायै गृणते वयो धुर्यूयं पात स्वस्तिभिः सदा नः ॥
verses.rom:
achchhayam vo marutah shloka etvachchha vishnum nishiktapamavobhih |
uta prajayai grinate vayo dhuryuyam pata svastibhih sada nah ||
verses.en:
May this our song of praise reach you, O Maruts, and Visnu guardian of the future infant.
May they vouchsafe the singer strength for offspring. Preserve us evermore, ye Gods, with blessings.

verses.sa:
आ वो वाहिष्ठो वहतु स्तवध्यै रथो वाजा ऋभुक्षणो अमृक्तः ।
अभि त्रिपृष्ठैः सवनेषु सोमैर्मदे सुशिप्रा महभिः पृणध्वम् ॥
verses.rom:
a vo vahishtho vahatu stavadhyai ratho vaja ribhukshano amriktah |
abhi triprishthaih savaneshu somairmade sushipra mahabhih prinadhvam ||
verses.en:
LET your best-bearing car that must be lauded, ne'er injured, bring you Vajas and Rbhuksans.
Fill you, fair-helmeted! with mighty Soma, thrice-mixed, at our libations to delight you.

verses.sa:
यूयं ह रत्नं मघवत्सु धत्थ स्वर्दृश ऋभुक्षणो अमृक्तम् ।
सं यज्ञेषु स्वधावन्तः पिबध्वं वि नो राधांसि मतिभिर्दयध्वम् ॥
verses.rom:
yuyam ha ratnam maghavatsu dhattha svardrisha ribhukshano amriktam |
sam yajneshu svadhavantah pibadhvam vi no radhamsi matibhirdayadhvam ||
verses.en:
Ye who behold the light of heaven, Rbhuksans, give our rich patrons unmolested riches.
Drink, heavenly-natured. at our sacrifices, and give us bounties for the hymns we sing you.

verses.sa:
उवोचिथ हि मघवन्देष्णं महो अर्भस्य वसुनो विभागे ।
उभा ते पूर्णा वसुना गभस्ती न सूनृता नि यमते वसव्या ॥
verses.rom:
uvochitha hi maghavandeshnam maho arbhasya vasuno vibhage |
ubha te purna vasuna gabhasti na sunrita ni yamate vasavya ||
verses.en:
For thou, O Bounteous One, art used to giving, at parting treasure whether small or ample.
Filled full are both thine arms with great possessions: thy goodness keeps thee not from granting riches.

verses.sa:
त्वमिन्द्र स्वयशा ऋभुक्षा वाजो न साधुरस्तमेष्यृक्वा ।
वयं नु ते दाश्वांसः स्याम ब्रह्म कृण्वन्तो हरिवो वसिष्ठाः ॥
verses.rom:
tvamindra svayasha ribhuksha vajo na sadhurastameshyrikva |
vayam nu te dashvamsah syama brahma krinvanto harivo vasishthah ||
verses.en:
Indra, high-famed, as Vaja and Rbhuksans, thou goest working, singing to the dwelling.
Lord of Bay Steeds, this day may we Vasisthas offer our prayers to thee and bring oblations.

verses.sa:
सनितासि प्रवतो दाशुषे चिद्याभिर्विवेषो हर्यश्व धीभिः ।
ववन्मा नु ते युज्याभिरूती कदा न इन्द्र राय आ दशस्येः ॥
verses.rom:
sanitasi pravato dashushe chidyabhirvivesho haryashva dhibhih |
vavanma nu te yujyabhiruti kada na indra raya a dashasyeh ||
verses.en:
Thou winnest swift advancement for thy servant, through hymns, Lord of Bay Steeds, which thou hast favoured.
For thee with friendly succour have we battled, and when, O Indra, wilt thou grant us riches?

verses.sa:
वासयसीव वेधसस्त्वं नः कदा न इन्द्र वचसो बुबोधः ।
अस्तं तात्या धिया रयिं सुवीरं पृक्षो नो अर्वा न्युहीत वाजी ॥
verses.rom:
vasayasiva vedhasastvam nah kada na indra vachaso bubodhah |
astam tatya dhiya rayim suviram priksho no arva nyuhita vaji ||
verses.en:
To us thy priests a home, as 'twere, thou givest: when, Indra wilt thou recognize our praises?
May thy strong Steed, through our ancestral worship, bring food and wealth with heroes to our dwelling.

verses.sa:
अभि यं देवी निरृतिश्चिदीशे नक्षन्त इन्द्रं शरदः सुपृक्षः ।
उप त्रिबन्धुर्जरदष्टिमेत्यस्ववेशं यं कृणवन्त मर्ताः ॥
verses.rom:
abhi yam devi nirritishchidishe nakshanta indram sharadah suprikshah |
upa tribandhurjaradashtimetyasvavesham yam krinavanta martah ||
verses.en:
Though Nirrti the Goddess reigneth round him, Autumns with food in plenty come to Indra.
With three close Friends to length of days he cometh, he whom men let not rest at home in quiet.

verses.sa:
आ नो राधांसि सवित स्तवध्या आ रायो यन्तु पर्वतस्य रातौ ।
सदा नो दिव्यः पायुः सिषक्तु यूयं पात स्वस्तिभिः सदा नः ॥
verses.rom:
a no radhamsi savita stavadhya a rayo yantu parvatasya ratau |
sada no divyah payuh sishaktu yuyam pata svastibhih sada nah ||
verses.en:
Promise us gifts, O Savitar: may riches come unto us in Parvata's full bounty.
May the Celestial Guardian still attend us. Preserve us evermore, ye Gods, with blessings.

verses.sa:
उदु ष्य देवः सविता ययाम हिरण्ययीममतिं यामशिश्रेत् ।
नूनं भगो हव्यो मानुषेभिर्वि यो रत्ना पुरूवसुर्दधाति ॥
verses.rom:
udu shya devah savita yayama hiranyayimamatim yamashishret |
nunam bhago havyo manushebhirvi yo ratna puruvasurdadhati ||
verses.en:
ON high hath Savitar, this God, extended the golden lustre which he spreads around him.
Now, now must Bhaga be invoked by mortals, Lord of great riches who distributes treasures.

verses.sa:
उदु तिष्ठ सवितः श्रुध्यस्य हिरण्यपाणे प्रभृतावृतस्य ।
व्युर्वीं पृथ्वीममतिं सृजान आ नृभ्यो मर्तभोजनं सुवानः ॥
verses.rom:
udu tishtha savitah shrudhyasya hiranyapane prabhritavritasya |
vyurvim prithvimamatim srijana a nribhyo martabhojanam suvanah ||
verses.en:
Rise up, O Savitar whose hands are golden, and hear this man while sacrifice is offered,
Spreading afar thy broad and wide effulgence, and bringing mortal men the food that feeds them.

verses.sa:
अपि ष्टुतः सविता देवो अस्तु यमा चिद्विश्वे वसवो गृणन्ति ।
स न स्तोमान्नमस्यश्चनो धाद्विश्वेभिः पातु पायुभिर्नि सूरीन् ॥
verses.rom:
api shtutah savita devo astu yama chidvishve vasavo grinanti |
sa na stomannamasyashchano dhadvishvebhih patu payubhirni surin ||
verses.en:
Let Savitar the God he hymned with praises, to whom the Vasus, even, all sing glory.
Sweet be our lauds to him whose due is worship: may he with all protection guard our princes.

verses.sa:
अभि यं देव्यदितिर्गृणाति सवं देवस्य सवितुर्जुषाणा ।
अभि सम्राजो वरुणो गृणन्त्यभि मित्रासो अर्यमा सजोषाः ॥
verses.rom:
abhi yam devyaditirgrinati savam devasya saviturjushana |
abhi samrajo varuno grinantyabhi mitraso aryama sajoshah ||
verses.en:
Even he whom Aditi the Goddess praises, rejoicing in God Savitar's incitement:
Even he who praise the high imperial Rulers, Varuna, Mitra, Aryaman, sing in concert.

verses.sa:
अभि ये मिथो वनुषः सपन्ते रातिं दिवो रातिषाचः पृथिव्याः ।
अहिर्बुध्न्य उत नः शृणोतु वरूत्र्येकधेनुभिर्नि पातु ॥
verses.rom:
abhi ye mitho vanushah sapante ratim divo ratishachah prithivyah |
ahirbudhnya uta nah shrinotu varutryekadhenubhirni patu ||
verses.en:
They who come emulous to our oblation, dispensing bounty, from the earth and heaven.
May they and Ahibudhnya hear our calling: guard us Varutri with the Ekadhenus.

verses.sa:
अनु तन्नो जास्पतिर्मंसीष्ट रत्नं देवस्य सवितुरियानः ।
भगमुग्रोऽवसे जोहवीति भगमनुग्रो अध याति रत्नम् ॥
verses.rom:
anu tanno jaspatirmamsishta ratnam devasya savituriyanah |
bhagamugro'vase johaviti bhagamanugro adha yati ratnam ||
verses.en:
This may the Lord of Life, entreated, grant us,-the wealth which Savitar the God possesses.
The mighty calls on Bhaga for protection, on Bhaga calls the weak to give him riches.

verses.sa:
शं नो भवन्तु वाजिनो हवेषु देवताता मितद्रवः स्वर्काः ।
जम्भयन्तोऽहिं वृकं रक्षांसि सनेम्यस्मद्युयवन्नमीवाः ॥
verses.rom:
sham no bhavantu vajino haveshu devatata mitadravah svarkah |
jambhayanto'him vrikam rakshamsi sanemyasmadyuyavannamivah ||
verses.en:
Bless us the Vajins when we call, while slowly they move, strong Singers, to the Gods' assembly.
Crushing the wolf, the serpent, and the demons, may they completely banish all affliction.

verses.sa:
वाजेवाजेऽवत वाजिनो नो धनेषु विप्रा अमृता ऋतज्ञाः ।
अस्य मध्वः पिबत मादयध्वं तृप्ता यात पथिभिर्देवयानैः ॥
verses.rom:
vajevaje'vata vajino no dhaneshu vipra amrita ritajnah |
asya madhvah pibata madayadhvam tripta yata pathibhirdevayanaih ||
verses.en:
Deep-skilled in Law eternal, deathless, Singers, O Vajins, help us in each fray for booty.
Drink of this meath, he satisfied, be joyful: then go on paths which Gods are wont to travel.

verses.sa:
ऊर्ध्वो अग्निः सुमतिं वस्वो अश्रेत्प्रतीची जूर्णिर्देवतातिमेति ।
भेजाते अद्री रथ्येव पन्थामृतं होता न इषितो यजाति ॥
verses.rom:
urdhvo agnih sumatim vasvo ashretpratichi jurnirdevatatimeti |
bhejate adri rathyeva panthamritam hota na ishito yajati ||
verses.en:
AGNI, erect, hath shown enriching favour: the flame goes forward to the Gods' assembly.
Like car-borne men the stones their path have chosen: let the priest, quickened, celebrate our worship.

verses.sa:
प्र वावृजे सुप्रया बर्हिरेषामा विश्पतीव बीरिट इयाते ।
विशामक्तोरुषसः पूर्वहूतौ वायुः पूषा स्वस्तये नियुत्वान् ॥
verses.rom:
pra vavrije supraya barhireshama vishpativa birita iyate |
vishamaktorushasah purvahutau vayuh pusha svastaye niyutvan ||
verses.en:
Soft to the tread, their sacred grass is scattered: these go like Kings amid the band around them,
At the folks early call on Night and Morning,-Vayu, and Pusan with his team, to bless us.

verses.sa:
ज्मया अत्र वसवो रन्त देवा उरावन्तरिक्षे मर्जयन्त शुभ्राः ।
अर्वाक्पथ उरुज्रयः कृणुध्वं श्रोता दूतस्य जग्मुषो नो अस्य ॥
verses.rom:
jmaya atra vasavo ranta deva uravantarikshe marjayanta shubhrah |
arvakpatha urujrayah krinudhvam shrota dutasya jagmusho no asya ||
verses.en:
Here on their path the noble Gods proceeded: in the wide firmament the Beauteous decked them.
Bend your way hither, ye who travel widely: hear this our envoy who hath gone to meet you.

verses.sa:
ते हि यज्ञेषु यज्ञियास ऊमाः सधस्थं विश्वे अभि सन्ति देवाः ।
ताँ अध्वर उशतो यक्ष्यग्ने श्रुष्टी भगं नासत्या पुरंधिम् ॥
verses.rom:
te hi yajneshu yajniyasa umah sadhastham vishve abhi santi devah |
tan adhvara ushato yakshyagne shrushti bhagam nasatya puramdhim ||
verses.en:
For they are holy aids at sacrifices: all Gods approach the place of congregation.
Bring these, desirous, to our worship, Agni, swift the Nisatyas, Bhaga, and Purandhi.

verses.sa:
आग्ने गिरो दिव आ पृथिव्या मित्रं वह वरुणमिन्द्रमग्निम् ।
आर्यमणमदितिं विष्णुमेषां सरस्वती मरुतो मादयन्ताम् ॥
verses.rom:
agne giro diva a prithivya mitram vaha varunamindramagnim |
aryamanamaditim vishnumesham sarasvati maruto madayantam ||
verses.en:
Agni, to these men's hymns, from earth, from heaven, bring Mitra, Varuna, Indra, and Agni,
And Aryaman, and Aditi, and Visnu. Sarasvati be joyful, and the Maruts.

verses.sa:
ररे हव्यं मतिभिर्यज्ञियानां नक्षत्कामं मर्त्यानामसिन्वन् ।
धाता रयिमविदस्यं सदासां सक्षीमहि युज्येभिर्नु देवैः ॥
verses.rom:
rare havyam matibhiryajniyanam nakshatkamam martyanamasinvan |
dhata rayimavidasyam sadasam sakshimahi yujyebhirnu devaih ||
verses.en:
Even as the holy wish, the gift is offered: may he, unsated, come when men desire him.
Give never-failing ever-conquering riches: with Gods for our allies may we be victors.

verses.sa:
नू रोदसी अभिष्टुते वसिष्ठैरृतावानो वरुणो मित्रो अग्निः ।
यच्छन्तु चन्द्रा उपमं नो अर्कं यूयं पात स्वस्तिभिः सदा नः ॥
verses.rom:
nu rodasi abhishtute vasishthairritavano varuno mitro agnih |
yachchhantu chandra upamam no arkam yuyam pata svastibhih sada nah ||
verses.en:
Now have both worlds been praised by the Vasisthas; and holy Mitra, Varuna, and Agni.
May they, bright Deities, make our song supremest. Preserve us evermore, ye Gods, with blessings.

verses.sa:
ओ श्रुष्टिर्विदथ्या समेतु प्रति स्तोमं दधीमहि तुराणाम् ।
यदद्य देवः सविता सुवाति स्यामास्य रत्निनो विभागे ॥
verses.rom:
o shrushtirvidathya sametu prati stomam dadhimahi turanam |
yadadya devah savita suvati syamasya ratnino vibhage ||
verses.en:
BE gathered all the audience of the synod: let us begin their praise whose course is rapid.
Whate'er God Savitar this day produces, may we be where the Wealthy One distributes.

verses.sa:
मित्रस्तन्नो वरुणो रोदसी च द्युभक्तमिन्द्रो अर्यमा ददातु ।
दिदेष्टु देव्यदिती रेक्णो वायुश्च यन्नियुवैते भगश्च ॥
verses.rom:
mitrastanno varuno rodasi cha dyubhaktamindro aryama dadatu |
dideshtu devyaditi rekno vayushcha yanniyuvaite bhagashcha ||
verses.en:
This, dealt from heaven ' may both the Worlds vouchsafe us, and Varuna, Indra, Aryaman, and Mitra.
May Goddess Aditi assign us riches, Vayu and Bhaga make them ours for ever.

verses.sa:
सेदुग्रो अस्तु मरुतः स शुष्मी यं मर्त्यं पृषदश्वा अवाथ ।
उतेमग्निः सरस्वती जुनन्ति न तस्य रायः पर्येतास्ति ॥
verses.rom:
sedugro astu marutah sa shushmi yam martyam prishadashva avatha |
utemagnih sarasvati junanti na tasya rayah paryetasti ||
verses.en:
Strong be the man and full of power, O Maruts, whom ye, borne on by spotted coursers, favour.
Him, too, Sarasvati and Agni further, and there is none to rob him of his riches.

verses.sa:
अयं हि नेता वरुण ऋतस्य मित्रो राजानो अर्यमापो धुः ।
सुहवा देव्यदितिरनर्वा ते नो अंहो अति पर्षन्नरिष्टान् ॥
verses.rom:
ayam hi neta varuna ritasya mitro rajano aryamapo dhuh |
suhava devyaditiranarva te no amho ati parshannarishtan ||
verses.en:
This Varuna is guide of Law, he, Mitra, and Aryaman, the Kings, our work have finished.
Divine and foeless Aditi quickly listens. May these deliver us unharmed from trouble.

verses.sa:
अस्य देवस्य मीळ्हुषो वया विष्णोरेषस्य प्रभृथे हविर्भिः ।
विदे हि रुद्रो रुद्रियं महित्वं यासिष्टं वर्तिरश्विनाविरावत् ॥
verses.rom:
asya devasya milhusho vaya vishnoreshasya prabhrithe havirbhih |
vide hi rudro rudriyam mahitvam yasishtam vartirashvinaviravat ||
verses.en:
With offerings I propitiate the branches of this swift-moving God, the bounteous Visnu.
Hence Rudra gained his Rudra-strength: O Asvins, ye sought the house that hath celestial viands.

verses.sa:
मात्र पूषन्नाघृण इरस्यो वरूत्री यद्रातिषाचश्च रासन् ।
मयोभुवो नो अर्वन्तो नि पान्तु वृष्टिं परिज्मा वातो ददातु ॥
verses.rom:
matra pushannaghrina irasyo varutri yadratishachashcha rasan |
mayobhuvo no arvanto ni pantu vrishtim parijma vato dadatu ||
verses.en:
Be not thou angry here, O glowing Pusan, for what Varutri and the Bounteous gave us.
May the swift-moving Gods protect and bless us, and Vata send us rain, wha wanders round us.

verses.sa:
नू रोदसी अभिष्टुते वसिष्ठैरृतावानो वरुणो मित्रो अग्निः ।
यच्छन्तु चन्द्रा उपमं नो अर्कं यूयं पात स्वस्तिभिः सदा नः ॥
verses.rom:
nu rodasi abhishtute vasishthairritavano varuno mitro agnih |
yachchhantu chandra upamam no arkam yuyam pata svastibhih sada nah ||
verses.en:
Now have both worlds been praised by the Vasisthas, and holy Mitra, Varuna, and Agni.
May they, bright Deities, make our song supremest. Preserve us evermore, ye Gods, with blessings.

verses.sa:
प्रातरग्निं प्रातरिन्द्रं हवामहे प्रातर्मित्रावरुणा प्रातरश्विना ।
प्रातर्भगं पूषणं ब्रह्मणस्पतिं प्रातः सोममुत रुद्रं हुवेम ॥
verses.rom:
prataragnim pratarindram havamahe pratarmitravaruna pratarashvina |
pratarbhagam pushanam brahmanaspatim pratah somamuta rudram huvema ||
verses.en:
AGNI at dawn, and Indra we invoke at dawn, and Varuna and Mitra, and the Asvins twain.
Bhaga at dawn, Pusan, and Brahmanaspati, Soma at dawn, Rudra we will invoke at dawn.

verses.sa:
प्रातर्जितं भगमुग्रं हुवेम वयं पुत्रमदितेर्यो विधर्ता ।
आध्रश्चिद्यं मन्यमानस्तुरश्चिद्राजा चिद्यं भगं भक्षीत्याह ॥
verses.rom:
pratarjitam bhagamugram huvema vayam putramaditeryo vidharta |
adhrashchidyam manyamanasturashchidraja chidyam bhagam bhakshityaha ||
verses.en:
We will invoke strong, early-conquering Bhaga, the Son of Aditi, the great supporter:
Thinking of whom, the poor, yea, even the mighty, even the King himself says, Give me Bhaga.

verses.sa:
भग प्रणेतर्भग सत्यराधो भगेमां धियमुदवा ददन्नः ।
भग प्र णो जनय गोभिरश्वैर्भग प्र नृभिर्नृवन्तः स्याम ॥
verses.rom:
bhaga pranetarbhaga satyaradho bhagemam dhiyamudava dadannah |
bhaga pra no janaya gobhirashvairbhaga pra nribhirnrivantah syama ||
