verses.sa:
जनीयन्तो न्वग्रवः पुत्रीयन्तः सुदानवः ।
सरस्वन्तं हवामहे ॥
verses.rom:
janiyanto nvagravah putriyantah sudanavah |
sarasvantam havamahe ||
verses.en:
We call upon Sarasvan, as unmarried men who long for wives,
As liberal men who yearn for sons.

verses.sa:
ये ते सरस्व ऊर्मयो मधुमन्तो घृतश्चुतः ।
तेभिर्नोऽविता भव ॥
verses.rom:
ye te sarasva urmayo madhumanto ghritashchutah |
tebhirno'vita bhava ||
verses.en:
Be thou our kind protector, O Sarasvan, with those waves of thine
Laden with sweets and dropping oil.

verses.sa:
पीपिवांसं सरस्वत स्तनं यो विश्वदर्शतः ।
भक्षीमहि प्रजामिषम् ॥
verses.rom:
pipivamsam sarasvata stanam yo vishvadarshatah |
bhakshimahi prajamisham ||
verses.en:
May we enjoy Sarasvan's breast, all-beautiful, that swells with streams,
May we gain food and progeny.

verses.sa:
यज्ञे दिवो नृषदने पृथिव्या नरो यत्र देवयवो मदन्ति ।
इन्द्राय यत्र सवनानि सुन्वे गमन्मदाय प्रथमं वयश्च ॥
verses.rom:
yajne divo nrishadane prithivya naro yatra devayavo madanti |
indraya yatra savanani sunve gamanmadaya prathamam vayashcha ||
verses.en:
WHERE Heaven and Earth combine in men's assembly, and those who love the Gods delight in worship,
Where the libations are effused for Indra, may he come first to drink and make him stronger.

verses.sa:
आ दैव्या वृणीमहेऽवांसि बृहस्पतिर्नो मह आ सखायः ।
यथा भवेम मीळ्हुषे अनागा यो नो दाता परावतः पितेव ॥
verses.rom:
a daivya vrinimahe'vamsi brihaspatirno maha a sakhayah |
yatha bhavema milhushe anaga yo no data paravatah piteva ||
verses.en:
We crave the heavenly grace of Gods to guard us-so may Brhaspati, O friends, exalt us-
That he, the Bounteous God, may find us sinless, who giveth from a distance like a father.

verses.sa:
तमु ज्येष्ठं नमसा हविर्भिः सुशेवं ब्रह्मणस्पतिं गृणीषे ।
इन्द्रं श्लोको महि दैव्यः सिषक्तु यो ब्रह्मणो देवकृतस्य राजा ॥
verses.rom:
tamu jyeshtham namasa havirbhih sushevam brahmanaspatim grinishe |
indram shloko mahi daivyah sishaktu yo brahmano devakritasya raja ||
verses.en:
That Brahmanaspati, most High and Gracious, I glorify with offerings and with homage.
May the great song of praise divine, reach Indra who is the King of prayer the Gods' creation.

verses.sa:
स आ नो योनिं सदतु प्रेष्ठो बृहस्पतिर्विश्ववारो यो अस्ति ।
कामो रायः सुवीर्यस्य तं दात्पर्षन्नो अति सश्चतो अरिष्टान् ॥
verses.rom:
sa a no yonim sadatu preshtho brihaspatirvishvavaro yo asti |
kamo rayah suviryasya tam datparshanno ati sashchato arishtan ||
verses.en:
May that Brhaspati who brings all blessings, most dearly loved, be seated by our altar.
Heroes and wealth we crave; may he bestow them, and bear us safe beyond the men who vex us.

verses.sa:
तमा नो अर्कममृताय जुष्टमिमे धासुरमृतासः पुराजाः ।
शुचिक्रन्दं यजतं पस्त्यानां बृहस्पतिमनर्वाणं हुवेम ॥
verses.rom:
tama no arkamamritaya jushtamime dhasuramritasah purajah |
shuchikrandam yajatam pastyanam brihaspatimanarvanam huvema ||
verses.en:
To us these Deathless Ones, erst born, have granted this laud of ours which gives the Immortal pleasure.
Let us invoke Brhaspati, the foeless, the clear-voiced God, the Holy One of households

verses.sa:
तं शग्मासो अरुषासो अश्वा बृहस्पतिं सहवाहो वहन्ति ।
सहश्चिद्यस्य नीलवत्सधस्थं नभो न रूपमरुषं वसानाः ॥
verses.rom:
tam shagmaso arushaso ashva brihaspatim sahavaho vahanti |
sahashchidyasya nilavatsadhastham nabho na rupamarusham vasanah ||
verses.en:
Him, this Brhaspati, his red-hued horses, drawing together, full of strength, bring hither.
Robed in red colour like the cloud, they carry the Lord of Might whose friendship gives a dwelling.

verses.sa:
स हि शुचिः शतपत्रः स शुन्ध्युर्हिरण्यवाशीरिषिरः स्वर्षाः ।
बृहस्पतिः स स्वावेश ऋष्वः पुरू सखिभ्य आसुतिं करिष्ठः ॥
verses.rom:
sa hi shuchih shatapatrah sa shundhyurhiranyavashirishirah svarshah |
brihaspatih sa svavesha rishvah puru sakhibhya asutim karishthah ||
verses.en:
For he is pure, with hundred wings, refulgent, with sword of gold, impetuous, winning sunlight.
Sublime Brhaspati, easy of access granteth his friends most bountiful refreshment.

verses.sa:
देवी देवस्य रोदसी जनित्री बृहस्पतिं वावृधतुर्महित्वा ।
दक्षाय्याय दक्षता सखायः करद्ब्रह्मणे सुतरा सुगाधा ॥
verses.rom:
devi devasya rodasi janitri brihaspatim vavridhaturmahitva |
dakshayyaya dakshata sakhayah karadbrahmane sutara sugadha ||
verses.en:
Both Heaven and Earth, divine, the Deity's Parents, have made Brhaspati increase in grandeur.
Glorify him, O friends, who merits glory: may he give prayer fair way and easy passage.

verses.sa:
इयं वां ब्रह्मणस्पते सुवृक्तिर्ब्रह्मेन्द्राय वज्रिणे अकारि ।
अविष्टं धियो जिगृतं पुरंधीर्जजस्तमर्यो वनुषामरातीः ॥
verses.rom:
iyam vam brahmanaspate suvriktirbrahmendraya vajrine akari |
avishtam dhiyo jigritam puramdhirjajastamaryo vanushamaratih ||
verses.en:
This, Brahmanaspati, is your laudation prayer hath been made to thunder wielding Indra.
Favour our songs, wake up our thought and spirit: destroy the godless and our foemen's malice.

verses.sa:
बृहस्पते युवमिन्द्रश्च वस्वो दिव्यस्येशाथे उत पार्थिवस्य ।
धत्तं रयिं स्तुवते कीरये चिद्यूयं पात स्वस्तिभिः सदा नः ॥
verses.rom:
brihaspate yuvamindrashcha vasvo divyasyeshathe uta parthivasya |
dhattam rayim stuvate kiraye chidyuyam pata svastibhih sada nah ||
verses.en:
Ye Twain are Lords of wealth in earth and heaven, thou, O Brhaspati, and thou, O Indra.
Mean though he be, give wealth to him who lauds you. Preserve us evermore, ye Gods, with blessings.

verses.sa:
अध्वर्यवोऽरुणं दुग्धमंशुं जुहोतन वृषभाय क्षितीनाम् ।
गौराद्वेदीयाँ अवपानमिन्द्रो विश्वाहेद्याति सुतसोममिच्छन् ॥
verses.rom:
adhvaryavo'runam dugdhamamshum juhotana vrishabhaya kshitinam |
gauradvediyan avapanamindro vishvahedyati sutasomamichchhan ||
verses.en:
PRIESTS, offer to the Lord of all the people the milked-out stalk of Soma, radiant-coloured.
No wild-bull knows his drinking-place like Indra who ever seeks him who hath pressed the Soma,

verses.sa:
यद्दधिषे प्रदिवि चार्वन्नं दिवेदिवे पीतिमिदस्य वक्षि ।
उत हृदोत मनसा जुषाण उशन्निन्द्र प्रस्थितान्पाहि सोमान् ॥
verses.rom:
yaddadhishe pradivi charvannam divedive pitimidasya vakshi |
uta hridota manasa jushana ushannindra prasthitanpahi soman ||
verses.en:
Thou dost desire to drink, each day that passes, the pleasant food which thou hast had aforetime,
O Indra, gratified in heart and spirit, drink eagerly the Soma set before thee.

verses.sa:
जज्ञानः सोमं सहसे पपाथ प्र ते माता महिमानमुवाच ।
एन्द्र पप्राथोर्वन्तरिक्षं युधा देवेभ्यो वरिवश्चकर्थ ॥
verses.rom:
jajnanah somam sahase papatha pra te mata mahimanamuvacha |
endra paprathorvantariksham yudha devebhyo varivashchakartha ||
verses.en:
Thou, newly-born, for strength didst drink the Soma; the Mother told thee of thy future greatness.
O Indra, thou hast filled mid-air's wide region, and given the Gods by battle room and freedom.

verses.sa:
यद्योधया महतो मन्यमानान्साक्षाम तान्बाहुभिः शाशदानान् ।
यद्वा नृभिर्वृत इन्द्राभियुध्यास्तं त्वयाजिं सौश्रवसं जयेम ॥
verses.rom:
yadyodhaya mahato manyamanansakshama tanbahubhih shashadanan |
yadva nribhirvrita indrabhiyudhyastam tvayajim saushravasam jayema ||
verses.en:
When thou hast urged the arrogant to combat, proud in their strength of arm, we will subdue them.
Or, Indra, when thou fightest girt by heroes, we in the glorious fray with thee will conquer.

verses.sa:
प्रेन्द्रस्य वोचं प्रथमा कृतानि प्र नूतना मघवा या चकार ।
यदेददेवीरसहिष्ट माया अथाभवत्केवलः सोमो अस्य ॥
verses.rom:
prendrasya vocham prathama kritani pra nutana maghava ya chakara |
yadedadevirasahishta maya athabhavatkevalah somo asya ||
verses.en:
I will declare the earliest deeds of Indra, and recent acts which Maghavan hath accomplished.
When he had conquered godless wiles and magic, Soma became his own entire possession.

verses.sa:
तवेदं विश्वमभितः पशव्यं यत्पश्यसि चक्षसा सूर्यस्य ।
गवामसि गोपतिरेक इन्द्र भक्षीमहि ते प्रयतस्य वस्वः ॥
verses.rom:
tavedam vishvamabhitah pashavyam yatpashyasi chakshasa suryasya |
gavamasi gopatireka indra bhakshimahi te prayatasya vasvah ||
verses.en:
Thine is this world of flocks and herds around thee, which with the eye of Surya thou beholdest.
Thou, Indra, art alone the Lord of cattle; may we enjoy the treasure which thou givest.

verses.sa:
बृहस्पते युवमिन्द्रश्च वस्वो दिव्यस्येशाथे उत पार्थिवस्य ।
धत्तं रयिं स्तुवते कीरये चिद्यूयं पात स्वस्तिभिः सदा नः ॥
verses.rom:
brihaspate yuvamindrashcha vasvo divyasyeshathe uta parthivasya |
dhattam rayim stuvate kiraye chidyuyam pata svastibhih sada nah ||
verses.en:
Ye Twain are Lords of wealth in earth and heaven, thou, O Brhaspati, and thou, O Indra.
Mean though he be, give wealth to him who lauds you. Preserve us evermore, ye Gods, with blessings.

verses.sa:
परो मात्रया तन्वा वृधान न ते महित्वमन्वश्नुवन्ति ।
उभे ते विद्म रजसी पृथिव्या विष्णो देव त्वं परमस्य वित्से ॥
verses.rom:
paro matraya tanva vridhana na te mahitvamanvashnuvanti |
ubhe te vidma rajasi prithivya vishno deva tvam paramasya vitse ||
verses.en:
MEN come not nigh thy majesty who growest beyond all bound and measure with thy body.
Both thy two regions of the earth, O Visnu, we know: thou God, knowest the highest also.

verses.sa:
न ते विष्णो जायमानो न जातो देव महिम्नः परमन्तमाप ।
उदस्तभ्ना नाकमृष्वं बृहन्तं दाधर्थ प्राचीं ककुभं पृथिव्याः ॥
verses.rom:
na te vishno jayamano na jato deva mahimnah paramantamapa |
udastabhna nakamrishvam brihantam dadhartha prachim kakubham prithivyah ||
verses.en:
None who is born or being born, God Visnu, hath reached the utmost limit of thy grandeur.
The vast high vault of heaven hast thou supported, and fixed earth's eastern pinnacle securely.

verses.sa:
इरावती धेनुमती हि भूतं सूयवसिनी मनुषे दशस्या ।
व्यस्तभ्ना रोदसी विष्णवेते दाधर्थ पृथिवीमभितो मयूखैः ॥
verses.rom:
iravati dhenumati hi bhutam suyavasini manushe dashasya |
vyastabhna rodasi vishnavete dadhartha prithivimabhito mayukhaih ||
verses.en:
Rich in sweet food be ye, and rich in milch-kine, with fertile pastures, fain to do men service.
Both these worlds, Visnu, hast thou stayed asunder, and firmly fixed the earth with pegs around it.

verses.sa:
उरुं यज्ञाय चक्रथुरु लोकं जनयन्ता सूर्यमुषासमग्निम् ।
दासस्य चिद्वृषशिप्रस्य माया जघ्नथुर्नरा पृतनाज्येषु ॥
verses.rom:
urum yajnaya chakrathuru lokam janayanta suryamushasamagnim |
dasasya chidvrishashiprasya maya jaghnathurnara pritanajyeshu ||
verses.en:
Ye have made spacious room for sacrificing by generating Surya, Dawn, and Agni.
O Heroes, ye have conquered in your battles even the bull-jawed Dasa's wiles and magic.

verses.sa:
इन्द्राविष्णू दृंहिताः शम्बरस्य नव पुरो नवतिं च श्नथिष्टम् ।
शतं वर्चिनः सहस्रं च साकं हथो अप्रत्यसुरस्य वीरान् ॥
verses.rom:
indravishnu drimhitah shambarasya nava puro navatim cha shnathishtam |
shatam varchinah sahasram cha sakam hatho apratyasurasya viran ||
verses.en:
Ye have destroyed, thou, Indra, and thou Visnu, Sambara's nine-and-ninety fenced castles.
Ye Twain smote down a hundred times a thousand resistless heroes of the royal Varcin.

verses.sa:
इयं मनीषा बृहती बृहन्तोरुक्रमा तवसा वर्धयन्ती ।
ररे वां स्तोमं विदथेषु विष्णो पिन्वतमिषो वृजनेष्विन्द्र ॥
verses.rom:
iyam manisha brihati brihantorukrama tavasa vardhayanti |
rare vam stomam vidatheshu vishno pinvatamisho vrijaneshvindra ||
verses.en:
This is the lofty hymn of praise, exalting the Lords of Mighty Stride, the strong and lofty.
I laud you in the solemn synods, Visnu: pour ye food on us in our camps, O Indra.

verses.sa:
वषट् ते विष्णवास आ कृणोमि तन्मे जुषस्व शिपिविष्ट हव्यम् ।
वर्धन्तु त्वा सुष्टुतयो गिरो मे यूयं पात स्वस्तिभिः सदा नः ॥
verses.rom:
vashat te vishnavasa a krinomi tanme jushasva shipivishta havyam |
vardhantu tva sushtutayo giro me yuyam pata svastibhih sada nah ||
verses.en:
O Visnu, unto thee my lips cry Vasat! Let this mine offering, Sipivista, please thee.
May these my songs of eulogy exalt thee. Preserve us evermore, ye Gods, with blessings.

verses.sa:
नू मर्तो दयते सनिष्यन्यो विष्णव उरुगायाय दाशत् ।
प्र यः सत्राचा मनसा यजात एतावन्तं नर्यमाविवासात् ॥
verses.rom:
nu marto dayate sanishyanyo vishnava urugayaya dashat |
pra yah satracha manasa yajata etavantam naryamavivasat ||
verses.en:
NE'ER doth the man repent, who, seeking profit, bringeth his gift to the far-striding Visnu.
He who adoreth him with all his spirit winneth himself so great a benefactor.

verses.sa:
त्वं विष्णो सुमतिं विश्वजन्यामप्रयुतामेवयावो मतिं दाः ।
पर्चो यथा नः सुवितस्य भूरेरश्वावतः पुरुश्चन्द्रस्य रायः ॥
verses.rom:
tvam vishno sumatim vishvajanyamaprayutamevayavo matim dah |
parcho yatha nah suvitasya bhurerashvavatah purushchandrasya rayah ||
verses.en:
Thou, Visnu, constant in thy courses, gavest good-will to all men, and a hymn that lasteth,
That thou mightst move us to abundant comfort of very splendid wealth with store of horses.

verses.sa:
त्रिर्देवः पृथिवीमेष एतां वि चक्रमे शतर्चसं महित्वा ।
प्र विष्णुरस्तु तवसस्तवीयान्त्वेषं ह्यस्य स्थविरस्य नाम ॥
verses.rom:
trirdevah prithivimesha etam vi chakrame shatarchasam mahitva |
pra vishnurastu tavasastaviyantvesham hyasya sthavirasya nama ||
verses.en:
Three times strode forth this God in all his grandeur over this earth bright with a hundred splendours.
Foremost be Visnu, stronger than the strongest: for glorious is his name who lives for ever.

verses.sa:
वि चक्रमे पृथिवीमेष एतां क्षेत्राय विष्णुर्मनुषे दशस्यन् ।
ध्रुवासो अस्य कीरयो जनास उरुक्षितिं सुजनिमा चकार ॥
verses.rom:
vi chakrame prithivimesha etam kshetraya vishnurmanushe dashasyan |
dhruvaso asya kirayo janasa urukshitim sujanima chakara ||
verses.en:
Over this earth with mighty step strode Visnu, ready to give it for a home to Manu.
In him the humble people trust for safety: he, nobly born, hath made them spacious dwellings.

verses.sa:
प्र तत्ते अद्य शिपिविष्ट नामार्यः शंसामि वयुनानि विद्वान् ।
तं त्वा गृणामि तवसमतव्यान्क्षयन्तमस्य रजसः पराके ॥
verses.rom:
pra tatte adya shipivishta namaryah shamsami vayunani vidvan |
tam tva grinami tavasamatavyankshayantamasya rajasah parake ||
verses.en:
To-day I laud this name, O gipivista, I, skilled in rules, the name of thee the Noble.
Yea, I the poor and weak praise thee the Mighty who dwellest in the realm beyond this region.

verses.sa:
किमित्ते विष्णो परिचक्ष्यं भूत्प्र यद्ववक्षे शिपिविष्टो अस्मि ।
मा वर्पो अस्मदप गूह एतद्यदन्यरूपः समिथे बभूथ ॥
verses.rom:
kimitte vishno parichakshyam bhutpra yadvavakshe shipivishto asmi |
ma varpo asmadapa guha etadyadanyarupah samithe babhutha ||
verses.en:
What was there to be blamed in thee, O Visnu, when thou declaredst, I am Sipivista?
Hide not this form from us, nor keep it secret, since thou didst wear another shape in battle.

verses.sa:
वषट् ते विष्णवास आ कृणोमि तन्मे जुषस्व शिपिविष्ट हव्यम् ।
वर्धन्तु त्वा सुष्टुतयो गिरो मे यूयं पात स्वस्तिभिः सदा नः ॥
verses.rom:
vashat te vishnavasa a krinomi tanme jushasva shipivishta havyam |
vardhantu tva sushtutayo giro me yuyam pata svastibhih sada nah ||
verses.en:
O Visnu, unto thee my lips cry Vasat! Let this mine offering, Sipivista, please thee.
May these my songs of eulogy exalt thee. Preserve us evermore, ye Gods, with blessings.

verses.sa:
तिस्रो वाचः प्र वद ज्योतिरग्रा या एतद्दुह्रे मधुदोघमूधः ।
स वत्सं कृण्वन्गर्भमोषधीनां सद्यो जातो वृषभो रोरवीति ॥
verses.rom:
tisro vachah pra vada jyotiragra ya etadduhre madhudoghamudhah |
sa vatsam krinvangarbhamoshadhinam sadyo jato vrishabho roraviti ||
verses.en:
SPEAK forth three words, the words which light precedeth, which milk this udder that produceth nectar.
Quickly made manifest, the Bull hath bellowed, engendering the germ of plants, the Infant.

verses.sa:
यो वर्धन ओषधीनां यो अपां यो विश्वस्य जगतो देव ईशे ।
स त्रिधातु शरणं शर्म यंसत्त्रिवर्तु ज्योतिः स्वभिष्ट्यस्मे ॥
verses.rom:
yo vardhana oshadhinam yo apam yo vishvasya jagato deva ishe |
sa tridhatu sharanam sharma yamsattrivartu jyotih svabhishtyasme ||
verses.en:
Giver of growth to plants, the God who ruleth over the waters and all moving creatures,
Vouchsafe us triple shelter for our refuge, and threefold light to succour and befriend us.

verses.sa:
स्तरीरु त्वद्भवति सूत उ त्वद्यथावशं तन्वं चक्र एषः ।
पितुः पयः प्रति गृभ्णाति माता तेन पिता वर्धते तेन पुत्रः ॥
verses.rom:
stariru tvadbhavati suta u tvadyathavasham tanvam chakra eshah |
pituh payah prati gribhnati mata tena pita vardhate tena putrah ||
verses.en:
Now he is sterile, now begetteth offspring, even as he willeth doth he change his figure.
The Father's genial flow bedews the Mother; therewith the Sire, therewith the son is nourished.

verses.sa:
यस्मिन्विश्वानि भुवनानि तस्थुस्तिस्रो द्यावस्त्रेधा सस्रुरापः ।
त्रयः कोशास उपसेचनासो मध्व श्चोतन्त्यभितो विरप्शम् ॥
verses.rom:
yasminvishvani bhuvanani tasthustisro dyavastredha sasrurapah |
trayah koshasa upasechanaso madhva shchotantyabhito virapsham ||
verses.en:
In him all living creatures have their being, and the three heavens with triply flowing waters.
Three reservoirs that sprinkle down their treasure shed their sweet streams around him with a murmur.

verses.sa:
इदं वचः पर्जन्याय स्वराजे हृदो अस्त्वन्तरं तज्जुजोषत् ।
मयोभुवो वृष्टयः सन्त्वस्मे सुपिप्पला ओषधीर्देवगोपाः ॥
verses.rom:
idam vachah parjanyaya svaraje hrido astvantaram tajjujoshat |
mayobhuvo vrishtayah santvasme supippala oshadhirdevagopah ||
verses.en:
May this my song to Sovran Lord Parjanya come near unto his heart and give him pleasure.
May we obtain the showers that bring enjoyment, and God-protected plants with goodly fruitage.

verses.sa:
स रेतोधा वृषभः शश्वतीनां तस्मिन्नात्मा जगतस्तस्थुषश्च ।
तन्म ऋतं पातु शतशारदाय यूयं पात स्वस्तिभिः सदा नः ॥
verses.rom:
sa retodha vrishabhah shashvatinam tasminnatma jagatastasthushashcha |
tanma ritam patu shatasharadaya yuyam pata svastibhih sada nah ||
verses.en:
He is the Bull of all, and their impregner lie holds the life of all things fixed and moving.
May this rite save me till my hundredth autumn. Preserve us evermore, ye Gods, with blessings.

verses.sa:
पर्जन्याय प्र गायत दिवस्पुत्राय मीळ्हुषे ।
स नो यवसमिच्छतु ॥
verses.rom:
parjanyaya pra gayata divasputraya milhushe |
sa no yavasamichchhatu ||
verses.en:
SING forth and laud Parjanya, son of Heaven, who sends the gift of rain
May he provide our pasturage.

verses.sa:
यो गर्भमोषधीनां गवां कृणोत्यर्वताम् ।
पर्जन्यः पुरुषीणाम् ॥
verses.rom:
yo garbhamoshadhinam gavam krinotyarvatam |
parjanyah purushinam ||
verses.en:
Parjanya is the God who forms in kine, in mares, in plants of earth,
And womankind, the germ of life.

verses.sa:
तस्मा इदास्ये हविर्जुहोता मधुमत्तमम् ।
इळां नः संयतं करत् ॥
verses.rom:
tasma idasye havirjuhota madhumattamam |
ilam nah samyatam karat ||
verses.en:
Offer and pour into his mouth oblation rich in savoury juice:
May he for ever give us food.

verses.sa:
संवत्सरं शशयाना ब्राह्मणा व्रतचारिणः ।
वाचं पर्जन्यजिन्वितां प्र मण्डूका अवादिषुः ॥
verses.rom:
samvatsaram shashayana brahmana vratacharinah |
vacham parjanyajinvitam pra manduka avadishuh ||
verses.en:
THEY who lay quiet for a year, the Brahmans who fulfil their vows,
The Frogs have lifted up their voice, the voice Parjanya hath inspired.

verses.sa:
दिव्या आपो अभि यदेनमायन्दृतिं न शुष्कं सरसी शयानम् ।
गवामह न मायुर्वत्सिनीनां मण्डूकानां वग्नुरत्रा समेति ॥
verses.rom:
divya apo abhi yadenamayandritim na shushkam sarasi shayanam |
gavamaha na mayurvatsininam mandukanam vagnuratra sameti ||
verses.en:
What time on these, as on a dry skin lying in the pool's bed, the floods of heaven descended,
The music of the Frogs comes forth in concert like the cows lowing with their calves beside them.

verses.sa:
यदीमेनाँ उशतो अभ्यवर्षीत्तृष्यावतः प्रावृष्यागतायाम् ।
अख्खलीकृत्या पितरं न पुत्रो अन्यो अन्यमुप वदन्तमेति ॥
verses.rom:
yadimenan ushato abhyavarshittrishyavatah pravrishyagatayam |
akhkhalikritya pitaram na putro anyo anyamupa vadantameti ||
verses.en:
When at the coming of the Rains the water has poured upon them as they yearned and thirsted,
One seeks another as he talks and greets him with cries of pleasure as a son his father.

verses.sa:
अन्यो अन्यमनु गृभ्णात्येनोरपां प्रसर्गे यदमन्दिषाताम् ।
मण्डूको यदभिवृष्टः कनिष्कन्पृश्निः सम्पृङ्क्ते हरितेन वाचम् ॥
verses.rom:
anyo anyamanu gribhnatyenorapam prasarge yadamandishatam |
manduko yadabhivrishtah kanishkanprishnih samprinkte haritena vacham ||
verses.en:
Each of these twain receives the other kindly, while they are revelling in the flow of waters,
When the Frog moistened by the rain springs forward, and Green and Spotty both combine their voices.

verses.sa:
यदेषामन्यो अन्यस्य वाचं शाक्तस्येव वदति शिक्षमाणः ।
सर्वं तदेषां समृधेव पर्व यत्सुवाचो वदथनाध्यप्सु ॥
verses.rom:
yadeshamanyo anyasya vacham shaktasyeva vadati shikshamanah |
sarvam tadesham samridheva parva yatsuvacho vadathanadhyapsu ||
verses.en:
When one of these repeats the other's language, as he who learns the lesson of the teacher,
Your every limb seems to be growing larger as ye converse with eloquence on the waters.

verses.sa:
गोमायुरेको अजमायुरेकः पृश्निरेको हरित एक एषाम् ।
समानं नाम बिभ्रतो विरूपाः पुरुत्रा वाचं पिपिशुर्वदन्तः ॥
verses.rom:
gomayureko ajamayurekah prishnireko harita eka esham |
samanam nama bibhrato virupah purutra vacham pipishurvadantah ||
verses.en:
Onc is Cow-bellow and Goat-bleat the other, one Frog is Green and one of them is Spotty.
They bear one common name, and yet they vary, and, talking, modulate the voice diversely.

verses.sa:
ब्राह्मणासो अतिरात्रे न सोमे सरो न पूर्णमभितो वदन्तः ।
संवत्सरस्य तदहः परि ष्ठ यन्मण्डूकाः प्रावृषीणं बभूव ॥
verses.rom:
brahmanaso atiratre na some saro na purnamabhito vadantah |
samvatsarasya tadahah pari shtha yanmandukah pravrishinam babhuva ||
verses.en:
As Brahmans, sitting round the brimful vessel, talk at the Soma-rite of Atiratra,
So, Frogs, ye gather round the pool to honour this day of all the year, the first of Rain-time.

verses.sa:
ब्राह्मणासः सोमिनो वाचमक्रत ब्रह्म कृण्वन्तः परिवत्सरीणम् ।
अध्वर्यवो घर्मिणः सिष्विदाना आविर्भवन्ति गुह्या न के चित् ॥
verses.rom:
brahmanasah somino vachamakrata brahma krinvantah parivatsarinam |
adhvaryavo gharminah sishvidana avirbhavanti guhya na ke chit ||
verses.en:
These Brahmans with the Soma juice, performing their year-long rite, have lifted up their voices;
And these Adhvaryus, sweating with their kettles, come forth and show themselves, and none are hidden.

verses.sa:
देवहितिं जुगुपुर्द्वादशस्य ऋतुं नरो न प्र मिनन्त्येते ।
संवत्सरे प्रावृष्यागतायां तप्ता घर्मा अश्नुवते विसर्गम् ॥
verses.rom:
devahitim jugupurdvadashasya ritum naro na pra minantyete |
samvatsare pravrishyagatayam tapta gharma ashnuvate visargam ||
verses.en:
They keep the twelve month's God-appointed order, and never do the men neglect the season.
Soon as the Rain-time in the year returneth, these who were heated kettles gain their freedom.

verses.sa:
गोमायुरदादजमायुरदात्पृश्निरदाद्धरितो नो वसूनि ।
गवां मण्डूका ददतः शतानि सहस्रसावे प्र तिरन्त आयुः ॥
verses.rom:
gomayuradadajamayuradatprishniradaddharito no vasuni |
gavam manduka dadatah shatani sahasrasave pra tiranta ayuh ||
verses.en:
Cow-bellow and Goat-bleat have granted riches, and Green and Spotty have vouchsafed us treasure.
The Frogs who give us cows in hundreds lengthen our lives in this most fertilizing season.

verses.sa:
इन्द्रासोमा तपतं रक्ष उब्जतं न्यर्पयतं वृषणा तमोवृधः ।
परा शृणीतमचितो न्योषतं हतं नुदेथां नि शिशीतमत्रिणः ॥
verses.rom:
indrasoma tapatam raksha ubjatam nyarpayatam vrishana tamovridhah |
para shrinitamachito nyoshatam hatam nudetham ni shishitamatrinah ||
verses.en:
INDRA and Soma, burn, destroy the demon foe, send downward, O ye Bulls, those who add gloom to gloom.
Annihilate the fools, slay them and burn them up: chase them away from us, pierce the voracious ones.

verses.sa:
इन्द्रासोमा समघशंसमभ्यघं तपुर्ययस्तु चरुरग्निवाँ इव ।
ब्रह्मद्विषे क्रव्यादे घोरचक्षसे द्वेषो धत्तमनवायं किमीदिने ॥
verses.rom:
indrasoma samaghashamsamabhyagham tapuryayastu charuragnivan iva |
brahmadvishe kravyade ghorachakshase dvesho dhattamanavayam kimidine ||
verses.en:
Indra and Soma, let sin round the wicked boil like as a caldron set amid the flames of fire.
Against the foe of prayer, devourer of raw flesh, the vile fiend fierce of eye, keep ye perpetual hate.

verses.sa:
इन्द्रासोमा दुष्कृतो वव्रे अन्तरनारम्भणे तमसि प्र विध्यतम् ।
यथा नातः पुनरेकश्चनोदयत्तद्वामस्तु सहसे मन्युमच्छवः ॥
verses.rom:
indrasoma dushkrito vavre antaranarambhane tamasi pra vidhyatam |
yatha natah punarekashchanodayattadvamastu sahase manyumachchhavah ||
verses.en:
Indra and Soma, plunge the wicked in the depth, yea, cast them into darkness that hath no support,
So that not one of them may ever thence return: so may your wrathful might prevail and conquer them.

verses.sa:
इन्द्रासोमा वर्तयतं दिवो वधं सं पृथिव्या अघशंसाय तर्हणम् ।
उत्तक्षतं स्वर्यं पर्वतेभ्यो येन रक्षो वावृधानं निजूर्वथः ॥
verses.rom:
indrasoma vartayatam divo vadham sam prithivya aghashamsaya tarhanam |
uttakshatam svaryam parvatebhyo yena raksho vavridhanam nijurvathah ||
verses.en:
Indra and Soma, hurl your deadly crushing bolt down on the wicked fiend from heaven and from the earth.
Yea, forge out of the mountains your celestial dart wherewith ye burn to death the waxing demon race.

verses.sa:
इन्द्रासोमा वर्तयतं दिवस्पर्यग्नितप्तेभिर्युवमश्महन्मभिः ।
तपुर्वधेभिरजरेभिरत्रिणो नि पर्शाने विध्यतं यन्तु निस्वरम् ॥
verses.rom:
indrasoma vartayatam divasparyagnitaptebhiryuvamashmahanmabhih |
tapurvadhebhirajarebhiratrino ni parshane vidhyatam yantu nisvaram ||
verses.en:
Indra and Soma, cast ye downward out of heaven your deadly darts of stone burning with fiery flame,
Eternal, scorching darts; plunge the voracious ones within the depth, and let them sink without a sound.

verses.sa:
इन्द्रासोमा परि वां भूतु विश्वत इयं मतिः कक्ष्याश्वेव वाजिना ।
यां वां होत्रां परिहिनोमि मेधयेमा ब्रह्माणि नृपतीव जिन्वतम् ॥
verses.rom:
indrasoma pari vam bhutu vishvata iyam matih kakshyashveva vajina |
yam vam hotram parihinomi medhayema brahmani nripativa jinvatam ||
verses.en:
Indra and Soma, let this hymn control you both, even as the girth encompasses two vigorous steeds-
The song of praise which I with wisdom offer you: do ye, as Lords of men, animate these my prayers.

verses.sa:
प्रति स्मरेथां तुजयद्भिरेवैर्हतं द्रुहो रक्षसो भङ्गुरावतः ।
इन्द्रासोमा दुष्कृते मा सुगं भूद्यो नः कदा चिदभिदासति द्रुहा ॥
verses.rom:
prati smaretham tujayadbhirevairhatam druho rakshaso bhanguravatah |
indrasoma dushkrite ma sugam bhudyo nah kada chidabhidasati druha ||
verses.en:
In your impetuous manner think ye both thereon: destroy these evil beings, slay the treacherous fiends.
Indra and Soma, let the wicked have no bliss who evermore assails us with malignity.

verses.sa:
यो मा पाकेन मनसा चरन्तमभिचष्टे अनृतेभिर्वचोभिः ।
आप इव काशिना संगृभीता असन्नस्त्वासत इन्द्र वक्ता ॥
verses.rom:
yo ma pakena manasa charantamabhichashte anritebhirvachobhih |
apa iva kashina samgribhita asannastvasata indra vakta ||
verses.en:
Whoso accuses me with words of falsehood when I pursue my way with guileless spirit,
May he, the speaker of untruth, be, Indra, like water which the hollowed hand compresses.

verses.sa:
ये पाकशंसं विहरन्त एवैर्ये वा भद्रं दूषयन्ति स्वधाभिः ।
अहये वा तान्प्रददातु सोम आ वा दधातु निरृतेरुपस्थे ॥
verses.rom:
ye pakashamsam viharanta evairye va bhadram dushayanti svadhabhih |
ahaye va tanpradadatu soma a va dadhatu nirriterupasthe ||
verses.en:
Those who destroy, as is their wont, the simple, and with their evil natures harm the righteous,
May Soma give them over to the serpent, or to the lap of Nirrti consign them.

verses.sa:
यो नो रसं दिप्सति पित्वो अग्ने यो अश्वानां यो गवां यस्तनूनाम् ।
रिपु स्तेन स्तेयकृद्दभ्रमेतु नि ष हीयतां तन्वा तना च ॥
verses.rom:
yo no rasam dipsati pitvo agne yo ashvanam yo gavam yastanunam |
ripu stena steyakriddabhrametu ni sha hiyatam tanva tana cha ||
verses.en:
The fiend, O Agni, who designs to injure the essence of our food, kine, steeds, or bodies,
May he, the adversary, thief, and robber, sink to destruction, both himself and offspring.

verses.sa:
परः सो अस्तु तन्वा तना च तिस्रः पृथिवीरधो अस्तु विश्वाः ।
प्रति शुष्यतु यशो अस्य देवा यो नो दिवा दिप्सति यश्च नक्तम् ॥
verses.rom:
parah so astu tanva tana cha tisrah prithiviradho astu vishvah |
prati shushyatu yasho asya deva yo no diva dipsati yashcha naktam ||
verses.en:
May he be swept away, himself and children: may all the three earths press him down beneath them.
May his fair glory, O ye Gods, be blighted, who in the day or night would fain destroy us.

verses.sa:
सुविज्ञानं चिकितुषे जनाय सच्चासच्च वचसी पस्पृधाते ।
तयोर्यत्सत्यं यतरदृजीयस्तदित्सोमोऽवति हन्त्यासत् ॥
verses.rom:
suvijnanam chikitushe janaya sachchasachcha vachasi paspridhate |
tayoryatsatyam yataradrijiyastaditsomo'vati hantyasat ||
verses.en:
The prudent finds it easy to distinguish the true and false: their words oppose each other.
Of these two that which is the true and honest, Soma protects, and brings the false to nothing.

verses.sa:
न वा उ सोमो वृजिनं हिनोति न क्षत्रियं मिथुया धारयन्तम् ।
हन्ति रक्षो हन्त्यासद्वदन्तमुभाविन्द्रस्य प्रसितौ शयाते ॥
verses.rom:
na va u somo vrijinam hinoti na kshatriyam mithuya dharayantam |
hanti raksho hantyasadvadantamubhavindrasya prasitau shayate ||
verses.en:
Never doth Soma aid and guide the wicked or him who falsely claims the Warrior's title.
He slays the fiend and him who speaks untruly: both lie entangled in the noose of Indra.

verses.sa:
यदि वाहमनृतदेव आस मोघं वा देवाँ अप्यूहे अग्ने ।
किमस्मभ्यं जातवेदो हृणीषे द्रोघवाचस्ते निरृथं सचन्ताम् ॥
verses.rom:
yadi vahamanritadeva asa mogham va devan apyuhe agne |
kimasmabhyam jatavedo hrinishe droghavachaste nirritham sachantam ||
verses.en:
As if I worshipped deities of falsehood, or thought vain thoughts about the Gods, O Agni.
Why art thou angry with us, Jatavedas? Destruction fall on those who lie against thee!

verses.sa:
अद्या मुरीय यदि यातुधानो अस्मि यदि वायुस्ततप पूरुषस्य ।
अधा स वीरैर्दशभिर्वि यूया यो मा मोघं यातुधानेत्याह ॥
verses.rom:
adya muriya yadi yatudhano asmi yadi vayustatapa purushasya |
adha sa virairdashabhirvi yuya yo ma mogham yatudhanetyaha ||
verses.en:
So may I die this day if I have harassed any man's life or if I be a demon.
Yea, may he lose all his ten sons together who with false tongue hath called me Yatudhana.

verses.sa:
यो मायातुं यातुधानेत्याह यो वा रक्षाः शुचिरस्मीत्याह ।
इन्द्रस्तं हन्तु महता वधेन विश्वस्य जन्तोरधमस्पदीष्ट ॥
verses.rom:
yo mayatum yatudhanetyaha yo va rakshah shuchirasmityaha |
indrastam hantu mahata vadhena vishvasya jantoradhamaspadishta ||
verses.en:
May Indra slay him with a mighty weapon, and let the vilest of all creatures perish,
The fiend who says that he is pure, who calls me a demon though devoid of demon nature.

verses.sa:
प्र या जिगाति खर्गलेव नक्तमप द्रुहा तन्वं गूहमाना ।
वव्राँ अनन्ताँ अव सा पदीष्ट ग्रावाणो घ्नन्तु रक्षस उपब्दैः ॥
verses.rom:
pra ya jigati khargaleva naktamapa druha tanvam guhamana |
vavran anantan ava sa padishta gravano ghnantu rakshasa upabdaih ||
verses.en:
She too who wanders like an owl at night-time, hiding her body in her guile and malice,
May she fall downward into endless caverns. May press-stones with loud ring destroy the demons.

verses.sa:
वि तिष्ठध्वं मरुतो विक्ष्विच्छत गृभायत रक्षसः सं पिनष्टन ।
वयो ये भूत्वी पतयन्ति नक्तभिर्ये वा रिपो दधिरे देवे अध्वरे ॥
verses.rom:
vi tishthadhvam maruto vikshvichchhata gribhayata rakshasah sam pinashtana |
vayo ye bhutvi patayanti naktabhirye va ripo dadhire deve adhvare ||
verses.en:
Spread out, ye Maruts, search among the people: seize ye and grind the Raksasas to pieces,
Who fly abroad, transformed to birds, at night-time, or sully and pollute our holy worship.

verses.sa:
प्र वर्तय दिवो अश्मानमिन्द्र सोमशितं मघवन्सं शिशाधि ।
प्राक्तादपाक्तादधरादुदक्तादभि जहि रक्षसः पर्वतेन ॥
verses.rom:
pra vartaya divo ashmanamindra somashitam maghavansam shishadhi |
praktadapaktadadharadudaktadabhi jahi rakshasah parvatena ||
verses.en:
Hurl down from heaven thy bolt of stone, O Indra: sharpen it, Maghavan, made keen by Soma.
Forward, behind, and from above and under, smite down the demons with thy rocky weapon.

verses.sa:
एत उ त्ये पतयन्ति श्वयातव इन्द्रं दिप्सन्ति दिप्सवोऽदाभ्यम् ।
शिशीते शक्रः पिशुनेभ्यो वधं नूनं सृजदशनिं यातुमद्भ्यः ॥
verses.rom:
eta u tye patayanti shvayatava indram dipsanti dipsavo'dabhyam |
shishite shakrah pishunebhyo vadham nunam srijadashanim yatumadbhyah ||
verses.en:
They fly, the demon dogs, and, bent on mischief, fain would they harm indomitable Indra.
Sakra makes sharp his weapon for the wicked: now, let him cast his bolt at fiendish wizards.

verses.sa:
इन्द्रो यातूनामभवत्पराशरो हविर्मथीनामभ्याविवासताम् ।
अभीदु शक्रः परशुर्यथा वनं पात्रेव भिन्दन्सत एति रक्षसः ॥
verses.rom:
indro yatunamabhavatparasharo havirmathinamabhyavivasatam |
abhidu shakrah parashuryatha vanam patreva bhindansata eti rakshasah ||
verses.en:
Indra hath ever been the fiends' destroyer who spoil oblations of the Gods' invokers:
Yea, Sakra, like an axe that splits the timber, attacks and smashes them like earthen vessels.

verses.sa:
उलूकयातुं शुशुलूकयातुं जहि श्वयातुमुत कोकयातुम् ।
सुपर्णयातुमुत गृध्रयातुं दृषदेव प्र मृण रक्ष इन्द्र ॥
verses.rom:
ulukayatum shushulukayatum jahi shvayatumuta kokayatum |
suparnayatumuta gridhrayatum drishadeva pra mrina raksha indra ||
verses.en:
Destroy the fiend shaped like an owl or owlet, destroy him in the form of dog or cuckoo.
Destroy him shaped as eagle or as vulture as with a stone, O Indra, crush the demon.

verses.sa:
मा नो रक्षो अभि नड्यातुमावतामपोच्छतु मिथुना या किमीदिना ।
पृथिवी नः पार्थिवात्पात्वंहसोऽन्तरिक्षं दिव्यात्पात्वस्मान् ॥
verses.rom:
ma no raksho abhi nadyatumavatamapochchhatu mithuna ya kimidina |
prithivi nah parthivatpatvamhaso'ntariksham divyatpatvasman ||
verses.en:
Let not the fiend of witchcraft-workers reach us: may Dawn drive off the couples of Kimidins.
Earth keep us safe from earthly woe and trouble: from grief that comes from heaven mid-air preserve us.

verses.sa:
इन्द्र जहि पुमांसं यातुधानमुत स्त्रियं मायया शाशदानाम् ।
विग्रीवासो मूरदेवा ऋदन्तु मा ते दृशन्सूर्यमुच्चरन्तम् ॥
verses.rom:
indra jahi pumamsam yatudhanamuta striyam mayaya shashadanam |
vigrivaso muradeva ridantu ma te drishansuryamuchcharantam ||
verses.en:
Slay the male demon, Indra! slay the female, joying and triumphing in arts of magic.
Let the fools' gods with bent necks fall and perish, and see no more the Sun when he arises.

verses.sa:
प्रति चक्ष्व वि चक्ष्वेन्द्रश्च सोम जागृतम् ।
रक्षोभ्यो वधमस्यतमशनिं यातुमद्भ्यः ॥
verses.rom:
prati chakshva vi chakshvendrashcha soma jagritam |
rakshobhyo vadhamasyatamashanim yatumadbhyah ||
verses.en: Look each one hither, look around Indra and Soma, watch ye well.
